title: Customer Experience Manager - Spanish and Portuguese Speaking
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Location: Lisbon, Portugal or London, the UK</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Experience Manager leads the post-sale customer journey, managing everything from onboarding to long-term retention and contract renewals. Acting as both a trusted business advisor and a commercial owner of the account, you will build strategic relationships with stakeholders to clearly articulate ROI and business value and ultimately successfully close renewals maximizing upsells and minimizing churn. You will collaborate tightly with the Sales team to maintain accurate weekly forecasts and contribute to  critical engagements like Executive Business Reviews. In addition, you will embed AI-driven optimization into your daily workflows—using advanced data analysis to uncover selling opportunities and automating routine tasks to accelerate customer outcomes and maximize operational efficiency.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <h3>Customer Lifecycle & Success</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Manage customer engagement across the entire customer lifecycle, from onboarding through renewal.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be a Trusted Advisor to your customers by helping them adopt the Cloudflare products and services to meet their needs and make them successful</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with your account teams to plan and execute long term Success Plans with our largest customers to facilitate retention and growth via product and new business unit expansion.</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintain a deep understanding of our solutions and present to customers about the most relevant features/functionality for their specific business needs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own or be an active participant in several customer touch points including: Business Value Justification meetings, Business Reviews, and Renewal Meetings, with a track record of successful planning and execution of Executive Business Reviews.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrate how your customer engagement directly impacts revenue growth and adoption of Cloudflare solutions and services.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Commercial & Renewals</h3> <ul> <li> <p>You are ultimately responsible for the retention and growth of your book of business. You will own and drive the renewal including maintaining and reporting an accurate weekly forecast.</p> </li> <li> <p>Negotiate and execute renewal contracts in accordance with customer objectives.</p> </li> <li> <p>You will be an expert in deal construction and pricing strategy. You will directly be designing renewals to create a win-win for customers and Cloudflare. </p> </li> <li> <p>Analyze data and leverage tools to identify selling opportunities and business value.</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive strong alignment with the Sales team, contributing to team forecasting, planning, and targets.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Cross-Functional & Operational Management</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Develop and maintain long-term relationships with stakeholders in your account portfolio.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support,Marketing and other teams to resolve customer business issues and work towards each customer’s stated goals.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage customer feedback and product needs by providing feature requests to internal partner teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Able to prioritize effectively to handle multiple deals at the same time.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>AI Competencies</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Generative AI: Mastery of LLMs to rapidly draft renewal communications, synthesize quarterly review data, and prepare executive summaries.</p> </li> <li> <p>Data Analysis: Proficiency in leveraging AI analytics tools to parse customer usage metrics and instantly highlight up-sell or cross-sell opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Workflow Automation: Ability to build automations to synchronize CRM data, update weekly forecasts, and trigger lifecycle alerts.</p> </li> <li> <p>AI Problem Solving: The instinct to view AI as a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Customer Success/Account Management role or Inside or Field sales.</p> </li> <li>Fluency in Spanish AND Portuguese (Italian is nice to have)</li> <li> <p>2+ years of industry experience, with experience in cloud security and/or performance industries preferred.</p> </li> <li> <p>Bachelor's degree and/or other professional qualifications.</p> </li> <li> <p>Direct experience in commercial sales, negotiation, and deal closure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of or willingness to learn about computer networking and “how the internet works,” with network security a plus.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage and prioritize competing portfolio demands, aligning internal resources with the highest-impact commercial and retention goals</p> </li> <li> <p>Expertise in SaaS retention and sales process and excellent knowledge of value driven sales.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent problem solving skills with the ability to creatively achieve resolutions.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="2">● For description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Responsibilities Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets. Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints. Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions. A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight. Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently. title: Data Engineer
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Data Foundations team ⭐ At Alan, every decision we make about our members' care, contracts and claims is a data decision. The Data Foundations team builds the platform that makes those decisions possible in a safe way. Being part of the Data Foundations team means you’ll build, maintain, and improve the Data Platform used by everyone at Alan. We enable Alan’s data-driven nature and help our colleagues make the most of their data. Partner closely with people across Alan (technical and non-technical) to understand their needs and build data solutions they can trust and use effectively. We own and manage all data-related tools that power Alan. AI is changing the way companies work with data: agents are becoming first-class users of our data warehouse. It opens a world of new usage and exciting features, as well as concerns around security, data quality and governance. We are building the foundations that allow Alan to make the most of this exciting new paradigm. Alan is expanding quickly: we went from 4 to 6 countries this year and we won’t stop there. Our objective is to onboard new countries in weeks, not months. Having strong data foundations is a cornerstone of that expansion , allowing our teams to make sense of a patchwork of insurance systems, regulations and reporting rules. Examples of our missions: improve the developer experience when building and maintaining data pipelines, enable reliable and secure access to our data warehouse for Alaners and AI agents, strengthen security and governance around our data assets, define and implement standard data practices across Alan, maintain and evolve our core data infrastructure to accommodate Alan's international expansion and growing product breadth… Our core tools include Python, Airflow, Snowflake, AWS/GCP, Metabase, Terraform, dbt, and others. Who you'll work with: Data Foundations is a small, high-leverage team inside the Tech Foundations area, whose mission is to enable product crews through world-class infrastructure, developer experience, operational excellence, and built-in security. You'd be joining as one of its core engineers, working daily with the whole Data community at Alan. 🎯 Expected skills and abilities You would thrive at Alan if most of this sounds like you: Passionate about owning ambitious problems and developing simple solutions for them. 3+ years of experience demonstrating impact in Data positions. We welcome candidates from early-career to highly experienced profiles. You may already have strong expertise in Data Engineering, or be an experienced data or software engineer looking to deepen your specialization in this area. Experience building and operating production data infrastructure : orchestration (Airflow or similar), a cloud data warehouse, infrastructure as code. Experience designing systems, tools or libraries used by other engineers, scientists or analysts . Proficient in Python and SQL. Setting a high standard of rigor and precision for yourself, interested in your craft. Curious about AI and eager to use it thoughtfully to increase your impact. Great listening and communication skills. Humble, kind, collaborative, and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!). Fluent and clear in English, both oral and written (no need to speak French!). For this role, we are looking to hire within the C0-E level range . ⚙️ Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you . Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learning or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application! 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. You want to know more about Alan? 🙌 Perks & Benefits : Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 🤘 A strong culture : People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work 🔄 A quick note about the process Note: While you're applying for a specific area, you may join a different engineering team based on where we think you'll have the most impact. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</li> <li><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>2+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li><strong>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).</li> <li><strong>Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures</strong> and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams</strong> (e.g., Customer Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills</strong>, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context</strong> — account intelligence, outreach personalisation, pipeline management, or meeting preparation. title: Compliance Analyst - Alternance (Contrat de 24 mois)
description: 🦊 À propos de Green-Got : Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous construisons l’infrastructure financière du monde qui vient, au service de la transition écologique. Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l’ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Nous proposons un compte de paiement associé à une carte, ainsi qu’une gamme de placements pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition. La Compliance est au cœur de ce modèle : c’est le socle de notre crédibilité vis-à-vis de nos membres, du régulateur et de la mission que nous portons. Lieu : Paris (75) + Télétravail partiel Contrat : Alternance Niveau : Master 1 Poste à pourvoir : Janvier - Février 2027 Chez Green-Got, la Compliance est un pilier stratégique. Nous voulons la faire évoluer vite, avec les bons outils, les bonnes personnes et une vraie culture de la donnée. Nous recherchons un profil hybride, capable de concilier la rigueur du traitement opérationnel et la puissance de la data. Au-delà des acquis académiques, c’est la posture qui fera la différence : autonomie, initiative sincère et envie d’avancer dans un environnement qui bouge vite. Tu es méthodique sur le fond et réactif dans l’exécution. Les deux à la fois. Une mission au service de notre raison d’être La transition écologique est notre mission principale : permettre à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance, et orienter nos placements vers les entreprises qui font avancer la transition. La Compliance rend cette mission crédible et durable. Tes missions Au sein d’une équipe Compliance à taille humaine (nous sommes 5 aujourd’hui), tu es en interface directe avec les équipes Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data, nos partenaires et nos membres. Nos missions vont évoluer avec notre offre et avec une année 2027 qui s’annonce très dynamique. Le descriptif de ce poste bougera donc certainement, mais l’objectif restera le même : rester conforme à nos obligations tout en faisant avancer l’entreprise. Production et gestion des dossiers Compliance (80 %) Traitement des dossiers KYC et de l’entrée en relation : tu analyses les dossiers, vérifies la cohérence des informations et prépares les décisions de validation ou de refus. Vigilance sur les flux et les alertes : tu qualifies les alertes, identifies les situations à risque et proposes les mesures à prendre. Déclarations de soupçon (TRACFIN) : tu participes à la préparation et à la transmission des déclarations, sous la supervision de l’équipe. Relation avec les membres et les partenaires : tu réponds aux questions de conformité avec un discours clair, pédagogique et ferme. Traçabilité : chaque action est documentée. Dans un environnement réglementé, ce qui n’est pas tracé n’a pas été fait. Outils et amélioration continue (20 %) Maîtrise de nos outils internes : tu utilises Notion au quotidien pour documenter, suivre et partager le travail de l’équipe. C’est un outil central de notre fonctionnement que tu dois maîtriser rapidement. Automatisation : tu repères les tâches répétitives et proposes des solutions pour les réduire, en lien avec l’équipe Data & IA. Veille et documentation : tu suis les évolutions réglementaires et contribues à maintenir nos procédures à jour. Ta montée en compétences Les premiers mois sont consacrés à une immersion forte dans la production. Nous te donnons un cadre clair pour gagner en autonomie : Mois 1 : comprendre Green-Got, notre application et les fondamentaux de la Compliance. Mois 2 : maîtriser les outils et les sujets opérationnels. Mois 3 : être autonome sur les cas simples, continuer d’apprendre sur les cas complexes. Mois 4 : être pleinement autonome sur l’opérationnel et contribuer aux projets de l’équipe. Ton profil Nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, prêt à grandir avec nous : quelqu’un de passionné par les enjeux réglementaires et par les sujets data et IA, qui veut voir l’impact concret de son travail sur une infrastructure financière que nous construisons avec conviction. Tu as une vraie envie de travailler, d’avancer et d’évoluer. Tu es prêt à un rythme soutenu, car la charge de travail peut être importante. Maturité et autonomie : tu avances sans attendre qu’on te guide pas à pas. Tu identifies les problèmes, tu proposes des solutions et tu prends en charge tes sujets jusqu’au bout. Sens de l’initiative : ton rôle dépasse l’exécution. Tu questionnes, tu améliores, tu contribues. Curiosité et débrouillardise : tu apprends vite, seul comme en équipe, et tu es à l’aise dans un environnement qui change souvent. Niveau d’exigence : tu ne te contentes pas de l’à-peu-près. La précision est un réflexe. Appétence pour l’IA et la data : tu utilises déjà ces outils pour travailler plus vite et mieux, et tu as envie d’aller plus loin. Ce n’est pas la mission principale du poste, mais c’est une compétence que nous attendons. Intérêt pour la conformité : tu veux comprendre les mécanismes KYC, LCB-FT et RGPD, et t’y investir sur la durée. Aisance rédactionnelle et relationnelle : tu sais expliquer une situation complexe simplement, à un membre comme à un collègue. Esprit d’équipe : la Compliance se construit collectivement, le partage d’information fait partie de notre culture. Formation : tu démarres un Master 1 (ou une année équivalente en école de commerce, d’ingénierie ou de droit), idéalement avec un ancrage en finance, risques, audit ou droit. Anglais opérationnel , indispensable pour échanger avec l’équipe technique et nos partenaires. Bonus : une première expérience ou un projet personnel qui te fait fier. Un lien à partager est le bienvenu. Chez Green-Got, nous sommes rusés, responsables, nous recherchons constamment le progrès, nous allons vite et le collectif passe avant l’individu. Ce que nous t'offrons Avec notre agrément ACPR, nous construisons nos propres standards de Compliance, avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant. Un rôle avec de vraies responsabilités : dès les premiers mois, tu portes tes sujets, et ton travail a un impact direct sur notre dispositif. Un apprentissage de terrain : aux côtés d’une équipe qui transmet ses savoir-faire opérationnels, au contact de l’ensemble des équipes (Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data). Une équipe exigeante et soudée , qui sait aussi passer de bons moments ensemble. Un environnement en forte croissance , où les profils les plus engagés progressent vite. Le package Cadre : alternance basée à Paris, minimum 4 jours au bureau par semaine. Rémunération : selon la grille légale en vigueur (variable selon l’âge, le niveau de formation et le type de contrat). Santé : mutuelle Alan. Cohésion : une journée d’équipe chaque semestre. Déroulement des entretiens Envoie-nous ton CV, une courte présentation de toi, ton calendrier d’alternance et, si possible, le montant de tes frais d’inscription. Nous t’appellerons rapidement pour faire connaissance, dès que ton profil aura retenu notre attention. Si ça matche, nous t'enverrons un Business Case à préparer. Entretien en visio avec Justé (Compliance Manager) et un futur collègue pour analyser le Business Case, évaluer tes compétences et faire connaissance.. Échange de 15 min avec un autre membre de l’équipe pour le fit culturel. Entretien avec Adèle (Head of Operations). Entretien final avec Andréa (CEO). Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer ! title: Release Engineer, Salesforce
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An Overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Senior Release Engineer to help design, standardize, and operate reliable enterprise application delivery across the Enterprise Technology & AI team. This role will establish scalable CI/CD practices for business-critical platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora and other Business Systems while enabling engineering teams to ship changes safely, quickly, and with clear operational controls.</p> <p>The ideal candidate combines strong release engineering and automation skills with practical experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications. You will build and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines, develop reusable scripts and deployment tooling, improve release governance, and partner with application, security, compliance, and business teams across the release lifecycle. Daily use of approved AI-assisted engineering tools, including Claude, Duo Agent Platform or comparable enterprise-approved tools, is a mandatory expectation for DevOps, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and automation activities.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications, including validation, testing, packaging, deployment, promotion, rollback, and post-release verification.</li> <li>Develop reusable automation using scripting languages such as Python to reduce manual release activities and improve repeatability.</li> <li>Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude or similar tools every day to accelerate pipeline development, scripting, test creation, troubleshooting, documentation, release analysis, and operational automation.</li> <li>Define and implement CI/CD patterns for platforms such as <strong>Salesforce, Zuora, </strong>and other <strong>Business Systems.</strong></li> <li>Establish environment and promotion strategies across development, test, staging, and production, including configuration management and deployment sequencing.</li> <li>Implement quality gates, automated checks, approvals, audit trails, and policy controls appropriate for enterprise application releases.</li> <li>Partner with application owners and development teams to define branching, versioning, release cadence, and rollback standards.</li> <li>Improve release observability through deployment dashboards, pipeline metrics, change records, notifications, and operational reporting.</li> <li>Investigate failed deployments and release issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions.</li> <li>Contribute to release calendars, change planning, blackout-period coordination, and risk-based release decision-making.</li> <li>Build documentation, runbooks, reusable templates, and enablement materials so teams can adopt consistent delivery practices.</li> <li>Coach engineers and application teams on GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD tools, release automation, trunk/branching strategies, testing, and operational readiness.</li> <li>Collaborate with security, compliance, architecture, and enterprise application stakeholders to meet control requirements without creating unnecessary delivery friction.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science,Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>7+ years of experience in release engineering, DevOps or a related discipline.</li> <li>Experience in Release & deployments for enterprise SaaS applications such as <strong>Salesforce, Zuora or Business Systems.</strong></li> <li>Strong hands-on experience designing and operating GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines in production environments.</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation and integrations.</li> <li>Mandatory hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools such as Claude or comparable enterprise-approved tools as part of day-to-day DevOps and release engineering work.</li> <li>Experience with source control, branching and merging strategies, artifact management, automated testing, deployment orchestration, and rollback practices.</li> <li>Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication patterns, and integration troubleshooting.</li> <li>Experience managing releases across multiple environments with strong attention to configuration, dependencies, access controls, and auditability.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, integration defects, and environment inconsistencies.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, business, security, compliance, and operations teams.</li> <li>Enterprise application releases become more predictable, repeatable, and transparent.</li> <li>Manual deployment effort and avoidable release errors decrease through automation and standardization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>ETA teams adopt reusable GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD patterns for Salesforce, Zuora, and other enterprise platforms.Release quality improves through automated validation, testing, policy checks, and post-deployment verification. Deployment, change, and compliance evidence is available through reliable pipeline records and operational reporting. Application teams can move faster while maintaining appropriate controls for business-critical systems. AI-assisted DevOps adoption measurably improves engineering throughput, troubleshooting speed, automation coverage, and documentation quality without reducing delivery controls.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Du kümmerst dich darum, dass unser Arbeitsplatz immer optimal ausgestattet ist – funktional, einladend, gut organisiert und den Anforderungen des Arbeitsschutzes entsprechend. Du unterstützt bei Vertragsangelegenheiten, beispielsweise bei der Vorbereitung von Vertragsunterlagen, Vertragsänderungen und weiteren administrativen Dokumenten. Du pflegst und aktualisierst Mitarbeitendendaten in unserer HR-Software und unterstützt bei der Verwaltung digitaler Personalunterlagen. Du behältst wichtige Fristen, Termine und wiederkehrende HR-Prozesse im Blick und unterstützt bei deren zuverlässiger Umsetzung. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und vertraulich mit personenbezogenen Daten und bist bei administrativen Fragen eine verlässliche Schnittstelle für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte. Arbeitsschutz & Gesundheitsorganisation Du unterstützt das People & Culture Team bei der Organisation und Dokumentation von Arbeitsschutzthemen. Dazu gehören beispielsweise die Koordination von Erstunterweisungen, Schulungen, Vorsorgeangeboten und wiederkehrenden Terminen. Du behältst die Ausstattung und Rahmenbedingungen im Office im Blick und bringst Hinweise oder Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten aktiv ein. Du unterstützt bei der Pflege relevanter Übersichten, Dokumentationen und Informationen rund um Arbeitsschutz und Gesundheit im Arbeitsalltag. Teaminterne Events & interne Kulturmomente Du planst, koordinierst und begleitest teaminterne Events wie Teamfrühstücke, Offsite-Days, interne Workshops oder saisonale Highlights. Als Teil des People & Culture Teams arbeitest du eng mit deinen Kolleg/innen und den Führungskräften zusammen, um unseren teaminternen Events ein echtes „Wir“-Gefühl zu geben und für gute Erlebnisse im Alltag zu sorgen. Ansprechpartner/in für Employee Wellbeing Du hast ein offenes Ohr für die Anliegen unserer Mitarbeitenden und trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass sich alle im Team gesehen und gut unterstützt fühlen. Du identifizierst frühzeitig Bedürfnisse im Team und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg/innen des People & Culture Teams passende Impulse, Formate und Maßnahmen. Du unterstützt dabei, Informationen, Angebote und Ansprechpersonen rund um den Arbeitsalltag für alle zugänglich und verständlich zu machen. Gestaltung der Arbeitsumgebung & Teamkultur Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie unser Office und unsere Arbeitsumgebung noch angenehmer, effizienter und inspirierender werden können. Du treibst kleine und große Verbesserungen an – von der Atmosphäre im Büro bis hin zu Abläufen, Ritualen und Teamkulturmomenten. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung im Office Management, in der HR Administration, im People & Culture-Bereich oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Fähigkeit, in einem lebendigen Arbeitsumfeld Prioritäten zu setzen und mehrere Themen parallel zu managen. Proaktivität und Lust, Dinge zu verbessern, Prozesse zu vereinfachen und Kultur aktiv mitzugestalten. Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an Teamarbeit. title: Senior Named Account Executive, Nordics
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Sweden</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>You aren't just selling a product; you’re selling the security, performance, and reliability that major enterprises require to stay competitive. You will be a foundational part of our growth story in the region, bridging the gap between complex technical challenges and the business value that keeps our customers ahead of the curve.</p> <h3>Why You’ll Love This Role</h3> <p>This is a <strong>builder’s role.</strong> We’re looking for a hunter who thrives on identifying opportunities, crafting a narrative, and navigating the nuances of enterprise sales.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>You’ll be an architect of growth:</strong> You will own your territory, build a strategy from the ground up, and nurture long-term, high-impact relationships.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>You’ll be a technical bridge:</strong> You will work alongside our solution engineers to demystify complex network architecture for stakeholders ranging from junior developers to the C-suite.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>You’ll work at scale:</strong> You’ll be supported by a world-class team, all while maintaining the agility of a lean, remote-first operation in Sweden.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strategy & Execution:</strong> Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan. You aren't just hitting a quota; you’re building a lasting market presence.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>The "Hunt":</strong> Identify, qualify, and capture new Enterprise business across the Nordics.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>The Narrative:</strong> Translate Cloudflare’s powerful technical capabilities into compelling value propositions that solve real-world problems for your clients.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>The Negotiation:</strong> Lead contract negotiations and manage the full cycle of the sales process.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Partnership:</strong> Develop long-term, strategic relationships. Our customers stay because we solve their hardest problems—and you’ll be at the center of that.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Seasoned Experience:</strong> 6+ years of direct B2B experience selling into Enterprise/Large-scale organizations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Regional Expertise:</strong> A strong, established network within the Swedish market.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Fluency:</strong> Professional-level proficiency in both <strong>Swedish and English (Norwegian is a plus)</strong></p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Technical Literacy:</strong> A deep understanding of Cloud, Security, and how the internet actually functions. You don't need to write code, but you need to speak the language of engineering and infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>The "Builder" Mindset:</strong> You are self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Communication:</strong> You know how to tailor your message, whether you're talking to a CTO or a procurement lead.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Does this sound like your next challenge?</h3> <ul> <li>We’re looking for someone who wants to leave a mark on the Nordic market while helping to build a safer, faster internet for everyone.</li> <li><strong>Help us build a better Internet.</strong></li> <li>Cloudflare isn’t just another tech company; we are the infrastructure that keeps the Internet fast, safe, and reliable for millions of users worldwide. We provide the "plumbing" for the modern digital economy, and we’re looking for an <strong>entrepreneurial Account Executive</strong> to help us own the Nordic market.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>For Sweden based hires: Estimated annual salary is between SEK 1,586,000 - SEK 2,180,000.</p> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description: At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath. Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day . We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams. We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin. We're hiring our first Data Engineer to own Superchat's data platform end to end, from raw product and business data to the gold tables the whole company reports on. Our engineers have already built the foundations, including a warehouse, pipelines, dbt and reverse ETL. Now we need someone to make the platform trustworthy at scale, with testing, monitoring, clear modelling layers and customer history over time. You'll set the standards for how data is modelled and documented, and work with a Business Analyst to build the gold tables that Finance, Sales, Marketing and Product rely on. Who We Want An experienced Data Engineer. You bring 3+ years of building and running data pipelines in production, ideally at a SaaS company. You've owned a data platform, or a large part of one, and you're comfortable making the architecture calls yourself. Strong in SQL and dbt. You write and review complex SQL with ease. You've built dbt projects with layered models, tests, documentation. At home in the Cloud. You have worked with Data Warehouses in the Cloud, ideally AWS Redshift. BigQuery or Snowflake is also fine. Reliability-minded. You think in tests, freshness checks, idempotent loads and backfills. You want to know the data is wrong before a stakeholder tells you. Curious about the business. You want to know what MRR, churn or an "active workspace" really mean, and you model data so those definitions hold everywhere they're used. Experience with subscription billing or product usage data is a plus. Who We Don’t Want Pure dashboard builder. You'd rather spend your days building dashboards and answering ad-hoc questions. That's our Business Analyst's job; yours is to build what they work from. Pure pipeline plumber. You move data from A to B but don't care what it means. Gold tables are only as good as the business understanding behind them. Over-engineer. You want Kafka, Spark and a lakehouse for data that fits comfortably in Redshift. We need pragmatic solutions that fit a 100-person company and can grow with it. Remote-only operator. You prefer fully remote work and don't want to build relationships in person. The data platform sits between many teams, and that works best with regular time together in our Berlin office. Our Data Stack Warehouse: AWS Redshift Ingestion: Airbyte, custom Python Transformation: dbt Orchestration: Dagster Reverse ETL: Hightouch BI: Metabase Infrastructure & CI: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions Your Day To Day Own ingestion from our product database, Chargebee, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Intercom, Amplitude and other tools, using Airbyte where it works and your own Python where it doesn't. Design and build the dbt models that take raw data to gold tables, with clear layers, naming and documentation that the Business Analyst and the rest of the company can rely on. Run orchestration in Dagster: schedules, dependencies, freshness checks and alerting, so a stalled sync gets noticed within hours. Build data quality in: dbt tests, source checks and CI on every pull request. Capture history where our source systems only keep the current state, so a question like "which plan was this customer on last March?" has an answer. Run the warehouse: Redshift performance and cost, access management, and AWS infrastructure in Terraform. Maintain the reverse ETL syncs (Hightouch) that send data back into HubSpot, Intercom and the other tools our teams work in. Why People Choose Us Mission that matters. Real impact on small businesses, not abstract metrics Funded with conviction. $18M raised and profitable Real ownership. You own the data platform end to end, not one step of someone else's pipeline Hybrid by design. Our Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg is the center of gravity, with two work-from-home days as the standard setup Direct feedback culture. Honest, direct, and kind feedback is part of how we work together - in 1:1s, retrospectives, and everyday collaboration Benefits & Culture Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription Regular company and team events Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment We want to build a community, not just a company. It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here! We're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the description. title: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Databases
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | London, UK (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.</p> <p>You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.</p> <p>Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.</li> <li>Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.</li> <li>Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.</li> <li>Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.</li> <li>Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.</li> <li>Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.</li> <li>You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.</li> <li>You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.</li> <li>You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.</li> <li>You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. title: Senior Analyst, Drug Development & Clinical Strategy
description: <p><strong>Position Summary: </strong></p> <p>Quotient is seeking a highly analytical and scientifically curious Senior Analyst to support strategic decision-making across our growing drug development pipeline. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of analytics, market intelligence, commercial strategy and early drug development in a genetics-based biotech company. </p> <p>The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills and familiarity with scientific and clinical data with commercial curiosity, to turn networks of complex data into meaningful insights. In doing so, the successful candidate will help us better understand where high-value, tractable drug development opportunities exist across our internal pipeline of drug targets, and more broadly across a range of disease areas. Together with other members of the drug development team, this role will help focus which indications, patient segments, and development paths we should consider, and where data can help inform our investment and planning decisions.</p> <p>This role could be based in our UK or US office and will report to the Chief Development Officer.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Across a range of disease/therapeutic areas, build a deep understanding of addressable markets, industry landscape, customer (health care practitioner, payor, and patient) needs, and forecast future states and opportunities for growth in sectors of interest</li> <li>Carry out market sizing, competitive analysis using epidemiology, clinical, and commercial data sets, and validate through research with external experts</li> <li>Partner with clinical, drug development and external experts/customers to further validate specific market segments and develop target product profiles (TPPs)</li> <li>Partner with Finance, Business development, and Drug Development teams to develop asset and disease area valuation models (e.g., rNPV) and support BD and finance discussions with valuation and commercial forecast models as required</li> <li>Design and improve data models, analytical frameworks, and output formats, that support assessments, presentation to stakeholders and internal decision-making</li> <li>Develop dashboards, reporting, and analysis tools to communicate outputs and disease area strategy. Develop and maintain revenue forecasts, pipeline models, and scenario analyses.  </li> <li>Prototype, test, and help deploy AI-enabled tools, agents, and other analytical resources to support all the above analyses; working with end users and internal teams to refine successful solutions</li> <li>Provide insights to drug development, project management, and finance teams to support target-setting and internal development planning.  </li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <p><u>Essential</u></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in health sciences discipline or a related field</li> <li>3+ years of experience working in or with pharmaceutical or biotech companies (including via consulting firms) in product planning or commercial strategy teams</li> <li>Experience in at least one of these disease segments: Cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, oncology, autoimmune diseases</li> <li>Familiarity with drug development strategy and regulatory pathways</li> <li>Experience with a range of healthcare or life-sciences databases and market research tools</li> <li>Exposure to valuation, business development, licensing, or investment analysis</li> <li>Strong analytical and research skills</li> <li>Familiarity with and ability to synthesize scientific, medical, and economic data</li> <li>Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Ability to work independently yet collaboratively, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines</li> </ul> <p><u>Desirable</u></p> <ul> <li>MD, PhD, or other advanced degree</li> <li>4-6+ years of industry experience</li> <li>Knowledge of genomic-based approaches to drug target discovery</li> </ul> <p><strong>Values and Behaviors:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Encourage respectful disagreement and cultivate open-minded, ego-free interactions to continuously push each other towards excellence</li> <li>Seek out diverse perspectives; practice active listening and genuine curiosity to ensure all contributions are valued, regardless of source</li> <li>Recognize the impact of your behavior, language and attitudes, and strive for balanced, meaningful exchanges that enhance mutual growth and understanding in all interactions</li> <li>Use a company-first mindset to guide decision-making; prioritize team over individual success</li> <li>Take calculated risks and challenge convention in the quest for exceptional outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Quotient:</strong></p> <p>Quotient Therapeutics is a privately-held, early stage company developing breakthrough medicines informed by natural somatic genetic diversity present in patients. Through our work in somatic genomics, we are forging a new status quo for biopharma research and development across a broad pipeline of internal and partnered programs. </p> <p>The company was founded by Flagship Pioneering, an innovative enterprise that conceives, creates, resources, and grows first-in-category life sciences companies. Flagship Pioneering has created over 100 groundbreaking companies over the past twenty years, all of which are pioneering novel and proprietary biological, industrial, and engineering approaches to solve major needs in human health and sustainability. These companies include Moderna (MRNA), Generate Biomedicines, Sana Biotechnology (SANA), Tessera Therapeutics, Evelo Biosciences (EVLO), Indigo Agriculture, Seres Therapeutics (MCRB), and Syros Pharmaceuticals (SYRS).</p> <p>Quotient Therapeutics and Flagship Pioneering are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.</p> <p><strong>Recruitment & Staffing Agencies:</strong></p> <p>Quotient Therapeutics (“Quotient”) and Flagship Pioneering (“FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. title: Senior Territory Account Executive, India
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p class="p2"><strong>Available Location: Bengaluru/Mumbai/New Delhi<br><br></strong></p> <div>About the Department Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</div> <div> </div> <div>Based in India, you will drive sales into commercial and enterprise accounts across Karnataka and South India for Cloudflare’s solutions. Your strategic selling activities will include "hunter" type activities to proactively penetrate target named accounts, detailed account planning, focused relationship building and leading effective sales campaigns to successful closure of high-value, multi-product architectural transformations.</div> <div>The ideal candidate will possess both a major account sales background in technology solutions, primarily software and cloud-based, that enables them to drive engagement with senior level decision makers (CISOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering) within Cloudflare’s target customers. Industry experience selling into Digital Natives, IT/ITES, SaaS scale-ups, and other Enterprise verticals is desired in this role. You must be capable of orchestrating complex six-figure ($100K+) expansions encompassing Zero Trust/SASE, Developer Platforms (Workers/R2), and Application Security.</div> <div> </div> <div>As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a Sales strategy/plan for assigned vertical or accounts, as well as driving large account sales into India markets to achieve revenue targets. Therefore, you must have a strong network of contacts with decision makers in enterprise accounts across the region, and have experience selling complex solutions to these accounts. You will have an intuitive understanding and experience with the key business and technical needs of these large accounts and will create and deliver compelling value propositions to them for Cloudflare solutions, specifically targeting competitive displacements of Cybersecurity SaaS like Akamai, AWS, Azure, GCP,  legacy appliances, Zscaler, or Cisco Umbrella.</div> <div>Additional responsibilities will include</div> <ul> <li> <div>Manage complex contract negotiations for high-AOV, multi-product enterprise deals</div> </li> <li> <div>Maintain a robust sales pipeline through proactive outbound targeting and whitespace mining within your installed base</div> </li> <li> <div>Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts to convert variable usage into committed enterprise contracts</div> </li> <li> <div>Collaborate closely with the regional partner ecosystem (e.g., Tech Data, Softcell) to accelerate deal velocity</div> </li> <li> <div>< 50% travel</div> </li> </ul> <div>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</div> <ul> <li> <div>Bachelor's degree required</div> </li> <li> <div>Fluent in English</div> </li> <li> <div>Relevant direct experience, track record, and relationships within corporate enterprise accounts in the India market (specifically Karnataka and South India)</div> </li> <li> <div>Minimum 10 years of direct B2B selling experience, preferably managing internet, cloud, and security accounts</div> </li> <li> <div>Direct experience selling network security, Zero Trust/SASE (Cloudflare One), and/or CDN / Application Security solutions preferred</div> </li> <li> <div>Proven track record of executing competitive takeout campaigns against legacy hardware and cloud point solutions</div> </li> <li> <div>Prior experience being part of an early sales team helping drive traction in India market for a US-based SaaS company highly preferred</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles and cross-functional evaluations</div> </li> <li> <div>Basic understanding of computer networking, cloud architectures, and “how the internet works”</div> </li> <li> <div>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</div> </li> <li> <div>Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organisational skills</div> </li> <li> <div>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</div> </li> <li> <div>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</div> </li> </ul> <p class="p2"> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Werkstudent Wirtschaftsinformatik (m/w/d)
description: Wir stellen uns dir vor. Eine Kanzlei, vielschichtige Leistungsbereiche und über 45 Teammitglieder. Bei uns kannst du die technische Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Kanzlei aktiv mitgestalten und dafür sorgen, dass digitale Anwendungen im Arbeitsalltag reibungslos funktionieren. Dabei kümmerst du dich sowohl um unsere bestehende IT-Landschaft als auch um die Entwicklung neuer Lösungen, mit denen wir wiederkehrende Abläufe automatisieren und unsere Prozesse effizienter gestalten. Wir erwarten nicht, dass du bereits jedes Programm beherrschst oder mit sämtlichen Technologien gearbeitet hast. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis mitbringst, dich gerne in neue Themen einarbeitest und Freude daran hast, eigenständig Lösungen zu entwickeln. Schließlich verändert sich die IT-Welt ständig und wir möchten uns gemeinsam mit dir weiterentwickeln. Von den folgenden Punkten solltest du dich ebenfalls angesprochen fühlen: Du absolvierst aktuell ein Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder bist in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für IT-Systeme, digitale Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge Microsoft 365 ist dir vertraut und idealerweise hast du dich bereits mit Power Automate, Power Apps oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen beschäftigt Begriffe wie APIs, JSON oder Power Query sind dir bekannt und du hast Interesse daran, dein Wissen in diesen Bereichen zu vertiefen Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert, strukturiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung Teamzusammenhalt ist dir wichtig und du hast Freude daran, andere Mitarbeiter bei technischen Fragen zu unterstützen Das passende Umfeld für deine Karriere. Ein Arbeitsverhältnis ist ein Geben und Nehmen. Deshalb kannst du dich bei uns auf weit mehr als ein sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis freuen: Gelebte Flexibilität mit Home-Office und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten Mentale Gesundheitsförderung mit vielschichtigen Unterstützungsangeboten und zusätzlich bis zu 12 Coaching- oder Therapiestunden pro Jahr Strukturierte Einarbeitung durch einen engagierten Ansprechpartner Regelmäßiges Feedback zur fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung Klare Strukturen gepaart mit digitalen und standardisierten Prozessen Vertrauen und Freiraum für ein eigenständiges Arbeiten Weiterbildungsflatrate Nettolohnoptimierung mit 50 Euro Sachbezugsgutscheinen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, Kindergartenzuschuss, Bike-Leasing etc. Business-Englisch und einmal pro Woche ein Fitnessangebot Höhenverstellbare Tische und klimatisierte Räumlichkeiten Beste technische Hard- und Software-Ausstattung (Notebook, Geschäftshandy etc.) Support durch einen kompetenten externen IT-Systempartner Regelmäßige Teamevents und vieles mehr Mit wenigen Klicks zum neuen Job. Wir gehen auch beim Bewerbungsprozess neue Wege. Bewirb dich mit nur wenigen Klicks über unser digitales Bewerbungsformular bei uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. title: Senior Consultant (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.</p> <p>With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <h2>Main Responsibilities</h2> <p>As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy Development:</strong> Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?</li> <li><strong>Structured Problem-Solving:</strong> Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.</li> <li><strong>Solution Design:</strong> Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Project Delivery:</strong> Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Client Engagement:</strong> Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge & Practice Building:</strong> Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.</li> </ul> <h2>Candidate Profile</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.</li> <li><strong>Work Experience:</strong> Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility. </li> <li><strong>Business Acumen & AI Fluency:</strong> A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.</li> <li><strong>Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Interpersonal Skills:</strong> Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred.. </li> <li><strong>Work Eligibility:</strong> You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join Us</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and the Build:</strong> Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.</li> <li><strong>Engineers, not hand-offs:</strong> Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.</li> <li><strong>Zurich Office Impact:</strong> As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Learning & Growth:</strong> Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.</li> <li><strong>Culture of Doers:</strong> Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.</li> </ul> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich or Lausanne</strong>.</p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow
