title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description: Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on. The Role As Senior Product Designer you shape how our customers and operators experience Optics11’s end-to-end underwater security solutions: from in-field sensor data acquisition, through data processing, to the software platform where that data is exposed and acted on. You combine user research with hands-on UX/UI design: you understand users in the field, turn those insights into workflows and interface designs, and hand over clear, build-ready designs to our front-end developers. You are part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with Product Management, R&D, Engineering, Data Science, Software, Sales, Projects and Application Engineering. No two weeks will look the same. You might join an Application Engineer in the field, interview operators and technicians, trace how sensor data flows from the field to the operator’s screen, prototype a new workflow in Figma, or review a front-end implementation with the developers. You own the user experience of our software platform, from research insight to interface design, and make sure real user needs guide decisions across technical, product and commercial teams. Within your first 6–12 months, you will establish a shared, evidence-based view of our users through personas, journey maps and a structured insight repository; evolve our design system and UI guidelines for the software platform; and deliver interface designs for priority platform features that our developers can build with confidence. This reduces development risk and helps us deliver technology customers can trust in demanding, high-stakes environments Responsibilities Lead user and customer research: plan and run qualitative, quantitative and field studies across installation, operation and maintenance (for example alongside our Application Engineers), and translate findings into product and design decisions. Design the user experience of our software platform: turn product requirements from Product Management and the Product Owner into information architecture, user flows and interaction patterns for complex, data-rich operator workflows (detect, assess, identify and classify), from early concepts to interactive prototypes. Propose and hand over UI designs to front-end developers: create high-fidelity, build-ready designs and specifications, align on feasibility with developers and the Product Owner, and review implementations for quality and consistency. Own end-to-end customer journeys: map the experience from in-field deployment and data acquisition through data processing to the software platform, including demo flows and supporting internal processes. Manage personas and customer insights: maintain the persona set and a central research repository, and synthesise learnings collected across the organisation. Validate and measure outcomes: run usability tests before and after release, define adoption and usability metrics, and report impact to stakeholders. Evolve and maintain our design system: extend the existing basis with UI components, patterns and guidelines that keep the platform consistent, accessible and efficient to develop. Partner across the organisation: work closely with Product Management, Product Ownership and System Architecture, as well as Sales, Business Development, Application Engineering, Support and Marketing, to prioritise development, reduce product risk and advance user-centred practices. Requirements Master’s degree in interaction design, human-computer interaction, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience in UX or product design, covering both user research and hands-on UX/UI design, preferably in defense or other technical, high-stakes industries. A portfolio showing end-to-end work, from research and workflows to high-fidelity UX/UI for data-rich professional software (e.g. situational-awareness, control-room or analytics applications). Experience working on integrated software platforms rather than isolated websites or prototypes. Experience handing designs over to front-end developers and working with and evolving a design system, with a working understanding of front-end technology and its constraints. Proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and design proposals. Understanding of end-to-end systems in which sensor data is acquired in the field, processed and exposed on a software platform, ideally in complex or regulated environments. Able to translate complex technical workflows and data into clear, intuitive interfaces, with strong attention to visual detail, consistency and quality. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; able to present research and designs to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proficiency in Figma and in research and collaboration tools such as Jira Product Discovery, Dovetail and Miro. Willingness to travel and do field research. Driver’s license B (or international equivalent). Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry. Nice to Have Big plus: Experience with underwater acoustics or sonar software. Plus: Experience in design leadership, or in setting up design practices in a growing organisation. Plus: Front-end skills (e.g. HTML/CSS, React) for prototyping next to AI based tooling. Plus: Proficiency in Dutch. Screening You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: CDI - Head of Finance (Paris)
description: We are hiring a Head of Finance and to own the finance function end to end, reporting to the CFO: monthly close and reporting, budget and rolling business plan, board materials, cash, audits and the regulatory obligations of a syndic, across our French and German entities. It is a hands-on role for someone who can do every job in the team and wants to shape the function as the company scales. With our CFO focused on fundraising and strategic topics, you will be the day-to-day finance decision-maker, working directly with the CEO, the VPs and the German country manager. As Matera grows, including through acquisitions in France and Germany, there is scope to rapidly grow into a VP Finance role. What you will do 1. Operational finance and business plan (70%) : Own the monthly close of all entities (in France and Germany) and deliver the management reporting pack: P&L, cash, KPIs, reconciliation with the statutory accounts, reporting to investors and banks. Own the annual budget , built with every team lead, and the business plan , updated every month after the close, for France and Germany. Own cash : the cash forecast, collection from customers, bank loans and their covenants, financing files and data rooms. Deliver the statutory audits in France and Germany and the annual accounts and filings of every entity, as well as the obligations specific to a property manager: the financial guarantee ( garantie financière ) that protects our clients' money, and the certifications of the funds we hold on their behalf ( fonds mandants ). You also cover the research tax credit (CIR) and tax. 2. Strategic topics (20%) : Lead the finance team (4 people) and steer our external accountants and auditors on scope, calendar and fees. Prepare the board deck and investor materials with the CFO , including for our 2027 fundraise, and bring a clear finance view to strategic decisions: acquisitions, growth versus capacity, cash allocation, pricing. Drive our finance tools roadmap : selecting and rolling out an ERP (planned for late 2027), billing and payment tools, and automating data and reporting. Pick up whatever else lands on finance : supplier negotiations, legal structure of our entities, equity events. 3. M&A (10%) : work with the other teams on financial analyses, billing, and the integration of the companies we acquire. Responsible commute leave : 1 extra paid day off per year (can be split into two half-days) to encourage low-carbon commuting. Menstrual leave : 1 extra paid day off per month to manage painful periods. Sport : access to Wellpass for affordable gym and sports. Works council perks (Leeto) : discounts on culture and leisure (cinema, museums, theme parks…). Remote work : 2 days a week at the office. Career support : weekly one-to-ones with your manager, 2 performance reviews a year, and an internal mobility policy. A laptop and a work phone. Practical information Location : Paris 10th Contract : permanent contract (CDI), full-time, cadre status on a forfait jours basis Salary : €90k to €100k base, depending on experience Start date : before July 2027 What we are looking for You must have: 7+ years in finance, including at least 2 years owning the close and audits of a multi-entity company, for example as Head of Finance, Finance Manager or Senior Financial Controller. Hands-on experience of closing the books and running statutory audits in France : you know the French system (social charges, tax, statutory auditors). Experience in a group with entities in other countries (not necessarily Germany). You build and defend financial models (P&L, cash, headcount, churn) and can run a monthly business plan yourself. You have managed a small team, and you still like doing some of the work yourself. Fluent French and English , written and spoken. You are: Direct : you say when a number does not hold, including to the CEO. Hands-on and structured : you turn open questions into plans with owners and deadlines. Firm with suppliers : you manage auditors, accountants and vendors on scope, calendar and fees. Autonomous and comfortable with change : you have worked in a growing company that needed structure. Nice to have: Experience with a German subsidiary or parent company, or speaking German. Experience of acquisitions and their integration. Experience in a regulated environment or with client funds (real estate, property management, fintech). Experience of selecting or rolling out an ERP. title: Graduate Software Engineer - Defence & Security (2027 start)
description: <p> </p> <h3><strong>Introduction  </strong></h3> <p>We’re seeking bright, curious graduates who are passionate about software and excited by how technology can solve real problems. Join our Software and Electronics Department and contribute to projects spanning the consumer, energy, industrial, and defence & security sectors. <br>You’ll get hands-on experience with a range of technologies aligned to your skills and interests, helping to tackle and solve real challenges for our clients.</p> <p><strong>Successful candidates can join us between May – October 2027 </strong></p> <p><strong>There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.  </strong></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What you’ll be doing  </strong></h3> <p>Day to day you will be working in a team with colleagues and clients, learning from experienced engineers to design, develop and debug software of all descriptions. This may range from web applications to embedded software, protocols and machine control.  You will also have the opportunity to collaborate on research projects and participate in STEM outreach activities with schools.  </p> <p>You could be working on projects like:  </p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/case-studies/iridium-extreme-satellite-phone">Satellite communications</a> – <a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/press-releases/satellite-cameras-saving-endangered-species">used in humanitarian relief efforts, wildlife conservation and more </a><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/press-releases/satellite-cameras-saving-endangered-species"> </a></li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/wireless-breakthrough-for-the-ocado-smart-platform/">Wireless control of high-speed warehouse robots  </a></li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/robot-navigation-and-simulation-for-industrial-autonomous-vehicles/">Robotics – autonomous navigation in crowded environments</a><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/robot-navigation-and-simulation-for-industrial-autonomous-vehicles/"> </a>  </li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/revolutionary-sports-wearable-technology-for-whoop/">Cutting-edge wearables and audio devices</a>  </li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/the-worlds-largest-commercial-airborne-antenna-for-world-mobile-stratospheric/">Beam 5G from the stratosphere with the world’s largest commercial airborne antenna  </a></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Unfortunately, we can’t talk about some of our clients until you join us, but you could be developing the next breakthrough product for brands you use every day.  </p> <p>  </p> <h3><strong>What you can bring  </strong></h3> <ul> <li>You are a high-achieving graduate (or soon-to-be graduate) in a STEM discipline, with a strong academic track record and a genuine interest in software development.</li> <li>You have practical programming experience in at least one of: C, C++, Python or Rust demonstrated through projects, coursework, or personal work that shows your curiosity and capability.</li> <li>You have a solid foundation in core software engineering practices, including problem-solving, structured thinking, and an understanding of how high-quality software is designed and built.</li> <li>You have knowledge of and a willingness to learn new programming languages, tools, and technologies, alongside a genuine enthusiasm for learning and solving interesting problems.</li> </ul> <p>Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to obtain a Security Check (SC) level security clearance  ( <a href="https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant">United Kingdom Security Vetting: Applicant</a> ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.</p> <p>Please be aware that, for roles requiring Security Check clearance, applicants will typically need to have been continuously resident in the UK for a minimum of 5 years immediately prior to applying for this role in order to meet the requirements for Security Check (SC) clearance.</p> <p>Along with your CV, please describe why you are attracted to this position, what you feel you offer Cambridge Consultants, and any achievements that you are particularly proud of. We are especially interested to hear about any software, electronics or engineering projects you have done, for a hobby, for work or for university. </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.</strong><br></p> <hr> <p style="text-align: center;"> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Lab Technician
description: <p></p> <p><strong>Senior Lab Technician | Precision Semiconductor Metrology</strong><br>Abingdon, UK</p> <p><strong>Reward and Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>£40,000 - £50,000 (depending on experience)</li> <li>Annual bonus, 3x salary death in service and private health care benefits BUPA, EMI Share scheme.</li> </ul> <p>If you are a Senior Lab Technician who keeps a busy engineering lab running smoothly and enjoys building things with your hands, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and take ownership of the lab behind our advanced semiconductor metrology systems.</p> <p>We are looking for a practical, well-organised Senior Lab Technician to join our Development Engineering team, reporting to the Development Engineering Manager. You will own our lab space, keeping it safe, tidy and well equipped, and support our engineers with hands-on build work for existing and next generation Metron3D products. You will work comfortably alongside electronics, mechanical and software engineers, and take pride in how the lab looks and runs. If your passion is making things and keeping a workspace working properly, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Keep every lab area clean, tidy and organised, applying 5S principles</li> <li>Be the day-to-day health and safety lead for the lab, covering risk assessments, COSHH, signage, incident reporting and safe waste disposal, and brief new starters and visitors on lab rules and safe working practice</li> <li>Monitor, order and restock materials, consumables, tools and PPE so teams never run short, and track tools and test equipment, coordinating calibration, PAT testing and servicing</li> <li>Work with the electronics, mechanical and other teams to set up, maintain and improve their working spaces</li> <li>Build cables and harnesses to drawing, including crimping, soldering and testing</li> <li>Build sub-assemblies, prototypes and test rigs for engineers, carry out simple machining, drilling, cutting, fitting and finishing, rework or repair as needed, and support applications, manufacturing and service with hands-on tasks</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>A technical qualification in engineering or similar, or a clear equivalent through an apprenticeship and hands-on technician experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience we’re looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>More than 5 years’ experience as a lab, workshop or production technician</li> <li>Hands-on cable and harness assembly, including crimping and soldering</li> <li>Confident use of hand tools and basic mechanical assembly</li> <li>Working knowledge of workplace health and safety practice</li> <li>An organised approach to stock, tools and housekeeping</li> <li>Fluent written and spoken English</li> <li>Able to work independently, setting priorities based on company goals and targets, and happy to support colleagues across all functions</li> <li>Takes ownership, spots problems early and acts on them, with pride in neat, accurate and well-documented work</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’d love to see:</strong></p> <ul> <li>IPC/WHMA-A-620 or J-STD-001 training or certification, or IOSH, first aid or fire marshal training</li> <li>Experience in ESD-controlled or cleanroom environments, or in a precision instrumentation or semiconductor-related business</li> <li>Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality systems and stock or ERP systems</li> </ul> <p></p> <div> <p><strong>A bit about us: </strong></p> <p>Infinitesima is a privately owned company founded in 2001, as a spin-out of the University of Bristol, by CTO Professor Andrew Humphris. Our dynamic team of scientists and engineers is focussed on enabling the next generation of semiconductor devices through delivery of innovative products to customers around the world. </p> <p>Our strength lies in the varied perspectives that come from different cultures, experiences, and identities. title: Electrical & Electronics Engineering Manager - Semiconductor Metrology
description: <p><strong>Lead Electrical & Electronics Engineering for Next-Generation Semiconductor Metrology</strong></p> <p><strong>£65,000 - £83,000 + EMI Share Options + Private Healthcare + 3x Death in Service + Hybrid Working</strong></p> <p>Would you enjoy leading the electrical and electronics engineering capability behind technology that is helping semiconductor manufacturers push the limits of what is physically possible?</p> <p>Infinitesima develops world-leading metrology solutions used by some of the most advanced semiconductor organisations in the world. Supported by Applied Ventures and backed by a growing global customer base, we're scaling rapidly and investing heavily in our engineering capability.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced Electrical & Electronics Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for the electrical systems, power distribution, electronics and signal acquisition at the heart of our products, along with the electrical safety and compliance of our platforms.</p> <p>This is a rare opportunity to combine:</p> <ul> <li>Technical leadership</li> <li>People leadership</li> <li>Semiconductor technology</li> <li>Electrical and electronics engineering</li> <li>Hands-on engineering</li> </ul> <p>You'll influence both engineering strategy and product direction while remaining close enough to the technology to solve complex technical challenges when needed.</p> <p><strong>Why Join Infinitesima?</strong></p> <p><strong>You'll be working on technology that matters</strong></p> <p>Our products enable the development of next-generation semiconductor devices, supporting advances in computing, communications, AI and high-performance electronics.</p> <p><strong>You'll have genuine influence</strong></p> <p>This is not a maintenance management role. high-performing electrical and electronics team</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coaching, mentoring and supporting engineers through regular development discussions</li> <li>Building technical capability and alignment with electrical and electronics priorities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Providing deep technical leadership on the hardest problems</strong></p> <ul> <li>Acting as the team's escalation point for working, including the practical adoption of AI and other emerging engineering tools</li> <li>Engaging with the competence management framework and advocating for improvements that strengthen the team's capability</li> </ul> <p><strong>Owning electrical safety and compliance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Taking responsibility for electrical cabinet design and power distribution across our assessments and supporting certification activities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Delivering robust electronics and measurement performance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Designing and reviewing electronics and power systems, with instrumentation and precision measurement forming part of the wider remit</li> <li>Ensuring signal integrity across complex electrical and electronics platforms</li> <li>Optimising power delivery, grounding and noise performance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Collaborating across engineering disciplines</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working closely with optics, controls, software, systems and mechanical engineering teams</li> <li>Supporting successful project delivery from concept through to production</li> <li>Driving technical decision-making across multidisciplinary programmes</li> development</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential Experience</strong></p> <p>Candidates new to a formal people management role are welcome to apply, provided they can demonstrate a strong track record of title: Manager Quality Assurance & Quality Engineering (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong>Mission Brief <br></strong></p> <p>As Manager Quality Assurance & Quality Engineering, you are accountable for translating the company quality strategy into effective governance, measurable objectives, and consistent execution across the organization. You will provide independent quality leadership, ensure customer and certification requirements are embedded into business processes, and maintain clear visibility of organizational quality performance.</p> <p>This role is not limited to maintaining procedures or reacting to non-conformances. It is about building a prevention-focused quality system, strengthening engineering and operational decision-making, and ensuring the organization remains ready for customer, regulatory, and certification scrutiny as products and production scale.</p> <p>Your Role in Our Space Mission: </p> <ul> <li>Implement and continuously develop the company quality strategy in alignment with business, product, and operational priorities.</li> <li>Lead the Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering function, establishing clear ownership, priorities, standards, and development plans.</li> <li>Define, deploy, and monitor quality objectives, KPIs, and improvement targets across the organization.</li> <li>Prepare and facilitate management reviews, ensuring quality performance, risks, trends, and required decisions are clearly presented and followed through.</li> <li>Own customer quality governance, including quality requirements, customer interfaces, escalations, reporting, and the coordination of customer quality reviews.</li> <li>Act as the primary quality interface to certification bodies and coordinate certification, surveillance, and recertification activities.</li> <li>Establish quality planning and assurance approaches for products, projects, processes, and organizational changes.</li> <li>Provide Quality Engineering leadership for risk prevention, including FMEA, control plans, process capability, measurement strategy, and verification planning.</li> <li>Govern non-conformance, corrective action, and preventive action processes, ensuring root causes are addressed and actions are effective.</li> <li>Drive cross-functional resolution of systemic quality issues and ensure lessons learned are translated into standards and preventive controls.</li> <li>Monitor organizational quality performance and provide transparent reporting to senior leadership on compliance, customer quality, product quality, and improvement priorities.</li> <li>Partner with Product Assurance, Supplier Quality, Production, Engineering, and the Chief Quality Inspector organization to ensure clear interfaces and end-to-end quality governance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualification Checklist </strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline.</li> <li>Significant experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Product Quality, or Quality Management within aerospace, space, defence, automotive, or another highly regulated engineering environment.</li> <li>Proven leadership experience managing quality teams and influencing cross-functional organizations.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of EN 9100 / AS9100, ISO 9001, and risk-based quality management principles; familiarity with ECSS requirements is advantageous.</li> <li>Experience working with customers, certification bodies, auditors, and senior management on quality performance and compliance topics.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of quality planning, FMEA, control plans, process capability, root cause analysis, corrective action, and structured problem-solving methods.</li> <li>Experience defining quality objectives, management review inputs, KPIs, and organizational quality performance reporting.</li> <li>Ability to balance independent assurance with pragmatic support for engineering and manufacturing execution.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management skills with the confidence to challenge decisions, escalate risks, and drive accountability.</li> <li>Clear, concise communication and professional proficiency in English; German language skills are advantageous.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Aim high, deliver relentlessly, act with integrity, and keep the mission first.</strong></p> <p><strong><span lang="EN-US">Benefits </span></strong></p> <ul> <li><span lang="EN-US"><strong>Employee Participation Program:</strong> Share in our success through our virtual company share program</span></li> <li><span lang="EN-US"><strong>30 days of vacation: </strong>Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge </span></li> <li><span lang="EN-US"><strong>Company pension plan:</strong> Secure your future with our company pension plan, featuring a 20% employer contribution after the probation period</span></li> <li><span lang="EN-US"><strong>Subsidised lunch:</strong> Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day</span></li> <li><strong>Flexible mobility budget</strong><span style="font-family: Calibri; font-size: 11pt;"><strong>: </strong>Travel your way with a choice between a fully financed Deutschlandticket, JobRad bicycle leasing, FINN JobAuto, or a fuel allowance</span></li> <li><span lang="EN-US"><strong>Rental clothing with laundry service:</strong> Enjoy hassle-free workwear with our convenient rental clothing and laundry service   </span></li> <li><span lang="EN-US"><strong>Sport Clubs membership:</strong> Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)</span></li> <li><span lang="EN-US"><strong>Individual learning allowance:</strong> Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period</span></li> <li><span lang="EN-US"><strong>Childcare allowance:</strong> Receive a childcare allowance for your non-school-age children</span></li> <li><span lang="EN-US"><strong>And Much More!</strong> Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team.         <br></span></li> </ul> <p><strong><span lang="EN-US">Who we are</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span lang="EN-US"><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/jW2V5vsMb_k" width="560" height="314"></iframe></span></strong></p> <p><span lang="EN-US">We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.</span></p> <p><span lang="EN-US">Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.</span></p> <p><span lang="EN-US">We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.</span></p> <p><span lang="EN-US">We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!</span></p> <p><span lang="EN-US">Want to find out more about us?</span></p> <p><span lang="EN-US">Visit </span><span lang="DE"><a href="http://www.isaraerospace.com/">www.isaraerospace.com</a></span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Data Protection<br></strong>We process your personal data for the purpose of managing the recruitment process and assessing your application. title: Director Quality and Continuous Improvement (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong>Mission Brief <br></strong></p> <p>Lead quality and continuous improvement across the business to deliver reliable products, successful missions and customer confidence. Establish independent assurance, a scalable QMS and a leadership culture in which quality is built into every function. Enable on-time vehicle delivery at the agreed cadence through capable processes, credible readiness evidence and sustained improvement.</p> <p>Your Role in Our Space Mission: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Customer quality. </strong>Own customer quality relationships, requirements, reviews, audits, complaints and escapes. Work with Mission Launch Operations as the internal customer for launch vehicles to define quality acceptance and handover evidence. Cascade requirements through Engineering, production, AIT and suppliers to raw materials; lead containment, corrective action and feedback.</li> <li><strong>Product assurance. </strong>Lead independent mission, project and design assurance from requirements through development, qualification, production and mission readiness. Establish assurance plans and gate evidence covering risks, traceability, interfaces, configuration, verification and validation. Challenge gaps and escalate unresolved risks to accountable decision-makers.</li> <li><strong>QMS and compliance. </strong>Own the QMS across all business functions, including process controls, records, audits, management review and corrective action. Use AS9100 as the aspirational framework with a proportionate maturity roadmap. Coordinate compliance assurance with Legal and specialist owners, ensuring applicable contractual, regulatory and certification obligations have accountable owners and evidence.</li> <li><strong>Supplier and operational quality. </strong>Lead quality assurance across suppliers, manufacturing, Propulsion AIT, Launch Vehicle AIT, engine testing and launch-pad AIT. Establish control plans, traceability and acceptance arrangements. Support current delivery and future product readiness, using AS9145 APQP as guidance.</li> <li><strong>Inspection requirements and quality at source. </strong>Through the Chief Inspector, define inspection requirements, techniques and acceptance evidence with Engineering. With Production Engineering and Operations, maximise poka-yoke, automated checks and real-time in-process verification to prevent defects and drive right first time (RFT), reducing reliance on offline inspection. Validate controls against technical requirements; ensure capable methods, calibrated equipment, competent personnel and traceable results, retaining required independent acceptance.</li> <li><strong>Problem solving and learning. </strong>Lead disciplined containment, root-cause analysis and corrective action for significant defects and escapes. Verify effectiveness, prevent recurrence and feed lessons from suppliers, builds, tests and missions into design and process improvements.</li> <li><strong>Lean management. </strong>Own the business-wide Lean methodology, standards, capability development and maturity assessment. Equip leaders to improve their own functions through daily management, visual performance, standard work and structured problem solving, supported by specialist coaching.</li> <li><strong>Continuous improvement. </strong>Govern a prioritised business-wide improvement portfolio aligned with customer outcomes, delivery, quality, lead time and cost. Coordinate cross-functional learning and verify sustained benefits with accountable leaders and Finance.</li> <li><strong>Digital thread and AI. </strong>Connect quality and assurance evidence across PLM, ERP, MES, test and mission readiness. Apply AI and automation to analysis, document review, reporting and workflows to improve departmental efficiency, with trusted data, appropriate access controls and accountable human review.</li> </ul> <h4>Authority and working relationships</h4> <ul> <li><strong>Chief Inspector. </strong>Reports directly to this role and leads inspection capability and technical practice. Set priorities and assure the suitability of inspection methods, equipment and competence; Engineering retains authority for technical requirements and acceptance criteria.</li> <li><strong>Independent quality authority. </strong>Authority to stop work, contain material or withhold quality acceptance where conformity or required evidence is inadequate. Define escalation and disposition routes and provide independent visibility of risks to executive leadership.</li> <li><strong>VP Spectrum Production. </strong>Owns production teams, resources and execution. The Production System / CI Leader reports to VP Spectrum Production with a functional link to this role for methodology, standards, coaching capability and maturity assessment. Manufacturing and AIT leaders own local improvement delivery and sustainment.</li> <li><strong>Director Spectrum Value Stream. </strong>Owns end-to-end industrial delivery, customer commitments and Spectrum-wide production system performance through Block 2 and Block 4 Leads. Agree quality readiness priorities and improvement outcomes; provide independent assurance and evidence without assuming vehicle schedule accountability.</li> <li><strong>Engineering and Programmes. </strong>Chief Engineers retain design authority and technical concession approval. Programme and mission leaders retain programme and mission decisions. Assure their processes and evidence, working with Production Engineering on process readiness, capability and design-for-manufacture feedback.</li> <li><strong>Mission Launch Operations. </strong>Agree quality handover criteria and assurance evidence, communicate product risks early and close readiness gaps with delivery owners. Campaign command and launch authorisation remain with designated leaders.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise Planning and functional owners. </strong>Align QMS controls with the business process architecture owned by Enterprise Planning and Transformation. Functions retain execution and compliance ownership; specialist teams retain their domain authority. Coordinate supplier quality with Procurement and local implementation with site leaders, including MD Sweden.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualification Checklist <br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Senior quality leadership in space, aerospace or another high-reliability business, including multiple sites, product development and production ramp-up.</li> <li>Strong experience in customer quality, mission/project/design assurance, supplier and operational quality, QMS, audits and corrective action. Working knowledge of AS9100 and APQP principles.</li> <li>Proven ability to deploy Lean through leaders, coach improvement capability and deliver sustained gains across technical, operational and support functions.</li> <li>Practical AI capability is required: demonstrable use of AI and automation to improve departmental efficiency, with measurable results. Experience with digital traceability and connected engineering and operational information.</li> <li>Relevant technical qualification or equivalent experience; clear judgement, constructive executive challenge and a record of building capable teams</li> </ul> <p>Aim radically high • Deliver, no excuses • Act with trust and integrity • Mission first, always</p> <p>Promote openness, early escalation and shared ownership of quality and improvement.</p> <p><strong><span lang="EN-US">Benefits </span></strong></p> <ul> <li><span lang="EN-US"><strong>Employee Participation Program:</strong> Share in title: Director Enterprise Planning and Transformation (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong>Mission Brief </strong></p> <p>Own the enterprise planning framework that translates company vision and strategy, through commercial growth and customer demand, into aligned product development and operational plans. Bring together Commercial, Engineering, Programmes, Operations and Finance to create one funded, resourced and governed business plan. Lead the transformation, process architecture and resilience needed to deliver it.</p> <p>Your Role in Our Space Mission: </p> <h4>Enterprise planning — primary accountability</h4> <ul> <li><strong>Vision and strategy into plans: </strong>Translate strategic objectives into a 3–5-year enterprise roadmap, annual business plan and rolling 36-month demand and delivery plan. Define planning assumptions, milestones, owners and dependencies across functions and sites.</li> <li><strong>Commercial demand and growth: </strong>Work with Commercial to translate customer needs, contracts, pipeline and growth opportunities into demand scenarios by product, configuration, launch date and site. Distinguish committed demand from probable and aspirational growth, making assumptions and confidence explicit.</li> <li><strong>Product development alignment: </strong>Integrate the product roadmap, development priorities, engineering resources, qualification and test campaigns, configuration changes and industrialisation milestones. description: <p>The Security Team of Scopely Explore (formerly known as Niantic) seeks a Senior Security Engineer to improve the security posture of our software development lifecycle, applications, and build infrastructure.</p> <p>Scopely Explore, known for global hits like Pokémon GO, Monster Hunter Now, and Pikmin Bloom is now part of Scopely, home to games like Monopoly GO!, Stumble Guys, and Star Trek Fleet Command. Together, we engage billions of players worldwide, and we need your expertise to keep them safe!</p> <p>Do you want to help secure one of the most widely used gaming platforms on the planet? We seek creative and dedicated engineers with excellent technical judgment, strong interpersonal skills, and an eagerness to embrace new technologies.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> launch.</li> <li>Provide guidance and expertise to product and operations teams across Scopely.</li> <li>Design, build and maintain automation and tooling that amplify the Security Team’s impact and in-house libraries, CI/CD systems, and cloud/container environments.</li> <li>Be responsible for third-party library reviews and manage vulnerability remediation.</li> <li>Educate engineers on secure customer-centric engineering culture and value pragmatic, scalable solutions. </li> <li>Can demonstrate hands-on experience or research in the area of AI security and safety. </li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Dan zoeken wij jou!</strong></p> <p><strong>Wie zijn wij?</strong> Bij WPP Media zijn we het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren en merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei te bieden. Dit fundament vinden we in onze gedeelde kernwaarden:</p> <ul> <li><strong>We’re Extraordinary:</strong> We verleggen grenzen en dagen het gewone denken uit.</li> <li><strong>We’re Open:</strong> We bouwen vertrouwen en begrip door naadloos samen te werken.</li> <li><strong>We’re Optimistic:</strong> Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA; we omarmen verandering.</li> </ul> <p>Ons Brand & Culture team is de drijvende kracht achter zowel onze externe merkidentiteit als onze interne cultuur en maatschappelijke impact. Je krijgt de unieke kans om te leren hoe we onze merkstrategie vertalen naar concrete acties én hoe we ons verhaal op een pakkende manier vertellen aan zowel interne als externe doelgroepen. Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren professionals en krijgt volop ruimte om je eigen ideeën in te brengen.</p> <p><strong>Wat ga jij doen?</strong> Als Stagiair(e) Brand & Culture ben jij een onmisbare schakel in ons team en help je mee om onze ambities waar te maken. Jouw missie is om ons te ondersteunen bij het versterken van de merkidentiteit van WPP Media en het creëren van impactvolle content. Je krijgt de kans om volop mee te werken aan diverse projecten en activiteiten, en er is ruimte voor jouw eigen initiatieven en ontwikkeling. Jouw takenpakket is veelzijdig en uitdagend:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Merkidentiteit & Cultuur:</strong> Je ondersteunt bij het bewaken en verder ontwikkelen van de merkidentiteit, tone of voice en visuele richtlijnen van WPP Media. Je draagt bij aan de doorvertaling van onze merkstrategie naar praktische initiatieven en versterkt onze interne bedrijfscultuur.</li> <li><strong>Content Creatie & Redactie:</strong> Je werkt actief mee aan de creatie van diverse content (tekst, beeld, video) voor verschillende kanalen. Denk hierbij aan social media posts, blogs, artikelen, whitepapers en communicatie voor interne activaties en evenementen.</li> <li><strong>Content Planning & Promotie:</strong> Je helpt bij het ontwikkelen van contentplannen en denkt mee over hoe we onze content effectief kunnen verspreiden via relevante kanalen. Je draagt bij aan het optimaliseren van content voor online vindbaarheid (SEO).</li> <li><strong>Evenementen & Projectondersteuning:</strong> Je helpt bij de organisatie van inspirerende interne evenementen (zoals borrels, workshops en collega-activiteiten) en andere projecten die onze cultuur versterken. Dit omvat ondersteuning bij projectmanagement taken, zoals planning, coördinatie met diverse interne en externe stakeholders en het bewaken van deadlines.</li> <li><strong>Social Impact:</strong> Je draagt bij aan projecten met maatschappelijke relevantie die aansluiten bij onze doelstellingen en een positieve impact maken.</li> <li><strong>Analyse & Optimalisatie:</strong> Je helpt met het analyseren van markttrends, concurrentie en de prestaties van onze communicatie-uitingen, en draagt bij aan inzichten voor continue verbetering.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wie ben jij?</strong> Jij bent een enthousiaste, open-minded en proactieve student(e) die gelooft in de kracht van verbinding. Adobe Creative Suite) is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wat bieden wij?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Een uitdagende en leerzame stageplek bij een toonaangevend, mondiaal mediabedrijf in het hart van de AI-revolutie.</li> <li>De mogelijkheid om een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan onze unieke bedrijfscultuur en maatschappelijke initiatieven.</li> <li>De kans om een With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p></p> <div>Die Rolle bietet dir die Möglichkeit, strategische Partnerschaften mit den führenden CTV-Vermarktern aktiv zu gestalten und auf Augenhöhe mit den wichtigsten Marktakteuren der Digitalbranche zu verhandeln. Dabei profitierst du von einem starken Netzwerk, einem hochprofessionellen Umfeld mit hervorragenden Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und einem erfahrenen Team, das echte Zusammenarbeit und Wissenstransfer lebt. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Associate Director treibst du Innovationen voran und entwickelst dich zum Spezialisten für Partner Investment auf höchstem Niveau.</div> <div> </div> <h2>Das bieten wir dir:</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Work-Life-Balance:</strong> Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.</li> <li><strong>Vacation mode on:</strong> Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.</li> <li><strong>Wellbeing first:</strong> Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.</li> <li><strong>Practice makes perfect: </strong>Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.</li> <li><strong>More than just a job:</strong> Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.</li> <li><strong>Be yourself:</strong> Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Das bewegst du:</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Partnerschaften eigenverantwortlich steuern:</strong> Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für ausgewählte Top-Marktpartner, baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf und bist deren zentraler Ansprechpartner.</li> <li><strong>Verhandlungsführung:</strong> Du bereitest Jahresverhandlungen aktiv vor und führst diese selbstständig, um marktführende Einkaufskonditionen und exzellente Rahmenverträge zu sichern.</li> <li><strong>Schnittstellen orchestrieren:</strong> Du übersetzt strategische Investmentziele in die Praxis und moderierst die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen.</li> <li><strong>Marktanalysen & Controlling:</strong> Du behältst die Performance deiner Partner fest im Blick, analysierst Marktentwicklungen und leitest daraus klare, kommerzielle Handlungsempfehlungen ab.</li> <li><strong>Vertrags-Compliance:‎</strong> Die sorgfältige Prüfung von Rahmenvereinbarungen und die Sicherstellung der korrekten vertraglichen Hinterlegung liegen in deiner Hand.</li> <li><strong>Finanzielle Steuerung:‎</strong> Die Erstellung präziser Prognosen, das Tracking von Umsätzen und die Durchführung von quartalsweisen Abgleichen mit Vermarktern.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Das zeichnet dich aus:</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Erfahrung im Digitalmarkt:</strong> Du bringst mindestens 4 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Digital- oder Medienumfeld mit (z. B. in Media-Agenturen oder der Vermarktung).</li> <li><strong>Verhandlungsstärke:</strong> Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung von Verhandlungen und besitzt ein ausgeprägtes kommerzielles und analytisches Gespür.</li> <li><strong>Tiefes Branchenwissen:</strong> Die digitale Medialandschaft (von Streaming, CTV, ATV und Programmatic) ist dein Zuhause.</li> <li><strong>Souveräner Gestalter:</strong> Du denkst unternehmerisch, handelst proaktiv und übernimmst mit Begeisterung die volle Ownership für deine Themen.</li> <li><strong>Kommunikationsprofi:</strong> Du überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten, sowie exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit verhandlungssicherem Deutsch und fließendem Englisch.</li> <li><strong>Analysevermögen: </strong>Du hast eine ausgeprägte Zahlenaffinität und bist sicher in der Analyse von Zahlen, Daten, Fakten und Ableitungen daraus inkl. der Darstellung dieser in Excel.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Darüber hinaus bist du:<strong> #innovativ #neugierig #kommunikativ</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p><strong>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</strong></p> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.<br> <br>WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.</p> <p>Bitte lies unsere <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">Datenschutzerklärung</a> für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz, um weitere Informationen darüber zu erhalten, wie wir die von dir bereitgestellten Daten verarbeiten. </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Sales Manager - French Market
description: About the role As Sales Manager for the French Market at Amenitiz, your primary objective is to ensure the day-to-day execution, coaching, and operational stability of a small, focused French sales team based in our new Lyon hub . You will be a hands-on manager - present in the detail, close to the numbers, and invested in each person's development. You are expected to make the team work: holding the cadence, removing blockers, running the pipeline, and making sure activity translates into results. We serve independent hoteliers across Europe: family hotels, boutique properties, and small chains that have long been underserved by technology designed for large chains. You will be leading people who sell something that genuinely makes a difference for hotel owners. This is a newly created role opening our first commercial hub in France. You won't start from a blank page: you'll inherit an existing customer base, pipeline, tools, sales methodology, and the full support of the wider commercial team in Barcelona. Your mission Build and grow the Lyon team: recruit, train, and manage a team of SDRs, BDRs, and AEs Run daily execution: manage pipeline health, call activity, and meeting volume across the team Coach in the detail: listen to calls, give real-time feedback, and identify patterns that slow conversion Hire and onboard: bring in the right profiles and get them productive quickly Hold performance: track individual KPIs at every level, have honest conversations early, and support people to improve Act as the link between the team and leadership: surface what is working, flag what is not, and translate direction into daily habits Drive pipeline generation through a mixed approach (roughly 80% outbound, 20% inbound), with a short sales cycle (typically 1-2 weeks, up to one month) Build a repeatable sales playbook to accelerate and scale the French market Maintain HubSpot hygiene: ensure the team logs accurately so pipeline data can be trusted Collaborate with Growth, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success, and align outreach quality with closing requirements between SDRs, BDRs, and AEs About you 3+ years of experience managing a sales team, ideally in a SaaS, tech, or B2B environment (independent businesses/SMEs) Native French speaker with strong written and verbal English (B1/B2 minimum) Confirmed skills in outbound prospecting (cold calling) and short sales-cycle selling Comfortable with HubSpot and Aircall (or similar tools) You are a coach first: you get energy from developing people, not from being the best seller in the room Strong organisational skills - you can manage a small team across multiple roles without losing track of the detail Comfortable in a performance-oriented environment where targets are clear and accountability is real Entrepreneurial, resilient, and autonomous, with genuine appetite for building a team "from scratch" Experience in hospitality tech, online travel, or B2B SaaS is an advantage Our offer Competitive OTE - base salary plus performance-based commission Stock options with a progressive vesting schedule Comprehensive health insurance 25 days of holidays from day one, rising to 28 after your first year and 30 after two years €10 a day for lunch through our virtual canteen, Kombo, every day you work from the office Flexible benefits - save on meals, childcare, transportation, and training with our tailored remuneration options On-demand salary access - no need to wait until the end of the month Any book, purchased for you, plus access to a shared team library An international team of 35+ nationalities based in one of Europe's leading tech hubs Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Venture Develoment Intern (d/f/m)
description: Our story: Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence. Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016. The opportunity At Taxfix, we have made tax filing simpler for millions of people. Now, we are looking to build our next major growth engine. We are looking for an entrepreneurial Venture Development Intern to join the Office of the COO . You will work directly with our Chief Operating Officer to explore, validate and build a new product proposition from the ground up. Think of this as a founder’s associate role for an internal startup: you will turn an ambiguous opportunity into actionable hypotheses, run experiments and help build the business case for launch. At Taxfix, AI is part of how we work and build—not just something we talk about. You will use AI tools hands-on to move faster from idea to evidence and from evidence to action. Duration: Fixed-term, full-time internship for a minimum of 3 months and up to 6 months. What you will do Discover and validate: Research markets and competitors, speak with potential customers and design experiments to test customer needs, demand and key assumptions. Build the business case: Develop pricing and unit-economics models, assess commercial viability and map the operational requirements for launch and scale. Turn ideas into tangible experiments: Use AI-native and no-code tools to create early prototypes, landing pages or other practical tests. Learn from the results and iterate with the COO and relevant teams. Shape the go-to-market plan: Explore positioning, distribution, regulatory considerations and how to build on Taxfix’s brand and capabilities. Communicate for decisions: Combine research, data and insights into clear recommendations, concise memos and presentations for the COO, Leadership Team and Board. Work AI-first and responsibly: Use approved AI tools to support research, analysis, prototyping and everyday workflows. Check outputs and sources critically, protect sensitive information and involve the right colleagues when needed. Academic collaboration If you are completing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, we encourage you to explore combining the internship with your thesis. Your work could inform real strategic decisions, with access to C-level perspectives and relevant company insights, subject to confidentiality and data-protection requirements. Who you are Entrepreneurial and hands-on: You are excited by building something from zero to one, comfortable with ambiguity and ready to take ownership rather than wait for a playbook. AI-native builder mindset: You are familiar with generative AI tools and use them—or are keen to use them—to research, analyze, prototype and automate. You enjoy turning ideas into tangible outputs; you do not need to be a software engineer. Critical thinker: You know that AI can accelerate your work but does not replace judgment. You question assumptions, verify outputs and can explain your reasoning. Structured and analytical: You can break down a broad question into hypotheses and practical workstreams. You are comfortable using Excel for analysis and modelling and PowerPoint to communicate a clear story. Curious and commercially minded: You enjoy understanding customers and connecting their needs to pricing, economics and a viable business model. Strong communicator: You can share ideas clearly and confidently with colleagues and senior stakeholders in German and English. Eager to learn: You are pursuing or have recently pursued a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in business or a related field, and are motivated to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment. What we offer C-level mentorship: Work closely with the COO and gain first-hand exposure to executive decision-making. Real ownership: Contribute to building a new proposition, not just supporting a predefined process. Accelerated learning: Gain experience across strategy, product, commercial, operations and venture building. A strong network: Collaborate with Taxfix leaders and connect with our network of founders and investors. An international environment: Join a dynamic team in Berlin with a flexible hybrid setup. If you are excited to combine structured thinking, AI tools and a founder’s mindset to help build what comes next at Taxfix, we would love to hear from you. Why Taxfix? A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals. Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible. Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions. Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office. Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture. At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves. Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: People Operations Specialist | French Market | (Paris)
description: Lexroom construit la plateforme d’IA sur laquelle s’effectue le travail juridique. En un peu plus de deux ans, nous sommes passés de zéro à 25 M€ d’ARR, et aujourd’hui plus de 20 000 professionnels du droit en Italie, en Espagne, en Allemagne, en France et en Bulgarie s’appuient sur Lexroom. Nous avons levé 73 M$ auprès de Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners et Eurazeo, et nous sommes une équipe d’environ 300 builders qui avancent vite, disent les choses franchement et assument chaque résultat. Notre prochain objectif ? Devenir le produit juridique le plus utilisé en Europe. Pourquoi Lexroom ? Définir les standards : rejoignez l’équipe qui fixe la référence de l’IA juridique en Europe. Travailler avec les meilleurs : collaborez avec des collègues d’exception, dans une culture qui valorise la compétence, la curiosité et l’ambition. Avoir un impact concret : votre travail influencera directement la manière dont les professionnels du droit exercent leur métier, plus rapidement, plus clairement et plus efficacement. Chez Lexroom, nous laissons les buzzwords de côté. Ici, vous construirez quelque chose de durable : une plateforme de confiance, une solide réputation et un nouveau standard pour le monde juridique. Le poste En tant que People Operations Specialist pour la France, vous serez l’interlocuteur de référence de nos équipes parisiennes. Vous prendrez en charge l’ensemble des aspects opérationnels de l’expérience collaborateur, du premier contrat à la paie mensuelle, en veillant à ce que tout fonctionne de manière fiable, conforme et fluide au fil de notre croissance. Lexroom connaît une expansion rapide à travers l’Europe, et la France est l’un de nos marchés stratégiques. Vous rejoindrez l’équipe People à un moment clé, pour construire les fondations sur lesquelles notre équipe française pourra se développer. Vos responsabilités Être le référent People en France : devenir l’interlocuteur RH de confiance de nos équipes parisiennes, répondre aux demandes avec réactivité et clarté, tout en sachant dire non lorsque c’est nécessaire. Gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vie des collaborateurs : des contrats à l’onboarding en passant par les avantages sociaux, garantir que chaque étape soit fiable, conforme et fluide. Assurer le bon fonctionnement des opérations : prendre en charge les éléments variables de paie et les données RH, en collaboration avec nos prestataires externes, pour une fiabilité irréprochable, mois après mois. Construire un cadre de conformité évolutif : travailler avec nos conseillers juridiques pour mettre en place les standards adaptés à la France, au rythme de la croissance de nos effectifs. Automatiser ce qui nous ralentit : utiliser l’IA, HiBob et les données pour réduire les tâches manuelles et construire les tableaux de bord qui aident l’équipe People à décider plus vite. Profil recherché 1 à 3 ans d’expérience en People Operations, HR Operations ou en tant que généraliste RH, avec une pratique concrète des contrats, de l’onboarding et de la paie. Votre potentiel et votre motivation comptent davantage que le nombre d’années d’expérience. De solides bases en droit du travail français : vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux de la législation sociale et avez déjà géré directement des contrats, des intégrations et des départs, idéalement avec une paie externalisée. À l’aise avec les données et l’IA : les SIRH n’ont pas de secret pour vous, et vous repérez instinctivement les tâches répétitives qui pourraient être automatisées. Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se) : vous savez gérer des échéances récurrentes, comme la paie mensuelle, sans rien laisser passer. Proactif(ve) et résilient(e) : vous anticipez les besoins et agissez avant qu’un collaborateur n’ait à se plaindre. Excellentes compétences en communication , à l’oral comme à l’écrit : français (langue maternelle) et anglais courant (C1 minimum). L’italien est un plus, sans être obligatoire. Atouts supplémentaires : une connaissance de HiBob ou d’outils RH et de paie similaires, ainsi qu’un intérêt pour le secteur juridique (aucune formation juridique requise). Perspectives d’évolution Ce poste repose sur la profondeur et la responsabilisation, pas sur une échelle hiérarchique. À mesure que notre équipe française grandit et que de nouveaux marchés s’ouvrent, votre périmètre évoluera avec elle. Vous contribuerez à définir la manière dont les People Operations fonctionnent sur un nouveau marché et travaillerez aux côtés d’un nouveau Head of People Operations. Vous développerez aussi une expertise très recherchée en paie, conformité et automatisation. Ce qui nous distingue Une équipe d’exception Chez Lexroom, vous travaillerez aux côtés des meilleurs talents de la tech et de l’IA juridique. Nos équipes agissent avec sens et autonomie, pour que chaque contribution produise des résultats visibles. Vous collaborerez avec des personnes qui allient innovation et rigueur, curiosité et discipline, ambition et profondeur. Une croissance qui compte Nous recrutons des personnes exceptionnelles pour faire la différence, et nous leur donnons l’espace pour mener. Votre travail façonnera l’avenir de la legal tech et fixera de nouveaux standards pour le secteur. L’impact se mesure à la vision et à l’exécution, pas à l’âge ni au titre. Si vous êtes prêt(e) à prendre des responsabilités, vous trouverez de vraies opportunités de grandir et de piloter des projets à fort enjeu. Valoriser votre contribution Nous valorisons l’excellence et partageons le succès : Rémunération : 30 000 – 45 000 € brut annuel Equity : alignez votre évolution sur le succès à long terme de l’entreprise. Des avantages qui comptent Travail hybride : un équilibre entre télétravail et collaboration en présentiel dans nos bureaux à Paris (quartier du Marais) Mutuelle Alan Titres-restaurant Accès Wellpass (sport et bien-être) Team retreats & off-sites : des moments dédiés pour se retrouver, collaborer et faire naître des idées audacieuses. Processus de recrutement Entretien avec l’un de nos Talent Acquisition (45 min) Entretien manager avec Riccardo, notre Head of People (60 min) Mise en situation via un cas concret (45 min) Entretien final de culture fit (30 min) Offre Chez Lexroom, l’ambition rencontre la discipline et le sens. Nous ne construisons pas seulement un produit : nous définissons un nouveau standard pour le monde juridique. Si vous êtes prêt(e) à contribuer à quelque chose de durable et porteur de sens, nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous. Compensation: €30K – €45K • Offers Equity • €30K – €45K • Offers Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Sovereign Cloud
description: Meet DeepL DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog . Meet the team behind this journey You will join the team building and operating DeepL for Sovereign Markets, our offering for public sector bodies and regulated organisations that need more than data residency. It is hosted and operated entirely within the EU, under EU jurisdiction, and runs alongside DeepL's global infrastructure. The team is designing the platform foundations that make that promise true in practice: how services are built, deployed, secured, observed and operated. The approach favours managed infrastructure and well designed software abstractions over bespoke low level plumbing. You will work closely with product, security and legal colleagues as the offering grows to cover more capabilities and features. Your responsibilities Build the platform as software: Design and build the platform layer of DeepL for Sovereign Markets as software: reusable services, abstractions and tooling that product engineers build on Own the architecture: Own the architecture of the managed infrastructure the platform runs on, including Kubernetes, networking, storage, identity and secrets, using provider managed services where they meet the requirement Standardise and automate: Define infrastructure as code and delivery standards that hold across teams, and automate operations so that manual work is the exception Make design decisions visible and reviewable: write and review architecture decision records, weigh positions on their merits and commit once a decision is made Build for reliability: Build observability, resilience testing and incident response practices so that the service meets its reliability commitments Adapt the product to the new environment: Make low invasive modifications to existing code in the product with confidence in order to make it run in the new environment Keep the environment auditable: Work with security and compliance colleagues to keep the environment auditable and aligned with the standards our customers require Raise the technical bar: Mentor engineers, raise the technical bar through design reviews, and build consensus across teams without relying on line authority Participation in our on-call rotation: You’ll ensure the reliability and availability of our services by being available to join the team's shared on-call rotation as needed Qualities we look for Software engineering depth: Strong software engineering skills in at least one major language, C#, Go or Python preferred, shown by tooling, services or platform abstractions that other engineers rely on Production infrastructure: Production experience designing and running managed infrastructure and Kubernetes, with sound judgement on when to use provider managed services and when not to Automation and delivery: Infrastructure as code with Terraform, Crossplane or equivalent, and GitOps delivery, applied to environments you have owned AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving A track record of technical ownership across several teams: you create clarity where a mandate crosses team boundaries, hold clear positions and change them on evidence Reliability discipline: observability, incident response and designing for failure, with experience carrying on-call Security fundamentals: Working knowledge of infrastructure security fundamentals, such as identity, secrets, network segmentation and supply chain hygiene Clear written communication: you can capture a decision so that others can build on it You’d get bonus points for Experience in regulated or audited environments, for example BSI C5, ISO 27001 or SOC2 Experience with EU based or sovereign cloud providers Chaos engineering and game day practice Building platforms for small teams through a high degree of automation What we offer Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network. Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together. Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration. Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future. Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally. Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity. 30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally. Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way. If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you! We are an equal opportunity employer You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.
