title: (Senior) Product Manager | Full Time (m/w/d)
description: Who Are We ? 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless. Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO. At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital. Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow. We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 💼 About This Role As a (Senior) Product Manager at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product. 🎖 What Success Looks Like In your first month You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects. You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities. You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed. You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work. By 3 months You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands. You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives. You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements. You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination. You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements. You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders. You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements. You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy. By 6 months You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation. You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams. You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement. You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation. You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed. You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed. You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams. 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field. You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in a SaaS environment. You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes. You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories. You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products. You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business. You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers. You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements. You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken. You are able to work from either our Munich or Nuremberg office at least 3 days per week. ⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools. You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools. You have experience working with CRM systems. 💡It’s a Plus If You Have Previous experience in the logistics industry. Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment. 🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us. Onboarding sessions with your manager and our Head of Product and Engineering Alex, to understand your role, goals, and priorities. Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business. HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes. Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür. A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions. Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured. We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly. 👥 About Our Team We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg – and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. title: Head of Data Protection (m/f/d)
description: At Quantum Systems, we develop advanced autonomous systems for defence and security across multiple domains, combining unmanned platforms with integrated software and AI. As Head of Data Protection, you will play a key role in building and strengthening Quantum Systems’ Group-wide Data Protection Management System (DPMS). You will develop the Group privacy framework and coordinate its implementation and continuous improvement across our international entities, translating legal and technical requirements into pragmatic processes and controls. This is a leadership role with responsibility for developing the Group privacy framework and coordinating its implementation across the Group. As part of the integrated Governance, Risk & Compliance organization, you will work across corporate functions, entity management, business process owners, external Data Protection Officers (DPOs) and local privacy coordinators. Entity management and business process owners retain their respective responsibilities for compliance and operational implementation. DPOs retain their independent advisory and monitoring functions. What is your Day to Day Mission: Develop and continuously enhance the Group privacy framework, translating GDPR and international privacy requirements into clear governance, responsibilities, processes and standards, and coordinate implementation with local entities. Coordinate the Group-wide implementation and continuous improvement of the DPMS, consolidating privacy risks, remediation actions and implementation evidence and tracking outstanding measures with the responsible owners. Support business functions in establishing practical privacy processes, including data subject rights and incident response, and assess technical and organizational measures, IT architectures, cloud services and international data flows in collaboration with IT and Information Security. Coordinate external DPOs and local privacy coordinators, working closely with entity management, business process owners, GRC, Legal, HR, IT and Information Security, and support engagement with regulators and auditors within the relevant responsibilities. Report material privacy risks, outstanding actions and implementation progress to Group management, providing clear, decision-relevant information while preserving management accountability and the independent advisory and monitoring functions of DPOs. What you bring to the team: Several years of relevant experience in data protection or privacy management, with proven experience establishing and implementing privacy management systems in international organizations. Strong legal expertise in GDPR and international privacy requirements; qualification as a lawyer and a recognized Data Protection Officer certification are highly desirable. Strong technical privacy competence, including the ability to assess technical and organizational measures, IT architectures, cloud services and international data flows in collaboration with IT and Information Security. Strong analytical and implementation capabilities, with a proven ability to translate complex legal and technical requirements into pragmatic, scalable processes, effective controls and documented implementation evidence. Strong project and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to coordinate cross-functional stakeholders without direct reporting lines and communicate clearly with business functions and senior management. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop, produce and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions designed for mission-critical operations in complex environments. Our systems combine autonomous platforms, advanced sensors, secure communications, mission software and AI to deliver actionable information, enable faster decision-making and support operations across domains – from the air to the ground and at sea. Headquartered in Gilching near Munich, with locations across Europe and worldwide, Quantum Systems develops its core technologies in-house. This integrated approach enables us to rapidly innovate, scale and deliver mission-ready solutions while strengthening European technological sovereignty. Quantum Systems operates in the global dual-use market, serving armed forces, security organizations, public institutions, and industrial and infrastructure customers. Our systems support a broad range of missions, including intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR), situational awareness, critical infrastructure protection and complex multi-domain operations. What sets us apart is the combination of hardware, software and AI within one integrated ecosystem - built to connect systems, data and operators across domains. Our mission is clear: Accelerate the world’s transition to unmanned systems for a better future. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: QA Engineer - Payments
description: <p>SumUp is already live in 38 markets and still growing. Our Global Expansion Team takes SumUp's payment products into new countries, with Mexico and Canada among our most recent launches and more markets like New Zealand and Argentina on the way. As a QA Engineer in our Berlin payments team, you'll build the automated and manual tests that decide when a new card reader can go live in a market, across frontend, backend and mobile flows, and you'll also help complete L3 certification (the final round of testing that acquiring banks and card networks require). It's hands-on engineering work with real launch impact, because your tests help new markets go live and recently launched ones stay stable, so small businesses there can take card payments with confidence.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build and maintain frontend and backend test automation, with mobile where relevant, and add targeted regression tests to continuous integration (CI) workflows so market specific checks run consistently after code changes</li> <li>Test SumUp products across markets, with a mix of automated and manual testing, functional, integration and regression checks, plus edge cases and recovery scenarios.</li> <li>Spot ways to improve how we test, explain why they matter and make a convincing case for the changes with the biggest payoff</li> <li>Trace failures through complex payment flows using logs and transaction traces, then raise clear, prioritised defects and work with engineers and external partners until they're fixed</li> <li>Own the testing of end-to-end communication between a payment terminal, software applications, and an acquiring network. with acquiring banks and card networks, and keep the team informed on certification status, quality risks and release readiness so launch decisions rest on evidence</li> <li>Work closely in collaboration with engineers, product and market-launch teams, as well as acquirers, card schemes and certification labs.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Programming or scripting skill to build and maintain automated tests for frontend web and backend APIs, and comfort reading code in languages such as Golang, Kotlin, Java or others on our <a href="https://www.sumup.com/en-us/how-we-work/the-sumup-tech-radar/">Tech Radar.</a></li> <li>Experience testing software both manually and with automation, including turning requirements into test scenarios and deciding what to automate first based on customer, launch and technical risk.</li> <li>Ability to analyse logs, transaction traces and test results, and to write defect reports that include reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, impact and evidence.</li> <li>Comfort working with Git and Jira (or similar tools)</li> <li>Experience with SQL and test-data setup, contract testing, mocking or service virtualisation.</li> <li>An engineering mindset: the ability to spot what can be improved, explain the reasoning and persuade others with clear evidence</li> <li>A curious, ownership minded approach: seeking out context when things are unclear and using AI tools where they help.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with Card payments, payment terminals, acquirers, card schemes or certification labs.</li> <li>Market launches, device integrations, external technical partners or business-to-business communication.</li> </ul> <p>Payments experience is helpful but not required. We'll support you in learning card payments, devices and the certification process.</p> <h3><strong>Why you should join SumUp</strong></h3> <ul> <li>🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first set up</li> <li>🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced</li> <li>🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success</li> <li>📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education</li> <li>💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions</li> <li>🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days</li> <li>🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches</li> <li>🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service</li> <li>🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Engineer, Cloudforce One
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>London, UK</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world’s largest global networks can provide. The team is able to analyze these unique data points, at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <p>You will join the data science team within Cloudforce One. We power much of the insight and intelligence delivered in Cloudflare’s <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/security-center/cloudforce-one/#analyze-threat-events">Threat Events</a> product, which customers can use to better protect themselves — for example, by <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/realtime-threat-intel-waf-rules/">turning our threat indicators into real-time WAF rules</a>. We own data pipelines that power analysis of Cloudflare’s DDoS and WAF data, including Cloudflare’s quarterly <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/ddos-threat-report-2026-q3/">DDoS Threat Report</a>. We also support internal Trust & Safety initiatives such as identifying and addressing network abuse, and collaborate directly with the Threat Intelligence team.</p> <p>As a Data Engineer, you will build the data foundation that makes this possible: designing and operating the scalable pipelines, analytical data stores, and data marts that turn raw Cloudflare telemetry into trusted, well-modeled datasets for threat researchers, data scientists, analysts, and customers.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate scalable batch data pipelines on Kubernetes-hosted Airflow and Spark clusters that extract, enrich, and publish threat and abuse signals from Cloudflare’s network and platform telemetry.</li> <li>Build and evolve our data stores in Apache Iceberg (R2) and the curated data marts that serve Threat Events, Trust & Safety initiatives, and Threat Intelligence investigations.</li> <li>Model datasets deliberately — choosing grain, partitioning, and schema evolution strategies that keep data correct, queryable, and cost-efficient.</li> <li>Write and optimize SQL against large-scale analytical data in ClickHouse, balancing completeness, performance, and cost.</li> <li>Make pipelines safe to retry, resume, and backfill, so downstream consumers receive exactly the data we intend to publish.</li> <li>Build data quality checks, reconciliation, and monitoring that catch problems before they reach analysts, detections, or customers.</li> <li>Treat privacy and data minimization as design requirements from the start.</li> <li>Enable Threat Intelligence and Trust & Safety partners with the data they need for tooling and investigations, translating ad hoc requests into reusable datasets.</li> <li>Partner with data scientists to turn exploratory analysis into repeatable, production-quality data products and ML-ready datasets.</li> <li>Raise the team’s engineering bar through code review, testing, CI/CD, and documentation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating scalable production data pipelines.</li> <li>Proven experience building analytical data stores and data marts, including data modeling, partitioning, and schema evolution.</li> <li>Strong Python for data engineering, including testing and maintainable, well-structured code.</li> <li>Strong SQL, including window functions, query optimization, and performance tuning on large datasets.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow in production, including Kubernetes-hosted deployments.</li> <li>Experience with distributed data processing (e.g. Spark or similar) at large scale.</li> <li>Experience with Apache Iceberg (or a comparable open table format) on object storage such as R2 or S3.</li> <li>Experience with ClickHouse or a comparable columnar analytical database.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD, version control, and containerized deployments.</li> <li>Clear communication and the ability to turn ambiguous requirements from researchers and analysts into well-defined data products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with security, threat intelligence, fraud, or trust & safety / abuse data.</li> <li>Solid understanding of how the Internet works (DNS, HTTP, TLS, BGP).</li> <li>Experience supporting data science or ML workflows (feature stores, training datasets).</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, R2, R2 Data Catalog).</li> <li>Trino/Presto or other distributed query engines.</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of your workflow.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span s

title: Account Executive, Mid-Market - DACH
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 10k to € 300k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place. Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis). You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting : The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You are a life-long learner : Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your customers : The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best : Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role you will: Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline. Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer. Minimum Requirements for the role: Winning DNA: Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch. Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt Native German language speakers Advantageous: Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain. A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results. A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy. Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here . title: Legal Counsel - Commercial and AI
description: About H: Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement , both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move. H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents , fully managed agents that take actions on computers. What you own Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA . What you'd be doing Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers. Working through the other side's mark-up. Our general terms cap our liability on paid services at the higher of €100 or the previous 12 months' fees, for example. When a customer's lawyers push on it, you'd work out where we hold. Then you'd make the argument. Turning new products and new AI law into contract changes and negotiation guidance. What we ship includes open-weight models: Holo3-35B-A3B is on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. Answering engineers and business teams on how to deploy AI within the rules. Customers can see on our Trust Center that we hold ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, and which subprocessors we use. When needed, questions outside contracts: employment, corporate or competition law. Who you'd work with Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, is hiring for this role. You'd join our Legal team and work closely with engineers and business teams. What we think it takes Likely a good fit if you Hold a master's in law and are admitted to the bar. Have a minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant legal experience. Know data protection law well (GDPR and the rules around it), along with IP, contract law and liability, and regulatory compliance. Have worked somewhere that was growing fast. Can explain a legal position plainly to an engineer. Work well on your own and adapt when plans change. An international outlook matters here too. Stronger still if you built that experience negotiating contracts at a tech or AI company. You do not need to have worked at an AI company before. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway. How we hire Three conversations. First a 30 minute call with our Talent team, then 30 minutes with Julie, and last a conversation with a member of our leadership team. title: People & Workplace Manager
description: About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. The Role Davis is in a phase of strong acceleration . The team grows every month, our client base is widening and we are expanding in the US and in the Middle East. Our founders spend their days with developers, investors, partners and candidates, and every hour they lose to logistics is an hour taken from the company. Your job is to make sure that does not happen. The role sits at the centre of the company and has two sides. On the people and workplace side , you work with our Chief of Staff and own the employee journey, our team rituals and our offices, in Paris and in the new ones we open abroad. On the executive side , you work directly with our co-founders, from their calendars to their board meetings. You are the first point of contact for the team and for everyone who walks through our door. What you will be working on: Own the employee journey Owning the onboarding experience end to end, from equipment and access to the first few weeks, so new joiners can contribute from day one. Handling offboarding with the same care, along with the HR admin that comes with each arrival and departure. Being the first point of contact for the team's everyday questions and needs . Build culture and community Running and improving our team rituals , from team lunches and drinks to company gatherings. Organising our offsites and our presence at industry events . Creating moments that help people connect and celebrate progress , across offices and time zones. Listening to the team and turning feedback into concrete improvements . Shape our workplaces Running our Paris office end to end, from vendors and supplies to welcoming the clients and investors who visit us. Leading the opening of our new offices abroad over the coming months, from finding the right space to making it work for the team. Managing workplace vendors, contracts and budget , and handling invoices and expense reports . Support the founders Owning the founders' complex, multi-time-zone calendars and travel logistics , and protecting their time for the work that moves Davis forward. Preparing their key meetings with clients, investors and the board, and making sure every follow-up gets done. What We Are Looking For You have 1 to 3 years of experience in a fast-growing startup . You are fluent in French and in English . You have warmth and empathy , and a genuine interest in helping people feel good and work better. You anticipate needs before they are voiced, and once you start something, you see it through. You are at ease switching from a travel booking to an office issue to a board meeting in the same morning. You are rigorous with admin , and you have already handled invoices, expenses or onboarding. You are very comfortable using AI , and you learn fast . Nice to have Experience opening or setting up an office, ideally abroad. Experience in people operations in an international company. Event organisation, from offsites and team events to trade shows. Experience working directly with a CEO or founder. Familiarity with modern finance and HR tools (accounting, payroll, applicant tracking). An interest in real estate, architecture or AI. Why Join Davis Shape the Davis experience for every person who joins, at a moment the team grows every month. Open our offices abroad , and build how Davis works across countries. Work directly with the founders , in a seat that sees every part of the company. Grow with the company , as the role expands with Davis. Competitive salary and benefits , including meal vouchers, health insurance and a sports membership. A world-class team of AI researchers, engineers, architects and real estate experts, backed by world-class VCs. More About Davis The Team Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. Today our team brings together technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA, architects and deep real estate expertise, and it grows every month. We are small with an extremely high bar , and we intend to keep it that way. Why We Will Win Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work , AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié. Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours. Ce que vous ferez Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec une équipe d’ingénieurs logiciels sur l’expansion belge de notre domaine Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL), l’un des domaines produit centraux de la plateforme Kaluza. Il gère les informations sur les clients, les comptes et les contrats, et porte les parcours client associés (par exemple un déménagement ou un changement de contrat). C’est un domaine full stack : une interface pour les conseillers du service client, des API qui exposent les données et des services backend qui portent les bases de données et la logique de workflow. Vous travaillez donc sur l’ensemble du domaine produit. Ce n’est pas un poste de product owner : vous portez des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, du dialogue avec les clients et les utilisateurs jusqu’à la livraison du logiciel, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe et la discovery. Des déplacements ponctuels en Belgique sont possibles (environ deux par trimestre). Traduire les exigences du marché belge en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché belge de l’énergie en exigences produit précises. Cette proximité vous aide à orienter ce que CAL construira ensuite. Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel, en interrogeant les données, en explorant les schémas d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez l’IA (par exemple Claude Code) chaque jour comme un multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer, pas seulement pour rédiger des documents. Aligner les équipes globales et locales sur toutes les fonctions : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, le QA et d’autres équipes, avec une influence full stack, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe (priorités, cérémonies, réunions), pour que chacun vise les bons résultats. Vous faites le lien entre les équipes globales et locales pour nourrir les priorités et la stratégie. Ce que vous apportez Idéalement, vous avez ou vous êtes : Une expérience avérée de Product Manager , de Business Analyst ou d’un rôle équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un parcours réussi de localisation de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux. Un français courant et un anglais professionel : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, et vous passez facilement de l’une à l’autre langue. De l’aisance en direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les profils seniors alignés et impliqués. Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard et concret, vous êtes à l’aise pour construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt que d’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les données et les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous savez prototyper avec les outils d’IA modernes. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur, mais vous pensez comme tel et vous tenez votre place dans une conversation technique. Vous raisonnez aussi bien sur un modèle de données que sur ce que l’utilisateur final voit à l’écran. Une communication claire et incisive, et l’habitude du travail transverse : vous savez aller à l’essentiel et expliquer la complexité technique et marché à des publics variés, clients compris. Vous collaborez avec l’ingénierie, le QA, le BA, le programme, le delivery, etc., pour livrer des solutions localisées. La maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et l’idéation jusqu’à la livraison et l’itération. Nos valeurs Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza : Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle. Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets. Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole. Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego. Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue. Nos avantages Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage) Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 € Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + 1 jour pour votre anniversaire + jours fériés + jours de RTT (11), congés « Moments That Matter », congé pour événement familial, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et éligibilité à un congé sabbatique (Career Break) Venez comme vous êtes Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre careers page et sur LinkedIn. Exceptional ability to translate abstract regulatory text or client requirements into clear, actionable, outcome-driven requirements for development teams. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, legal, operations, client success) to deliver localised solutions. Excellent stakeholder and client management skills , able to lead conversations across requirements, scope, expectations, and roadmap alignment, and communicate technical & market complexity clearly to varied audiences. Proficiency in AI tools throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.Fluent in French and English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both. A builder's mindset — you're autonomous, learn fast, and aren't afraid to go deep. Comfortable with ambiguity and pace — you can operate effectively when not everything is defined, know when to make a call, and aren't afraid to escalate or ask for help when it matters. title: Automation Engineer – Magnet Industrialisation
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. TEAM & ROLE Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
description: hbo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden? Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG). Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen. Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid. Je onderzoekt onder andere: Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties? Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG? Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen? Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed en de woningmarkt. We maken statistieken over (bouw)vergunningen, ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad, (gemiddelde) WOZ-waardes, eigendomsverhoudingen, tijdelijke woningen, woningtransformaties en nog heel veel meer. We doen statistisch onderzoek op verzoek van organisaties in de publieke sector. En we beheren en verwerken data voor CBS-collega’s en werken samen met diverse organisaties, waaronder het Kadaster, de ministeries van BZK, VRO en EZK en Eurostat. We publiceren regelmatig over de dynamiek van de Nederlandse vastgoed- en woningmarkt. Onze nieuwsberichten halen regelmatig journaals, nieuwssites en voorpagina’s van landelijke dagbladen. En daar zijn we trots op! Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een hbo opleiding in de studierichting toegepaste wiskunde, data science of sociale wetenschappen. Je hebt affiniteit met de woningmarkt. Je hebt kennis en wellicht ervaring met R/rmarkdown en/of Python en SQL databases. Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om met data aan de slag te gaan. Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te ontdekken, neemt graag initiatief en denkt actief mee. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook graag de samenwerking op. Je deelt gemakkelijk je ideeën en bevindingen en staat open voor nieuwe inzichten en feedback. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: samenwerkt met ervaren experts binnen hun vakgebied; gaat werken met grote databases (SQL); kennis opbouwt van de BAG en het registratieproces bij bronhouders; analyses samenvat in data visualisaties en overzichtelijke tabellen. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (with Ed-Tech experience)
description: Are you passionate about transforming how large organizations learn and develop? About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world's market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, including companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. We strive to provide the world's best courses and excellent support to our customers, while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. As a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility, with countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and to craft your own role. Role and Responsibilities As a Senior Customer Success Manager (with Ed-tech experience) , you enable AIHR's largest B2B clients to run successful learning initiatives and build a culture of learning. At AIHR, we call this role Learning Consultant rather than Customer Success Manager, because your focus goes beyond account management. You act as a strategic advisor, guiding customers in designing and implementing learning journeys that drive measurable impact. You own a dedicated portfolio of our largest and most complex enterprise customers, from onboarding to adoption, all the way to renewal. What does that look like in practice? Strategic partnership: You build strong, multi-level relationships with senior stakeholders (CHROs, VPs and Heads of HR, Heads of L&D) and make sure AIHR stays aligned with their business objectives. Joint Impact Plans: You diagnose customer needs and co-create a Joint Impact Plan that connects our learning solutions to their business goals, with clear metrics to show return on investment (ROI). Enterprise onboarding and adoption: You onboard large customers and design the change management and communication strategy that embeds the AIHR platform in their learning culture. Portfolio health: You take full ownership of your portfolio's health. You use the Customer Health Score in HubSpot to spot risks early and act before they turn into churn. Commercial partnership: You co-own commercial goals with our Growth Account Executives. Your deep customer knowledge shapes the renewal and expansion strategy for your accounts. Team excellence: You mentor other Learning Consultants and help develop the team's best practices and playbooks. You are successful when your clients' learners show improved work performance, not just when they complete a program, and when AIHR's impact makes them want to grow the partnership. Ultimately, your client's success is your success. Your goal is to develop their learners into T-shaped HR professionals . On a typical day You arrive at our beautiful office in Rotterdam or Amsterdam, grab a coffee, and after a quick chat with colleagues, you fire up your MacBook to check your calendar. You start by reviewing your portfolio in HubSpot, our single source of truth, paying close attention to the Customer Health Score to prioritize your actions for the day. Your morning starts with a Quarterly Strategic Check-in with the VP of HR at one of your key accounts. You present a clear story of their progress and ROI, using learning and engagement data you analyzed with the help of an AI skill. Afterward, you have a 1-1 with your manager, Emilie , to build a multithreading strategy for an account where you only have one champion. Later, you spend time with Dieter, one of our superstar SMEs, to plan a thought leadership session for your customer's HR leadership team. After a delicious lunch in the office with the team, you dedicate time to a new enterprise client, Ahold Delhaize, documenting their business objectives to build their Joint Impact Plan and rollout communication strategy. You then join Jessica, our Growth Account Executive, to align on the commercial strategy for an upcoming multi-year renewal, so you show up as one team. Next, you sit down with a newer Learning Consultant to prepare a difficult conversation with one of their customers. Before the day ends, you contribute to an internal project, sharing customer feedback about new features and improvements with the product team, including insights you summarized by feeding call transcripts into Gemini. To wrap up the week, you join the team for a drink during our weekly activity, celebrating joint successes and getting to know new colleagues. Who you are Helping large clients roll out complex learning initiatives is nothing new for you. You've done it many times, and you know your value goes further. You are the strategic advisor senior HR leaders call first, because you know that when they experience impact with AIHR, they see real skill development, better performance, and a lasting change in their learning culture. Furthermore, you have: 7+ years of experience in a client-facing role, such as a (Learning) Consultant, L&D Professional, or Customer Success Manager, specifically within the Ed-Tech or E-learning industry; A proven track record of managing a portfolio of large, complex enterprise accounts and prioritizing to maximize impact; Demonstrable experience building and maintaining relationships with multiple senior stakeholders at the same account (multithreading), up to C-level; Strong English proficiency, with the ability to discuss proposals, write clear copy, and push back on or challenge senior customers constructively; A natural ability to ask insightful follow-up questions to diagnose core challenges and co-create solutions with clients; Expertise in adult learning principles, change management, and designing effective L&D strategies for large organizations; The ability to think commercially, identify growth opportunities, and connect HR initiatives to overall business performance and ROI; Strong skills in using data from tools like HubSpot and Excel to derive insights and present a clear story of progress and value to executives; Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) for tasks like analysis, content creation, and workflow automation. This is essential; A genuine desire to help develop colleagues and raise the capabilities of the whole team. To set you up for success in this role, we are specifically looking for candidates with external-facing customer experience (not in-house L&D roles) and a background in education, e-learning, or ed-tech. We believe many skills can be learned on the job, but these experiences are essential. They provide the foundation you need to drive impact in our environment. title: Security Engineer
description: About Unblu Unblu helps the world's leading banks and insurance companies deliver conversational finance solutions. You'll own a mix of defensive operations and developer-facing security tooling, from WAF rule management and CVE triage to building the pipelines that keep our deployments safe by default. This role sits at the intersection of application security, platform security and operations. You'll partner closely with engineering to ship secure software, and with SRE when things need to be hardened or investigated. We run entirely in the cloud, with a strong focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You'll report to our VP SRE. An on-call rotation shared with SRE may be part of this role; we'll finalize expectations with the successful candidate. Responsibilities Embed security practices throughout the software development lifecycle, from design review to production monitoring, working hands-on with engineering teams Build, maintain and evolve the security tooling in our GitLab CI/CD pipelines: SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secret detection and container scanning Review Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) for our applications, track supply chain risk and drive remediation of issues in third-party components Own CVE triage end to end: assess relevance, prioritize based on exposure and exploitability, and coordinate remediation with product teams Manage and tune our Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules, balancing strong protection against false-positive noise Run internal security audits, document findings clearly and work with teams to close gaps Coordinate our annual external penetration test end to end; review pen test reports commissioned by our customers, translate findings into actionable work and respond back to the customer Lead the technical investigation, containment and recovery of security incidents together with SRE Provide technical evidence for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits, DORA resilience testing and customer security questionnaires, together with our Compliance Manager Help run or grow our external bug bounty program (optional scope): triage reports, coordinate with researchers and drive fixes through engineering Requirements Practical, hands-on security experience in a SOC, incident response or security engineering context, where you've done the work, not just written policy A degree, recognized certification (OSCP, CISSP, GIAC or equivalent) or structured training in information security Comfortable working across the entire software lifecycle, shifting between developer collaboration, operations and governance Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally in GitLab CI Familiarity with vulnerability scanners, SBOM tools (Syft, Grype, Trivy, Dependency-Track or similar) and WAF platforms (Cloud Armor, Cloudflare or similar) Working knowledge of GCP security primitives (IAM, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, Secret Manager, Binary Authorization, Security Command Center); comparable experience in another major cloud is fine if you're ready to go deep on GCP A clear communicator who can explain risk to engineers in terms they'll act on, and present confidently to customer security teams and auditors Fluent in English; German or French is a plus Benefits An interesting and rewarding role in the Sales team in the world's leading live collaboration software manufacturer Direct reporting line to the VP SRE Work in a diverse environment: 30+ nationalities across 8 locations Competitive salary, 5-week holiday, and great referral bonuses Flexible working hours and a hybrid working environment Our office in Basel is next to the main railway station #LI-Hybrid Make sure to have a look at our Glassdoor page too - it will give you more insights into what it is like to work for us. title: Executive Assistant to the CEO (Tech & Strategic Projects)
description: At Vicoland, we give the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies, in short: “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). Enabled through our unique AI-driven SaaS platform, Vicos allow freelance experts to team up and act like a real company, competing successfully for large enterprise projects. Our Vicos are already transforming how professional services projects are done. Since our launch 1.5 years ago, Vicos won projects from large corporate clients such as Mercedes-Benz, Netflix, or the German Federal Government, as well as from many mid-sized businesses. Vicoland was mentioned by Forbes and Forrester as a leading force in the market. Our SaaS platform is an integrated solution of marketing, organizational, legal and financial tech. It includes a marketplace that matches clients and Vicos. It is integrated into the world’s leading procurement software provided by one of our partners, SAP. There are already 100+ Vicos on our platform, uniting thousands of freelancers. Our central team has 40 members and is located across Europe, expanding to the US. Our headquarters are in Frankfurt/Main. Our offer to you You’ll be the CEO’s tech-savvy right hand for AI-centric strategic projects with measurable business impact. From day one, you’ll scope, launch, and deliver cross-functional initiatives aimed at shaping strategy, building operating muscle, and turning ideas into shipped outcomes. You’ll work directly with the CEO and collaborate closely with Product, Software Development, and Partnerships team members. We operate hybrid: regular on-site collaboration in Frankfurt am Main with the CEO (e.g., on key project days) while retaining flexibility to work remotely or from one of our offices (Frankfurt, Walldorf, Barcelona, Seville). Clear career perspectives into Strategy & Partnerships, Product, or Operations leadership as you prove impact. Tasks Drive CEO special projects end-to-end: define problem statements, scope work, set milestones, coordinate stakeholders & team members, and deliver measurable outcomes. Establish AI-first workflows (e.g., agentic automations, data pipelines) together with Product/Software Development to improve Vico operations and our platform. Pilot and operationalize the “AI agent” role inside Vicos; document learnings and scale playbooks. Support partnerships exploration: research targets, prepare outreach materials, analyze strategic fit, and help bootstrap pilot collaborations. Prepare crisp analyses and decision memos for the CEO (market scans, business cases, OKRs) and track execution against company priorities. Orchestrate cross-functional sprints that translate strategy into product/operations changes; ensure risks, dependencies, and comms are managed. Build dashboards to monitor KPIs for your projects; communicate business impact, pull insights and propose next steps and follow-up projects. Requirements Entrepreneurship – we’re growing fast, and so will you. You must be a fast learner and keen to work on new challenges every day. University degree with very good results. Professional experience requiring top qualities, be it via a first employment, own entrepreneurial initiative or internships is a plus. Ideally, this experience is in professional services (e. g. consulting, legal, finance) and somehow related to technology, including AI. Experience with intensive usage of AI tools and interest in the evolution of AI. Excellent communication skills – you will have to interact with a lot of people daily. You easily pick up the phone and talk to someone. Strong team spirit and capability to interact internally and externally with different people spanning the tech, sales, services and financial spheres. Excellent German and English (DACH is still our home market, while we expand abroad). Benefits CEO mentorship + strategic project ownership: an intense learning environment that pairs fast skill growth with real operating experience; a springboard to quickly take on more responsibility as we scale. Entrepreneurial key position in industry-transforming company with impact on company results, on the market, and on your own personal growth trajectory. Fast-paced environment where you are appreciated for your capabilities and, at the same time, will keep learning (as all of us). Competitive compensation plus share in company (ESOP in place). Working with a highly talented team of diverse backgrounds and top-notch qualifications. Possibility to work from where you want, remotely and/or in one of our offices (Frankfurt, Walldorf, Barcelona, Seville). Did we spark your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you soon! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das auf eine stolze Vergangenheit zurückblickt und gemeinsam mit dir eine innovative Zukunft gestalten möchte. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!
