title: Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – AI & Digital Natives (East)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: NYC, Boston, Atlanta, Miami OR Carolinas</strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare's North America Startups segment is growing its U.S. East go-to-market team. The goal is to win the fastest-growing AI-native and digital native companies early and grow with them as they scale. A new generation of companies is building AI models, agents, AI apps and developer tools, and many of them can go from seed funding to global scale in under two years. Cloudflare wants to be the platform they build, run and secure on from their first line of code through their IPO.</p> <p>As the Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – East, you will lead the managers and Account Executives (AEs) covering venture-backed AI and digital native companies across the eastern U.S., including New York, Boston, the DC area, Atlanta and Miami. You'll own revenue, hiring and Cloudflare's reputation in the East Coast startup and venture community, while keeping the Cloudflare culture. This role suits builders who like speed, technical buyers and the challenge of turning fast usage growth into lasting, multi-million-dollar customer relationships.</p> <p>You'll set strategy for the region and lead a team that sells to founders, CTOs and heads of engineering and infrastructure. Your team will:</p> <ul> <li>Move fast deals forward without losing sight of the long-term account</li> <li>Turn companies already on Cloudflare's free and pay-as-you-go plans into committed contracts</li> <li>Work with Product, Developer Speedboat, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and the Cloudflare for Startups program to make Cloudflare the default choice for AI-native builders</li> </ul> <p>Success means startups that love Cloudflare and recommend it, have grown alongside us from early stage to scale, and run their most important workloads on our Developer Platform, AI products, application security and network.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Drive revenue growth</strong> across new customers, expansion and conversion of pay-as-you-go accounts to contracts. Build a sales motion where usage growth opens the door to the next use case.</li> <li><strong>Lead a team of Regional Sales Directors</strong> and their Startup Account Executives. Also lead indirectly, the Solutions Engineers, Business Development Reps, Customer Success and Field Marketing teams who support startup accounts.</li> <li><strong>Build the East Coast startup sales team.</strong> Work with your Ecosystem and Recruiting to hire people who are technical, sharp about the business and comfortable talking with founders and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Spot breakout companies early.</strong> Use funding rounds, usage data, hiring and developer adoption signals to find likely winners, then win them before they lock into AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel or other platforms.</li> <li><strong>Make venture investors a growth channel.</strong> Build relationships with VC firms, accelerators and startup programs across the East Coast, working with the Cloudflare for Startups and Workers Launchpad teams to bring in companies at the earliest stages.</li> <li><strong>Help shape the product roadmap.</strong> Bring what AI-native customers need back to Product and Engineering, and run design-partner relationships with leading startups that influence what Cloudflare builds next.</li> <li><strong>Adapt our sales process for startups.</strong> Use and influence Cloudflare's sales methodology for faster deals with technical buyers. Bring discipline to forecasting usage-based revenue, contracts sized for growth and expansion planning.</li> <li><strong>Balance short-term and long-term revenue.</strong> Close fast deals while also building multi-year relationships with companies expected to become tomorrow's large enterprise customers. Work with Enterprise leaders on clean handoffs when accounts move to that segment.</li> <li><strong>Represent Cloudflare in the East Coast startup scene</strong> at founder events, AI meetups, investor portfolio sessions and developer communities.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring</h2> <ul> <li>12+ years of sales experience, including 3+ years managing managers (second-line leadership), with a track record of beating targets in a high-growth segment</li> <li>Experience selling cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, application security or data and AI infrastructure to startups, digital natives or high-growth tech companies</li> <li>Proven success in usage-based businesses, including converting product-led or pay-as-you-go customers to committed contracts and expanding from there</li> <li>Credibility with technical buyers: comfortable at the whiteboard with CTOs and founders talking about how their AI systems are built, latency, how they scale and what it costs per request or token</li> <li>Strong ties to the East Coast venture and startup community</li> <li>A history of hiring and developing great AE managers and AEs, and building a team people want to join</li> <li>Disciplined forecasting and pipeline management in fast-moving, high-volume deal environments</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build processes, programs and playbooks where none exist</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,1,0">For New York City and Boston based hires: Estimated annual salary of $418,000 - $575,000 OTE</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? You’re not afraid to ask for help or proactively reach out to others across the company to get answers.</li> <li><strong>Availability:</strong> Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship, with 3-5 days in office.</li> <li><strong>Understands the value of communications:</strong> Recognizes how effective communications improves engagement, connection, and alignment. title: Market Researcher
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Turn market signals into GTM strategy for Marketing. Notion is a collaborative AI workspace for teams and companies, operating in a market where AI is changing how teams evaluate software and get work done. This role will help Marketing understand how customers, competitors, and the broader market are responding, including shifts in brand perception, then turn that understanding into sharper messaging, growth strategy, and audience strategy. You’ll own the market research relationship with GTM partners across global markets and regional teams, and expand Notion’s thought-leadership research capability through original work on topics like AI transformation and ROI. This role is based in New York City or San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - Build a trusted market research practice and become a standing strategic partner for GTM planning, brought into launch planning early enough to shape the work. - Own brand tracking as a clear input into how Notion understands awareness, consideration, and perception, and translate those signals into sharper messaging and GTM priorities. - Connect customer, competitive, product, and top-of-funnel research across global markets to inform growth strategy and audience strategy. - Raise the bar for Notion’s research capabilities across decision support and thought leadership, building original studies on topics like AI transformation and ROI that give Marketing and Sales a credible point of view in the AI landscape. - Use AI as a research collaborator and workflow layer to connect data, scale analysis, surface patterns, and make insights easier for stakeholders to use, while improving the quality of decisions, not just the speed of delivery. SKILLS YOU’LL BRING - Strong quantitative research craft, including the ability to design and run research sprints, surveys, and MaxDiff studies, and to choose the right method for the decision at hand. - Deep understanding of brand tracking and top-of-funnel research, with the judgment to place those signals in the broader customer, competitive, and product context. - Strategic judgment: you can challenge the brief, connect market and product data, and turn ambiguous evidence into a clear recommendation that changes GTM priorities. - Experience working across global markets and regional teams, flexing across Product, Creative, and GTM while distinguishing local context from patterns that should shape broader strategy. - AI fluency and systems thinking: you use AI and data workflows thoughtfully to connect research infrastructure, scale insight delivery, and make the broader team more effective Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $196,000 - $219,000 per year. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
description: hellomed ist die führende digitale Pflege-Apotheke für Pflegeunternehmen – nach dem Motto: Dauermedikation nur in einfach! Unsere Vision ist es, bis 2030 die jährlichen 250.000 Krankenhauseinweisungen aufgrund von Medikationsfehlern und die damit verbundenen 1,2 Milliarden Euro Folgekosten zu vermeiden und der Pflege wieder zurückzugeben. Mit unserer innovativen hellomedOS-Software entlasten wir Pflegekräfte bei der täglichen Medikationsversorgung ihrer Patienten und machen diese noch sicherer. Unser revolutionäres Konzept bringen wir mit einem bunten Team aus Apothekern, Pflegeexperten und Entwicklern auf die Straße – namhafte Investoren sind bereits mit an Bord und Pflegekräfte deutschlandweit lieben das Produkt. Für unser CSM-Team suchen wir jemanden, der unsere Pflegeeinrichtungen von der Einführung an begleitet und dafür sorgt, dass sie die versprochene Entlastung im Alltag wirklich spüren. Aufgaben Begleitung neuer Kunden: Du begleitest unsere neu gewonnenen Pflegeeinrichtungen durch den gesamten Einführungsprozess und stellst sicher, dass sie erfolgreich in die digitale Medikationsversorgung mit der versprochenen Entlastung starten. Schulungen: Du schulst das Pflegepersonal und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten die Funktionen und Vorteile unseres Services sowie der intuitiven hellomedOS-Webapp verstehen und im Alltag sicher anwenden. Kundenbetreuung: Du hältst engen Kontakt zu unseren Partnereinrichtungen, stellst ihre Zufriedenheit sicher und arbeitest aktiv daran, die Zahl der versorgten Patienten zu erhöhen und die Zusammenarbeit auszubauen. Potenziale erkennen: Du analysierst Nutzungsdaten und die Entwicklung vor Ort, um gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb gezielt Potenziale bei bestehenden Kunden zu realisieren. Stimme der Kunden: Du gibst die Stimme unserer Kunden weiter – sammelst ihr Feedback, ihre Anregungen und Kritik und leitest sie an die richtigen Stellen weiter, um unseren Service und unser Produkt kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Qualifikation Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder Customer Success: Du hast in der Pflege gearbeitet oder bringst Erfahrung im Customer Success / Account Management mit, idealerweise im gesundheitsnahen Umfeld. Kundenorientierung: Du zeichnest dich durch eine ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung aus. Es fällt dir leicht, auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden einzugehen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die deren Alltag erleichtern. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist ein leidenschaftlicher Kommunikator und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte klar und verständlich erklären. Du hast Freude daran, Wissen zu vermitteln und Schulungen durchzuführen. Sprache: Du kommunizierst sicher und souverän auf Deutsch (mind. C1) – im Pflegealltag unserer Kunden ist das der Schlüssel zu Vertrauen. Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du kannst Kundenfeedback und Standortdaten strukturiert analysieren und daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten, um das hellomed-Kundenerlebnis und die Zahl der versorgten Patienten kontinuierlich zu verbessern. title: Senior Software Engineer, R2 Metadata
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | <strong>Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or London, UK</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <p>R2 is Cloudflare's object storage platform, offering developers durable, reliable storage that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare's global network and Developer Platform. The R2 Metadata team owns the metadata layer that underpins every R2 operation, every object put, get, list, and delete flows through the systems we build and operate.</p> <p>R2 is growing rapidly, and the metadata layer must evolve to keep pace. The team is responsible for designing and operating the metadata systems that track every object in R2, building and shipping developer-facing features, and ensuring the reliability and performance of these systems at global scale.</p> <p>You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of distributed databases, large scale storage infrastructure, and edge computing;  building systems that need to be correct, fast, and reliable.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Design and implement features in a metadata system, backed by a distributed SQL DB,  that serves every R2 API operation, ensuring correctness, performance, and compatibility with the S3 API surface.</li> <li>Build and operate production services on Cloudflare Workers and Kubernetes that handle high throughput metadata operations with strong consistency and durability guarantees.</li> <li>Own the schema, data model, and query patterns for a metadata layer managing billions of objects across multiple distributed database clusters.</li> <li>Own projects end to end; from design docs and schema changes through implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring.</li> <li>Participate in oncall rotations, drive incident resolution, and write postmortems that improve reliability.</li> <li>Use AI tools extensively to accelerate development, debugging, and operational tasks. We expect engineers to leverage AI as a core part of their workflow.</li> <li>Collaborate across teams (storage infrastructure, networking, other platform teams) to coordinate capacity planning, API contracts, and cross cutting initiatives.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Go, or similar languages.</li> <li>Experience with distributed databases; schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and understanding consistency/performance tradeoffs at scale.</li> <li>Experience building or operating large scale distributed systems with strong reliability requirements.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts such as object storage, edge computing, or service oriented architectures.</li> <li>Understanding of reliability and observability practices: monitoring, alerting, performance tuning, and incident response.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical decisions clearly and coordinate across teams.</li> <li>Comfortable working with AI coding tools as part of a daily development workflow.</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, or edge computing platforms is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Equity</strong></h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Time Off</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  P

title: Principal Network Architect, Backbone Network
description: <p><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></p> <p>Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. </p> <p>Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.</p> <p>At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers</p> <p><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></p> <p>Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p>It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity at Firmus, you will lead the architecture and technical assurance of the backbone connectivity platform that underpins the Firmus AI Factory ecosystem and Firmus AI Cloud. The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support of the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity, with focus on building and evolving Firmus’s national and international backbone across terrestrial and subsea networks, optical transport, IP backbone, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This role is responsible for the technical integrity of the backbone architecture across the full lifecycle, from concept and design assurance through delivery readiness, operational resilience and continuous improvement. You will work across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers, data-centre partners and internal engineering teams to ensure Firmus’s network connectivity is high-performance, secure, operationally robust and ready to scale with the company’s AI infrastructure growth.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity, you will own the technical architecture of Firmus's backbone network and act as the principal technical adviser to the Head of Connectivity, while operating as a senior technical lead within the Network Engineering team. You will convert the Firmus Connectivity Strategy into an integrated, executable backbone architecture spanning subsea and terrestrial fibre, optical transport (DWDM/OTN), IP/MPLS and segment routing, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. You will define the reference architecture, standards and reusable design patterns that guide engineers and partners, ensuring every AI Factory and Firmus AI Cloud service attaches through resilient, diverse and scalable backbone nodes free of unmanaged common-mode failure.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Working across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers and data-centre partners, you will set minimum resilience profiles, validate physical-route and shared-risk-link-group diversity, and provide independent technical assurance that designs can be delivered, operated and scaled safely across their full lifecycle. You bring deep expertise in national and international backbone design across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea systems, including landing-station connectivity, cable-landing diversity, and terrestrial route and duct engineering. You are fluent in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent and client-side optics, ROADM and amplification/regeneration planning) and in IP backbone design, including IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange, and high-capacity data-centre and customer interconnection. You understand how to design resilient, diverse networks free of unmanaged common-mode failure, using SRLG analysis, engineered failure-state capacity and physical-route evidence to prove your claims rather than assert them.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading architecture and design reviews, carrier and technology-vendor governance, technical evaluation of backbone and subsea services, change control, cutover planning, and operational-readiness and handover to network operations. You have authored or materially shaped reference architectures, design standards, reusable patterns and architecture decision records at a hyperscale operator, carrier, or equivalent, and you know how to keep an architecture modular and vendor-neutral so the business can flex across managed services, wavelengths, dark fibre and subsea assets as demand and economics change. You are comfortable engaging carriers, subsea consortia, internet exchanges and major equipment vendors, and you can drive value engineering and sustainability outcomes without compromising resilience or performance.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under delivery and incident pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of network engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. They will have led technical evaluations of carriers, subsea operators and equipment vendors, defined the technical sections of RFPs and evaluation criteria, and worked effectively across the design-to-operate interface with Network Engineering, Data Centre and Operations teams.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":120}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Experience authoring or contributing materially to global backbone reference architecture, minimum standards or interconnection strategy at a hyperscale, carrier or AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets — particularly Indonesia, Australia and Singapore — under diverse regulatory, licensing and provider conditions. Above all, the successful candidate will combine hands-on architectural depth with the influence and communication skills to lead as a senior technical authority</span></p> <p><em> </em></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Location & Reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>This role is based in Sydney, Australia.</li> <li>Reporting to Senior Manager, Networking</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Employment Basis</strong></p> <p>Full-time</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Diversity</strong></p> <p>At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. title: Senior General Ledger Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/f)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:  </strong></p> <p>The International Accounting team at Planet is seeking a versatile Senior GL Accountant to maintain our books and become a key part of our global Finance team. In this pivotal position, you will serve as a core financial anchor, managing critical workflows that directly support our expanding international footprint and global operational success. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, curious, collaborative, and analytical, bringing a strong work ethic to solve complex financial challenges. By driving rigorous accounting standards and cross-functional alignment, you will help power Planet's mission with a robust operational finance foundation. Ideal candidates are proactive problem-solvers who thrive in dynamic, cross-border team environments.</p> <p>This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin manufacturing office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage day-to-day closing and reporting activities including journal entries and reconciliations for Fixed Assets and Inventory in our Berlin Manufacturing site to ensure books are maintained in accordance with U.S. GAAP and HGB.</li> <li>Maintain the Fixed Asset Register (FAR), tracking capital expenditures, asset additions, disposals, transfers, monthly depreciation runs, and Construction in Progress (CIP) balances with operational stakeholders.</li> <li>Review and clear consolidated transfer orders between international subsidiaries, managing asset movements between locations for both PBC and GmbH entities.</li> <li>Maintain costs, prepayments, and accrued payables associated with satellite materials, launch, and build processes across inventory, WIP, and internal fixed asset materials.</li> <li>Support physical count / cycle count programs and analyze inventory adjustments.</li> <li>Partner with Berlin Operations to establish scalable cost accounting workflows, standard costing methodologies, and manufacturing time-tracking for our local production line.</li> <li>Serve as the dedicated backup for US cost accountants during time-off and high-volume periods.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>4+ years of relevant cost accounting experience in a manufacturing or high-tech operational environment.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (or a relevant German <em>Ausbildung</em>, e.g., <em>Industriekaufmann/-frau</em>, with specialized focus on accounting/controlling).</li> <li>Experience with inventory controls, Fixed Assets and multi-entity global structures.</li> <li>Proficiency with modern ERP systems and advanced capability in Excel or Google Sheets.</li> <li>Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Professional working proficiency in German</li> <li>Working knowledge of both US GAAP and German GAAP (HGB)</li> <li>A passion for Fixed Assets & Inventory GL Accounting</li> <li>Direct hands-on experience with NetSuite ERP/Oracle <br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.</em></p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off </li> <li>Employee Wellness Program </li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity </li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Germany Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€54.100</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€67.600 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging. <br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.  If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!  At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.  We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.  We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride. </p> <p><strong>EEO statement: <br></strong>Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. Planet is an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12.pdf">Know Your Rights.</a></p> <p><strong>Accommodations: <br></strong>Planet is an inclusive community and we know that everyone has their own needs. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please reach out to ----- or contact your recruiter with your request. Your message will be confidential and we will be happy to assist you.</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy</strong>: By clicking "Apply Now" at the top of this job posting, I acknowledge that I have read the <a href="https://www.planet.com/privacy/#california">Planet Data Privacy Notice for California Staff Members and Applicants</a>, and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein.</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy (European Applicants):</strong> By clicking "Apply Now" at the top of this job posting, I acknowledge that I have read the <a href="https://www.planet.com/privacy/">Candidate Privacy Notice GDPR Planet Labs Europe</a>, and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein.</p> <p><strong>AI in Our Interviewing Process</strong>: Planet is committed to providing an exceptional interview experience for all candidates. We currently use <a href="https://www.metaview.ai/" target="_blank">Metaview</a> to better focus on candidates and less on trying to capture notes. As such, with the candidate's consent, select interviews may be recorded and include a "Planet AI Notetaker" for transcription and summarization purposes. Should an interview involve use of AI interview technologies, the candidate will receive notification and have the ability to opt out both in advance and/or real-time. Opting out will not affect one's candidacy.</p> <p><strong>Candidate AI Policy</strong>: Planet embraces Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools, and we encourage its responsible use. We understand that candidates may use various resources, including AI tools, to <em>prepare</em> for interviews and assessments. However, <em>during any live interview stage or when actively completing assessments for this position, the use of AI tools—e.g. Large Language Models (LLMs), deep fake technology, etc.—is strictly prohibited unless explicitly prompted by an interviewer or assessment instructions</em>. If you are unsure about acceptable use, please contact your recruiter for clarification. If an AI tool or similar technology is desired as an accommodation, please contact ----

title: Senior Finance Business Partner
description: <p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p>Ocado Technology builds the systems behind some of the world’s most advanced grocery fulfilment: the Hive grid, thousands of bots, robotic picking and automated frame loading, all run by software our Product & Engineering teams write every day. More and more of that software is now built with AI.</p> <p>That makes finance here far from routine. Cloud and AI are among our fastest-moving costs, and how we capitalise engineering time directly shapes our P&L. Decisions made by engineering leaders this quarter show up in our cash flow next quarter. We want someone who’ll help make those decisions, not just report on them.</p> <p><strong>Are you our person?</strong> You’re curious about how things work, commercially sharp, and happy to challenge the way things are done when you can see a better way. You can juggle competing priorities and build trust at every level, from engineers to VPs. And you’re comfortable with AI: Claude is an official member of the team here, and you’ll work alongside it every day.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll report to the Head of Finance and have real autonomy. We’ll give you the problem, not a checklist. You’ll use AI as a core part of how you work: building tools, automating reporting and analysing data so your time goes on insight, not reconciliations. In this team, building a tracker in Claude or querying data yourself in Looker is normal. You will partner with: Product & Engineering VPs and leaders, Procurement, Treasury, Group Accounting, the Shared Service Centre, and Commercial Finance colleagues across Ocado.</p> <p>The exact mix will flex with your experience, your interests and the team’s priorities, but you’ll be working across:</p> <ul> <li>The P&E cost base: Partnering Product & Engineering leaders on budgets, outlooks and month-end, and helping them understand what drives their costs and where the opportunities are.</li> <li>Technology spend: Getting ahead of some of our fastest-moving costs, such as cloud, software and AI, and helping the business balance P&L impact against cash.</li> <li>Investment and accounting judgement: Making sure we treat engineering investment correctly, from capex and capitalisation to how costs are allocated across the business.</li> <li>Decision support: Turning messy questions into short, clear recommendations for senior finance and technology leaders.</li> <li>How finance works: Building tools, automating processes and finding better ways of doing things, and shaping the team as it evolves</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent) with 2+ years post-qualification experience including time in commercial finance or business partnering </li> <li>Confidence to take the lead: you set your own priorities, chase answers down and drive work through to a decision without waiting to be asked</li> <li>Hands-on use of AI tools in your work, with examples of something you’ve automated, built or rethought</li> <li>Strong modelling, budgeting and forecasting skills, and a solid grasp of P&L, capex and cash</li> <li>The ability to explain technical costs in plain English to engineers and finance leaders alike, and to challenge constructively</li> <li>Curiosity about how technology businesses work. Experience with cloud costs, capitalisation of development spend or SaaS/tech finance is a plus, not a requirement</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <p>We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Time to recharge</strong>:<br>25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.</li> <li><strong>Health & wellbeing</strong>:<br>Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.</li> <li><strong>Family-first policies</strong>:<br>22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave</li> <li><strong>Financial support</strong>:<br>Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.</li> <li><strong>Commuter perks</strong>:<br>Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.</li> <li><strong>Exclusive discounts</strong>:<br>15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).</li> </ul> <p></p> <p>#LI-JK3</p> <p>#LI-HYBRID</p> <p></p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Azure Integration Architect
description: <p></p> <div>Wil jij complexe integratievraagstukken vertalen naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-ecosysteem? En krijg je energie van het ontwerpen van architecturen die applicaties, systemen en data met elkaar verbinden? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!</div> <div> <div> <p>Bij HSO werk je aan uitdagende integratievraagstukken binnen complexe IT-landschappen. Je krijgt de ruimte om klanten te adviseren, technische keuzes te maken en bij te dragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft Cloud- en integratieoplossingen.</p> <p> </p> <h3>Wat ga je doen?</h3> <p>Als Azure Integration Architect help je onze klanten bij het ontwerpen, realiseren en moderniseren van hun integratielandschappen. Je vertaalt complexe business- en IT-vraagstukken naar schaalbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige oplossingen op basis van Microsoft Azure. Je kijkt verder dan alleen de techniek. Je begrijpt de uitdagingen van onze klanten, adviseert over architectuurkeuzes en zorgt ervoor dat verschillende systemen, applicaties en databronnen optimaal met elkaar samenwerken.</p> <p>Concreet houd je je bezig met:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Ontwerpen van integratiearchitecturen:</strong> Je ontwikkelt schaalbare en toekomstbestendige oplossingen binnen complexe Microsoft- en hybride IT-landschappen.</li> <li><strong>Adviseren van klanten:</strong> Je begeleidt klanten bij strategische en technische keuzes rondom integratie, cloudmodernisering en architectuur.</li> <li><strong>Inzetten van Azure-technologie:</strong> Je ontwerpt oplossingen met onder andere Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus en Event Grid.</li> <li><strong>Moderniseren van integratielandschappen:</strong> Je helpt organisaties bij het vervangen of verbeteren van bestaande integratieoplossingen en het toepassen van moderne cloud-native technologie.</li> <li><strong>Borgen van kwaliteit:</strong> Je houdt rekening met security, performance, schaalbaarheid en beheerbaarheid.</li> <li><strong>Kennis delen en samenwerken:</strong> Je werkt samen met andere architecten, consultants en developers en draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze integratie-expertise.</li> </ul> <p>Je krijgt de ruimte om inhoudelijk richting te geven, mee te denken over innovatieve oplossingen en klanten te helpen bij hun digitale transformatie.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Wat vragen wij van jou?</strong></p> <p></p> <div> <p>We zoeken een ervaren architect die technische expertise combineert met een adviserende en ondernemende instelling. description: The Practical Detail Location : Amsterdam Hybrid model Why this role matters We are looking for a commercially minded Head of Consumer & Market Insights Europe to ensure that consumers are at the heart of the decisions shaping the future growth of our great brands. This role is vital because it brings the consumer's voice into every strategic choice, from brand positioning to innovation and execution. In this role you will translate complex market and consumer data into clear, actionable opportunities that drive better food experiences in kitchens across Europe. Your work will help the business anticipate shifts in taste, nutrition, and consumer needs, ensuring Flora Food Group stays one step ahead. What you'll do Lead the European consumer and market insights strategy, identifying and delivering against the key questions that drive growth. Partner with senior marketing and cross-functional leaders to shape strategy and commercial decisions with clear, evidence-based consumer perspectives. Build and manage a focused learning agenda aligned with Flora's six strategic growth priorities, supporting innovation and market acceleration. Integrate qualitative and quantitative data, market intelligence, and emerging technologies to create a holistic view of consumer behaviour. Lead a lean, high-impact insights team, optimizing resources and fostering curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning. Performance You will own the quality and impact of consumer insights that shape European business decisions, driving measurable growth. Success will be tracked by how insight influences priority decisions, the delivery of learning agendas on time, and early involvement in innovation projects. You will lead the adoption of AI and advanced analytics to improve decision speed and quality, ensuring research budgets deliver maximum return on investment. Care You will report to the Global Insights Vice President and lead a dedicated European insights team. Collaboration across marketing, innovation, research and development, and other functions will be key to embedding consumer centricity throughout the organisation. Your leadership will ensure sustainable, responsible use of data and technology, building long-term capabilities that support Flora Food Group's mission to create better food for diverse communities. Passion As a food lover and consumer champion, you will bring relentless curiosity and empathy to your role. You will connect deeply with evolving food culture, nutrition trends, and consumer needs, inspiring your team and partners to innovate with confidence. Your passion for integrating taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability will raise the bar for how insights drive meaningful consumer experiences. About you You have significant senior experience in consumer and market insights, ideally within food, beverages, or fast-moving consumer goods. You excel at influencing senior stakeholders and shaping brand, innovation, and commercial decisions through integrated insight and strong storytelling capabilities. You have e xperience operating across countries and cultures and yo ur strategic mindset combines human understanding with advanced analytics and emerging technologies like AI. You thrive in complex, matrixed environments and build trust across diverse teams to prioritise impactful work. You are genuinely interested in food culture and have a relentless curiosity about consumer behaviour and how future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences. Where this could lead to This role typically leads to broader leadership positions within global consumer insights or commercial strategy, expanding your influence across more markets. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. title: Working Student, Revenue Engineering (m/f/d)
description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? ABOUT THE TEAM Revenue Engineering sits within Data & Insights Operations and exists to close the gap between our Data Production & Insights teams and our Revenue teams. We do this in two ways: by bringing product expertise directly into client conversations (for example through strategic pitch support), and by bringing our data and insights teams closer to the customer through programs like Voice of Customer (VoC), where we analyze signals such as customer feedback forms and support tickets submitted by our CSMs. Alongside both, we run a tool that automates our competitor research and content, and the team keeps that tool sharp and its outputs trustworthy. As a Working Student on this team, you'll get a front-row seat to how a data company turns customer signal and market knowledge into commercial impact, working across all three areas rather than being boxed into just one. YOUR JOB As Working Student in Revenue Engineering, you help turn customer signals and market knowledge into commercial impact and keep our Data & Insights teams closely connected to our customers. • Analyze customer feedback forms and support tickets from our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to find recurring themes, then turn them into structured summaries our Data Production and Insights teams can act on • Maintain and improve how we track and report on Voice of Customer signals over time • Support strategic Salesforce case requests by researching market and product angles and turning our data capabilities into clear talking points and visuals for clients • Review pitch materials for quality before they go to our Sales and Account teams • Keep our automated competitor research tool accurate by fact-checking its outputs against internal standards, flagging gaps and covering missing topics through targeted manual research • Build reports, presentations and data visualizations in PowerPoint and Excel, and support data cleaning and quality checks across team deliverables YOUR SKILLS • Enrolled student in business administration, economics, data science, communications, social sciences or a related field • Genuine interest in how customer insights, market research and data drive business decisions • Confident with Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Think-Cell is a plus • Strong written and spoken English; other languages are a plus • Curious and detail-oriented, able to work independently and reliably, and a team player who enjoys both analytical and client-facing tasks Available 15 to 20 hours per week, with a flexible schedule that fits around your studies What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from: Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year Hybrid work and flex-time International team and social events Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities Career & training opportunities Attractive locations and modern offices Mental health support with OpenUp Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above. title: Test Engineer
description: Wij zijn op zoek naar een test engineer met een brede technische interesse die techniek graag combineert met organiseren en samenwerken. Hoe mooi is het om als eerste een installatie aan te zetten en te testen of alles werkt zoals bedoeld en voldoet aan de verwachtingen van de opdrachtgever? Je werkt met uiteenlopende systemen, zoals camerasystemen, branddetectie, luchtbehandeling, voedingsverdeelkasten, verlichting, netwerken en waterinstallaties. Kortom: een compleet technisch gebouw, waarbij jij helpt om alles goed en aantoonbaar werkend op te leveren. Dit wordt jouw baan Je brengt samen met de testmanager in kaart wat er getest moet worden, stelt testplanningen en -protocollen op en bewaakt de voortgang. Je bereidt onder andere FAT-, PAT- en iFAT-testen voor, zorgt dat de juiste mensen, systemen en componenten beschikbaar zijn en begeleidt de daadwerkelijke testuitvoering. Bevindingen leg je zorgvuldig vast en je bewaakt dat deze worden opgevolgd. Je hoeft daarbij niet vanaf dag één specialist te zijn in alle systemen. Je werkt samen met ervaren testmanagers, testcoördinatoren, engineers en technische specialisten en krijgt de ruimte om je inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op je plek Je wordt onderdeel van de vakgroep Technische Installaties binnen het cluster Ontwerp van Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten. Samen met circa 140 collega's werk je aan de grootste multidisciplinaire infrastructurele projecten van Nederland, zoals tunnels, bruggen, sluizen, energieprojecten, waterzuiveringen en hoogspanningsinstallaties. Binnen het project werk je nauw samen met collega's uit ontwerp, uitvoering en projectbeheersing. Je krijgt veel ruimte om richting te geven aan het testproces en kunt daarbij terugvallen op ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Afhankelijk van het project werk je op locatie, vanuit een Dura Vermeer-kantoor of vanuit huis. Als eerste opdracht voorzien we een rol op het project Landstations, waarbij we de locatie realiseren waar de wind energie vanuit windparken op zee wordt omgezet naar het landzijdige nationale elektriciteitsnet. Je werk daarmee direct mee aan de verduurzaming van onze elektriciteitsvoorziening. Dit breng jij mee Een hbo / wo opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, industriële automatisering of een vergelijkbare richting; Een brede interesse in technische installaties en de motivatie om verschillende systemen te leren doorgronden; Je kunt technische tekeningen en documentatie lezen of bent gemotiveerd om dit verder te leren; Je werkt gestructureerd en kunt technische informatie vertalen naar een praktische aanpak; Je communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen en vindt het leuk om techniek en coördinatie te combineren; Ervaring met testen, commissioning, FAT/SAT of technische projectcoördinatie is een pré. Dit bieden wij jou Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen € 4.291,63,- en € 5.364,54,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). 43 verlofdagen volgens de Cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; Een laptop en een smartphone; Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap; Je hebt de keuze tussen een mobiliteitsbudget, NS Business Card of een elektrische leaseauto ; Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike; Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar bijvoorbeeld ook op het gebied van vitaliteit; Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland; Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibelwerkenbeleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical; Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de vijf weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%. Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen? Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteer direct via de sollicitatiebutton. Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze recruiter. Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Fabian Kamps op Bij Dura Vermeer werven en selecteren we onze kandidaten graag zonder de goedbedoelde hulp van ‘onderaannemers’. This is a broad, hands-on HR role that could suit either an existing HR Business Partner looking for their next opportunity, or an experienced HR Advisor ready to take the next step into a Business Partner role . Primarily supporting our Netherlands business, you will partner with managers and employees across a wide range of people matters, from employee relations and performance to organisational change, engagement and talent. You will also support smaller employee populations across Central Europe, giving you the opportunity to broaden your international HR experience and develop your knowledge of HR practices across different countries . Works Council: Building an effective relationship with the Dutch Works Council (OR) and supporting consultation and information processes. Sickness absence: Managing long-term sickness absence cases in line with the Dutch Gatekeeper Improvement Act (Wet verbetering poortwachter). HR projects and change: Supporting regional and global HR initiatives, organisational change and continuous improvement. Recruitment and onboarding: Partnering with Talent Acquisition and managers to support recruitment, onboarding and the employee experience. International HR: Providing practical HR support to smaller teams across Central Europe, working with regional HR colleagues and local specialists where required. HR operations: Supporting payroll checks, HR reporting, compliance and the consistent application of HR policies and processes. People management: Coaching and developing our HR Advisor in Breda. Ideally, you will bring: Strong, practical HR experience gained in the Netherlands, operating at Dutch HBO level or equivalent. Good working knowledge of Dutch employment law and sickness absence management. Experience handling employee relations matters and advising managers with confidence. Practical experience working with a Dutch Works Council. Experience of performance management, organisational change and stakeholder management. Strong communication, coaching and influencing skills. An analytical approach, with the ability to turn HR data and emerging issues into practical actions. Fluency in both Dutch and English , written and spoken. An interest in developing your international HR experience and supporting colleagues across Central Europe. Experience supporting employees in other European countries, particularly Germany and/or Switzerland, would be an advantage, but is not essential . Experience with SAP SuccessFactors would also be useful, but isn't required. Why this role? This is an opportunity to take ownership of a varied HR remit while being part of a wider international HR team. You'll have the chance to build on your HR Business Partnering skills, manage and develop an HR colleague and broaden your experience beyond the Netherlands through exposure to HR matters across Central Europe . Whether you're already working as an HR Business Partner or are an experienced HR Advisor looking for the opportunity to make that next career move, we'd be pleased to hear from you. title: Afstudeerstage AI Adoption
description: Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen? Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen. De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt. Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten. Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk. De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen. HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. Wat ga je doen? Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan. Concreet ga je onder andere: Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers. Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten. Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen. AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers. Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen. De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden. Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent. Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen. Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven. Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie. Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken. Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie. Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen. “We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.” – Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead Wie ben je? Je volgt een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, ICT, Business Informatics, Data & Business, Human Resource Management, Learning & Development, Communicatie of vergelijkbaar. Je hebt interesse in AI én de manier waarop mensen nieuwe technologie adopteren . Je vindt het leuk om voor groepen te staan en anderen iets nieuws te leren. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen op een eenvoudige en praktische manier uitleggen. Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd. Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt kritische vragen. Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete acties . Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende doelgroepen en niveaus van AI-ervaring. Je vindt het leuk om trainingen, materialen en nieuwe manieren van leren te ontwikkelen. Je durft initiatief te nemen en ideeën in de praktijk uit te proberen. Ervaring met tools zoals Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT en Power BI is een pre. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent naar AI en enthousiast wordt van de vraag: hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen AI daadwerkelijk goed gaan gebruiken? Wat bieden wij jou? Een afstudeeropdracht met directe impact op de organisatie. Intensieve begeleiding door de AI Transformation Lead. Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap. De kans om ervaring op te doen met AI-adoptie en organisatieverandering . Praktijkervaring met het ontwikkelen en geven van AI-trainingen, demo’s en workshops. De mogelijkheid om met echte adoptiedata te werken en te onderzoeken welke interventies daadwerkelijk effect hebben. Een actieve rol binnen het AI Champions-programma. Werken aan actuele AI-vraagstukken binnen een internationale organisatie. Een hybride werkomgeving vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere. Een informele en betrokken werksfeer waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand (obv 32 uur). Aan het einde van je stage heb je niet alleen een sterke afstudeerscriptie, maar ook praktische ervaring opgedaan met AI-adoptie, training en organisatieverandering binnen een internationale organisatie .
