title: Deal Intelligence Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon </p> <hr> <p><strong>About the Deal Desk Team</strong></p> <p>The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, serving as a trusted advisor to critical internal stakeholders as deal architect working on structuring, negotiating, approving and closing large complex commitment deals while balancing margin preservation, compliance, and velocity. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>As a Deal Intelligence Analyst, you will be the analytical engine driving our transition to a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk. Sitting within the Finance function, you will design the data systems and executive dashboards that allow our deal architects to analyze complex deal terms, protect margins, and close large, complex commitment deals with unprecedented velocity.</p> <p>This role is designed for a "full-stack" analyst. You won't just be querying pre-cleaned data—you possess the technical skills to build the pipelines that feed your insights. You will leverage Cloudflare's Developer Platform (Workers, R2, D1, Workers AI) alongside standard data warehousing tools to extract raw CRM and CPQ data, integrate it into AI workflows, and deliver actionable insights that directly impact margin preservation and our global growth.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build Advanced Dashboards & Analytics: Design and maintain executive dashboards and self-serve reporting systems that provide real-time visibility into deal terms, discount thresholds, win/loss rates, and margin performance across all regions.</li> <li>Transform Ideas into Reality: Work with stakeholders and help them refine their ideas and goals into queries that we’ll automate.</li> <li>Drive Strategic Margin Analysis: Partner closely with Finance, Infrastructure and Deal Desk leadership to dive deep into historic and active pricing data, uncovering insights that ensure our quoting strategies consistently align with margin preservation goals.</li> <li>Develop Data Pipelines: Apply your data engineering skills to build and maintain data cleansing tools that help refine data from Salesforce, CPQ, and billing systems, transforming it into clean, usable semantic models.</li> <li>Power AI Workflows: Assist in integrating structured deal data into Deal Desk tools to help automate routine approvals and surface real-time pricing optimizations to deal managers.</li> <li>Data Storytelling & Enablement: Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders, empowering the Deal Desk team to use your data products for faster, data-driven negotiations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Skills & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>3-5+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a technical RevOps role, with a strong emphasis on full-stack data problem solving.</li> <li>Experience incorporating data into AI workflows, utilizing LLM orchestration frameworks, or building predictive models.</li> <li>Proven experience designing analytical data models; domain expertise in financial and SaaS metrics (e.g. margins, discount rates, ARR, NRR) is a strong plus</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python (or TypeScript) with hands-on experience building ELT/ETL pipelines, interacting with APIs, and cleaning raw data.</li> <li>Experience designing analytical data models specifically tailored for financial and SaaS business analysis (e.g., margins, discount rates, ARR, NRR).</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud data platforms and an interest in edge computing/serverless architectures (Cloudflare Workers, R2, D1).</li> <li>Expertise, or interest in learning, CRM data structures (especially Salesforce custom objects), CPQ complexities, and the quote-to-cash lifecycle.</li> <li>Solid communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical data systems and operations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background working closely with Deal Desk, Finance, RevOps or Sales Strategy teams at a high-growth SaaS or technology company is a plus</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python (or TypeScript) with hands-on experience building ELT/ETL pipelines, interacting with APIs, and cleaning raw data.</li> <li>SQL and deep proficiency in modern data visualization and BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Sigma, PowerBI) to build intuitive executive reporting.</li> <li>Familiarity with data transformation frameworks and orchestration tools (like Airflow).</li> <li>Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform or other analytics databases</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €40,000 - €54,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong><br>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Gemeinsam mit uns Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Überzeugungen. Wir lieben Gespräche über das grosse Ganze genauso wie über die kleinen Details. description: À propos de Symrise Symrise est un fournisseur mondial de fragrances, de parfums, d'arômes, d'ingrédients actifs cosmétiques et d'ingrédients fonctionnels. Manager et développer l'équipe EHS , en définissant les priorités et en veillant à disposer des compétences et ressources nécessaires. Identifier, évaluer et prioriser les principaux risques environnementaux, santé et sécurité , et assurer la mise en œuvre de plans de prévention adaptés. Développer une véritable culture de la sécurité et de la prévention auprès de l'ensemble des activités du site : laboratoires, bureaux et fonctions support. Intégrer les exigences EHS dès les premières étapes des projets de transformation, immobiliers, laboratoires et de développement du site . Piloter la conformité réglementaire et anticiper les évolutions de la réglementation française et européenne en matière d'EHS susceptibles d'impacter les activités du site. Développer et entretenir des relations constructives avec les autorités et parties prenantes externes, notamment l'Inspection du travail, la CRAMIF, les services de santé au travail ainsi que les autorités environnementales et locales . Piloter les analyses d'incidents et garantir la mise en œuvre d'actions correctives et préventives durables. Suivre la performance EHS, les indicateurs clés et le reporting associé, dans une logique d' amélioration continue . Une expérience confirmée dans le management et le développement d'équipes EHS . Une expérience significative dans l'accompagnement de projets de transformation, de développement ou d'investissement . Une bonne maîtrise des relations avec les autorités réglementaires et les parties prenantes externes. Une capacité à anticiper les risques et à transformer des problématiques EHS complexes en recommandations concrètes et pragmatiques pour le business . De solides compétences en leadership, en influence et en accompagnement du changement dans une organisation matricielle et internationale . Une excellente capacité à communiquer et à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment avec le senior management. De fortes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et d'aide à la décision. Une expérience en conduite du changement et en gouvernance de projets. Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais . Avantages Ce poste vous offre l'opportunité de prendre la responsabilité des enjeux EHS au sein d'un site stratégique de Symrise , en collaboration étroite avec la Direction locale ainsi qu'avec les équipes régionales et globales du Groupe. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement en transformation, où l'EHS joue un rôle essentiel dans la continuité des activités, le développement du site, l'excellence opérationnelle et la croissance durable . Au-delà des enjeux de conformité, vous aurez l'opportunité de façonner la feuille de route EHS du site de Clichy , d'influencer des décisions structurantes et de contribuer directement au développement d'une culture forte et proactive de la sécurité. title: Location Data engineer
description: We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features. You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact. This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems. As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include: Making Sense of Data Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals. Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams. Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions. Building Data Products Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably. Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale. Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models. Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand. Exploring & Analyzing Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions. Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work. Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions. Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result. From Data to Intelligence Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter. Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem. Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability. Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production. Continuous Improvement Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure. Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies. Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack. Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning. Your Skills & Experience Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems. Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets. Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools. Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does. Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features. Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing. Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools. Preferred Qualifications Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products. Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data. Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering. Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production. Experience building internal tools or visualizations for exploring and debugging complex datasets. Life at amo To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week. We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you: We chose a location in central Paris, near Opéra (Metro lines 3, 8, 9 and RER A). We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light! Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover: Health care (100% coverage). Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%). Vacation days: 8–9 weeks (total) per year: 5 weeks of paid time off; 1–2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract); ~11 bank holidays. We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter, to allow everyone to truly recharge and avoid prolonged slowdowns. These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO. We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with: Help and sponsored visa process. 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival. Assistance from a trusted relocation agency to find your permanent home. Help with French paperwork like opening a French social security account, tax forms, getting your carte vitale (free healthcare), and more. French lessons to be fully set with your new Parisian life. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics)
description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. When a drone fails a test on our production floor, you're the first person we call. As Production Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics), you're the first line of technical support for production. You troubleshoot, diagnose and fix failures across our VTOL drones, their sub-systems, sensors and in-process quality tests. That way every aircraft we ship meets the standard our customers rely on in the field. You also step back from single failures and look at the data. You analyze yields and quarantine trends, find the root causes behind repeat problems and decide which fixes to tackle first. You work closely with Production, Engineering and Supply Chain, and your work shows up directly in product quality and output. Responsibilities First on the scene. You're the first-line technical support for production issues, from test failures and assembly defects to nonconforming units. Fix what's broken. You troubleshoot and repair electrical, electronic and system-level failures on drones, sub-assemblies, payloads and sensors. Keep the test benches honest. You help investigate issues with our software and electronics test benches. Decide what happens to quarantined material. You choose whether it gets reworked, repaired, scrapped or returned to the supplier. Find the real cause . You lead root cause analyses (5 Whys, Ishikawa, 8D) on recurring and high-impact failures. Let the data point the way. You analyze yields and quarantine Paretos to spot the biggest quality drivers. See fixes through. You turn your findings into prioritized corrective actions (CAPA) and follow them until they are closed. Keep failure, test and repair records traceable. Share what you learn. You feed findings back to Engineering and suppliers, and you train assembly staff on failure modes and workmanship defects. Requirements You've spent 4+ years as a quality technician, quality inspector or assembly technician on a complex mechatronic product. You understand at system level how mechanics, electronics, sensors and firmware work together. You're at ease with data. You can build yield and failure Paretos and draw sound conclusions from them. You're motivated and able to get to know our test software stack. You're methodical and keep good records, and you make sound calls under production pressure. You have a technical apprenticeship or technical diploma in Engineering, Manufacturing or Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience. You communicate excellently in English and enjoy working together on the shop floor. Plus Experience with UAVs, RC aircraft or avionics Familiarity with batteries, GNSS, IMUs, cameras or LiDAR Experience designing electronics PCBAs Experience in software programming SPC, Cp/Cpk, MSA or a Six Sigma Green Belt Python, SQL, BI or AI tools for data analysis Experience with non-conformance tracking, quality management systems or manufacturing ERP/PLM software Familiarity with inspection tools, measurement equipment, technical drawings and CAD Hands-on work with assembly line operators, manufacturing engineers and quality teams Continuous improvement methods such as 8D, 5S and CAPA Speaking or understanding German Joining Wingtra, you gain deep insight into applied robotics and aerial photogrammetry. You work in a startup, so you make a personal impact on both the technology and the organization itself. Please send your CV in English. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. Au sein de l’équipe Novar en France, vous serez accompagné·e par les équipes de développement et les supports techniques. Vous participerez, à votre niveau, à l’identification de sites et à la préparation des premières analyses et démarches d’autorisation pour des projets de stockage. Vous accompagnerez également dans leurs missions de développement de projets solaires les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets et les Chef.fe .s de projets. Vos missions · Identification de sites pour des projets de stockage par batteries. Pour cela, un travail d’analyse et de suivi des évolutions techniques et réglementaires devra être réalisé. · Analyses et prédimensionnement du projet de stockage sur la base des informations collectées (caractéristiques du réseau électrique à proximité ; règles d’urbanismes ; enjeux liés à l’occupation du sol, aux accès, au voisinage et aux zonages environnementaux). · Préparer des supports de synthèse (recherches documentaires, cartographie et tableaux de suivi) et apprendre à faire ressortir les principaux points à approfondir. · Accompagner les Chef.fe .s de projet en Développement et les Développeurs Nouveaux Projets dans leurs missions et se familiariser avec les démarches de sécurisation foncière, de développement de projets et de permitting sous leurs supervisions. Votre profil · Bac +5 type Master ou Ingénieur généraliste ou énergie . · Un intérêt marqué pour les énergies renouvelables, les systèmes électriques et la transition énergétique. · À l’aise avec la recherche, l’analyse et la synthèse d’informations, ainsi qu’avec la rédaction de documents clairs. · Rigueur, autonomie, curiosité et esprit d’équipe. · Bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques ; la connaissance des outils SIG ou de la réglementation en urbanisme et en environnement constitue un plus. · Bon niveau de français ; la connaissance de l’anglais est appréciée dans notre environnement international. Ce que NOVAR vous offre Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte? 💰 Une gratification de stage de 900 € par mois, dans le respect de la réglementation en vigueur. 🚆 Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport en commun. 📚 Des opportunités de développement et de croissance au sein de notre scale-up international. À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 200 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 7 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2035. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain. Intéressé(e) ? Prêt(e) pour la prochaine étape de votre carrière ? title: Product Manager Soft Fabrics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Hunter Douglas is wereldwijd marktleider in raamdecoratie en een toonaangevende producent van architecturale producten. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring in bijvoorbeeld productmanagement, projectmanagement, category management of een vergelijkbare functie.</p> <p> </p> <p>Daarnaast heb je:</p> <ul> <li>Een hbo diploma in bijvoorbeeld Bedrijfskunde, Marketing, Textieltechnologie of een vergelijkbare richting.</li> <li>Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden.</li> <li>Commercieel inzicht en een klantgerichte instelling.</li> <li>Een analytische, data-gedreven manier van werken.</li> <li>Ervaring met het managen van meerdere projecten en stakeholders tegelijk.</li> <li>Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.</li> <li>Interesse in AI en de mogelijkheden om hiermee productiviteit, inzichten en bedrijfsprocessen te verbeteren.</li> <li>Ervaring binnen een productieomgeving, textiel, interieurproducten of een industriële omgeving is een pré.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Je bent georganiseerd, proactief en hands-on. Je houdt gemakkelijk overzicht, ook wanneer er verschillende belangen en deadlines spelen. Tegelijkertijd werk je graag samen en weet je anderen mee te krijgen in jouw aanpak.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Waarom deze rol?</strong></p> <p>Je komt terecht bij Artex in Aarle-Rixtel, maar bent deel van het Product Team van Hunter Douglas met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam. title: Senior Data Analyst - Traffic / Acquisition (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>Notre équipe Data Analytics E-commerce recherche un·e Senior Data Analyst - Traffic / Acquisition (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Paris ou Lille.</strong></p> <h3><strong>À PROPOS DE L'ÉQUIPE</strong></h3> <p>L'équipe Data Analytics E-commerce (environ 10 personnes) accompagne les enjeux E-commerce de Decathlon à l'échelle internationale. Notre mission est de démocratiser la prise de décision guidée par les données pour rendre nos produits digitaux toujours plus performants, fluides et centrés sur l'utilisateur·rice. Au sein du périmètre <em>Acquisition</em>, tu travailleras en proximité directe avec une équipe Produit dédiée aux sujets SEO, Traffic et à la performance des contenus E-commerce pour faire rayonner nos solutions et maximiser la visibilité de nos offres à travers le monde.</p> <h4><strong>TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION</strong></h4> <p>En tant que <strong>Senior Data Analyst (f/m/d)</strong>, ton rôle sera d'apporter une vision analytique stratégique pour accompagner l'équipe Produit dédiée.</p> <p>Tes missions principales :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Expertise SEO & Search :</strong> Exploiter les données de Google Search Console et des outils SEO pour mesurer l'impact des optimisations techniques et de contenu sur la performance organique.</li> <li><strong>Performance des canaux digitaux :</strong> Réaliser l'analyse du trafic par canal d'acquisition, comprendre les mécanismes d'attribution et piloter la performance des optimisations mises en place dans l'équipe.</li> <li><strong>Innovation en suivi GEO & LLM :</strong> Mesurer, suivre et analyser le trafic en provenance des modèles LLM et moteurs génératifs pour accompagner notre stratégie de GEO.</li> <li><strong>Performance du contenu :</strong> Évaluer l'efficacité et la valeur créée par les contenus éditoriaux et accompagner les équipes dans leur optimisation continue.</li> <li><strong>Prise de décision stratégique :</strong> Apporter des enseignements basés sur les données pour orienter la roadmap produit, aider les équipes à prioriser les initiatives créatrices de valeur. Synthétiser ces données en recommandations claires et directement exploitables.</li> <li><strong>Business Partner :</strong> Travailler en partenariat étroit avec les équipes Produit pour définir les indicateurs de succès, partager des analyses auprès des pays et éclairer la prise de décision auprès d'interlocuteur·rices techniques et non techniques.</li> <li><strong>Garant·e de la qualité des données :</strong> Définir et affiner les besoins de tracking avec l'équipe en charge afin de garantir une collecte de données précise et fiable.</li> </ul> <p>CE QUE TU APPORTES</p> <ul> <li><strong>Expertise Web Analytics & Marketing Digital : </strong>Connaissance avancée des outils d'analyse de trafic web (Amplitude) et des plateformes SEO (Google Search Console), combinée à une solide maîtrise de l'analyse du trafic et de la performance des canaux d'acquisition.</li> <li><strong>Compétences Data avancées :</strong> Maîtrise experte du langage <strong>SQL</strong> et expérience pratique sur des environnements Cloud/Big Data comme <strong>Databricks</strong> pour traiter et croiser de grands volumes de données.</li> <li><strong>Solide expertise SEO : </strong>Bonne compréhension du SEO technique (indexation, architecture de site, Core Web Vitals).</li> <li><strong>Profil curieux & Veille permanente : </strong>Grande curiosité intellectuelle, veille active sur l'évolution des moteurs de recherche (IA générative, modèles LLM, GEO) et appétence pour l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodologies analytiques.</li> <li><strong>Développement & Optimisation Produit : </strong>Capacité avérée à mesurer la valeur incrémentale des évolutions produit et à fournir des recommandations stratégiques pour optimiser l'expérience client.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Maîtrise de l'anglais :</strong> Excellente capacité à vulgariser la donnée, faire du data storytelling et interagir avec fluidité en anglais professionnel (oral et écrit) au sein d'un environnement international et collaboratif.</li> <li><strong>Esprit d'équipe & Impact Data : </strong>Volonté de partager les connaissances au sein du collectif, participation à la construction d'une expertise Data E-commerce référente et contribution à la stratégie Data globale de Decathlon.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>STACK TECHNIQUE</strong></h4> <p>Google Search Console, Amplitude, Databrick, SQL, Tableau, Outils SEO</p> <h4><strong>CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Organisation de travail hybride ;</li> <li>Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;</li> <li>Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;</li> <li>Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, title: Chef.fe de Projet Applicatifs Hôpitaux
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service. En tant que Chef.fe de projet, tu piloteras des déploiements de nos solutions auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement. Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement. Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions. Coordonner Business Development, Ops Manager et R&D. Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain. Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés. Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques. Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé. Des bases en interopérabilité et en flux de données. La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire. Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes. Nice-to-have Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé. Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes. L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels. Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet. Soft skills Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions. Nos valeurs Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs. Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes. Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé. 👥 Process de recrutement Échange avec Laura, Talent Acquisition - 30 min. Étude de cas avec Loïc et un membre de l’équipe Customer Ops - 60 à 90 min. Quelques jours avant l’échange, nous t’enverrons une étude de cas à préparer. Lors de la restitution, tu présenteras ton raisonnement et la façon dont tu cadres un déploiement sur le plan fonctionnel. L’objectif est d’évaluer ta capacité à structurer un plan de déploiement, prioriser les actions et les risques, coordonner les parties prenantes et communiquer avec le client. Entretien Cultural Alignement avec Raphaël, VP ops - 30 min. Cet échange permet de discuter de ta façon de travailler, de ta collaboration avec les autres équipes et de revenir sur d’éventuels sujets à approfondir après les premières étapes. title: Head of Talent Development
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? At Back Market, we're on a mission to prolong the life of electronics — because a phone that's already been made is always smarter than making a new one. With around 700 Backmakers across Paris, Bordeaux, Barcelona, New York, and Tokyo, we're growing fast, and our People ambition is growing with us. title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Codex)
description: About the team The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. Work directly with selected customers to build Codex workflows, integrations, and automations, resolve technical blockers, and evaluate effectiveness and reliability. Turn successful approaches into reusable code examples, guides, and tools that help more startups succeed with Codex and OpenAI’s broader platform. Collaborate with account teams, developer experience, and ecosystem partners to reach developers and founders, prioritise opportunities, and drive measurable customer value. Translate customer experiences and developer feedback into actionable insights for OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Have experience building at, founding, or working closely with early-stage startups, and understand the pace, ambiguity, and practical trade-offs involved. Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy building practical AI applications, integrations, and developer tools. Bring high agency, curiosity, and end-to-end ownership, working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues and ecosystem partners. title: Product Marketing Manager (F/H)
description: At Younited, we believe credit and banking should feel as simple, fast and transparent as everything else in your digital life. So we build financial services that way. We combine technology, data and automation to rethink the way people borrow, pay, save and manage their money. Today, more than 1.5 million customers trust us, and nearly 500 employees contribute to our growth across 4 European countries . What we build Younited Credit – instant consumer credit, directly accessible to customers. Younited Pay – instalment payment and financing solutions embedded into our partners' customer journeys. Younited Cashback – cashback and personalised offers, enhanced by open banking data. Younited Bank – our everyday banking offering, currently available through helios by Younited and being expanded. Our ambition is to build a financial partner people genuinely trust, combining simplicity, transparency and responsible finance. As a certified B Corp, we integrate social and environmental considerations into the way we build our business. The 5 values we work by Make it simple - in the product, in the customer experience and in how we organise. Be transparent. Act as an entrepreneur - take ownership, play as a team, dare to try and accept failure. Innovate or die - challenge the status quo, however impossible it may seem. Faster is better - speed over perfection, alignment over debate. No limit - shoot for the moon, stay humble. We give passionate problem-solvers the space to do their best work in diverse and inclusive teams across Europe, because that is how we build better financial products for our customers and partners. Context 📄 How do you turn complex credit and payment products into propositions that customers understand, partners value and teams can sell? As Product Marketing Manager at Younited, you will shape the insights, narratives and tools that help our products stand out and grow. You will work across Younited’s product portfolio, with Younited Pay as your initial priority given its strategic importance and the competitiveness of its market. Within Marketing Central, you will join the Customer Engagement team and work with Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams. Depending on business priorities, your scope may evolve across different Younited products, audiences and customer journeys. Your mission will be to understand the audiences we want to reach, clarify what makes our products valuable and turn market, customer and field feedback into concrete recommendations for Sales, Partnerships, Product and Marketing. You will connect market reality, commercial priorities and product decisions by turning research, customer insights and field feedback into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations. You will also work closely with the PRM/CRM teams to connect these insights with customer journeys, engagement and retention initiatives. Key responsibilities 🚀 1) Build market and customer understanding Conduct market research, competitive analysis and customer data analysis to identify target audiences, understand their needs, uncover opportunities and bring the voice of the customer into business and product decisions. Work across several products, audiences and business priorities, with Younited Pay as the initial priority. Work with the PRM/CRM and Customer Engagement teams on segmentation, use cases and customer journeys across acquisition, activation, repeat usage and retention, including merchant onboarding for Younited Pay and other priority journeys across the Younited portfolio. 2) Define positioning and support commercial teams Clarify the benefits, differentiators and key messages of Younited products, making complex topics compelling and easy to understand for customers, merchants, partners and internal teams. Turn market and customer insights into sales pitches, presentations, enablement materials, partner tools and practical recommendations that help Sales and Partnerships teams explain and sell our products. Contribute to strategic RFPs by understanding requirements and shaping the response narrative, value proposition, differentiators, proof points and presentation materials. 3) Partner with Product teams and support product evolutions Bring market feedback and customer insights into product discussions and roadmaps, and influence product decisions based on market and customer feedback. Support product launches and evolutions with the necessary materials, including demos, training materials, operational guides, FAQs and sales enablement documents. Work across Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams to turn insights into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations. About you 👇 You have at least 5 years of experience in B2B Product Marketing, Product Marketing or a related role. You know how to conduct market research, analyse competition and turn customer and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations. You are comfortable working across several products, audiences and business priorities. You understand Sales and Partnerships teams’ challenges and know how to create useful, practical materials that support commercial teams. You are comfortable contributing to strategic RFPs and tailoring a value proposition to different business and partner contexts. You are comfortable working with Product teams and influencing product decisions based on market and customer feedback. Experience in payments, banking, credit, fintech, e-commerce or another complex or regulated industry is a plus. You know how to make complex topics simple and compelling, both in writing and verbally. You are fluent in French and English. You are autonomous, structured, proactive and able to manage several projects in parallel. You know how to adapt your approach to different audiences and switch between strategic thinking and hands-on execution. You know how to influence stakeholders without relying on hierarchical authority and deliver concrete results. Hiring process 📅 First video interview with Arthur, Lead Talent Acquisition Manager, to discuss the role, your motivations and Younited. Second interview with Lise, Head of Customer Engagement, to explore the expectations of the role in greater depth. Business case, followed by a debrief and conversations with members of the team. Final interview with Ricardo, Growth & Business Operations Director, to validate overall alignment with the role and potential development opportunities. 🎁 Other benefits from joining Younited ? Offices located in the heart of Paris (9th arrondissement) An international work environment and the opportunity to go on assignments in our offices abroad (Barcelona, Lisbon, Rome) An entrepreneurial mindset and strong team spirit Personalized managerial and HR support during onboarding and throughout your Younited journey A continuous learning environment with access to internal and external training, an e-learning platform, and “Friday workshops” within the Tech team to support everyone’s development A strong focus on work-life balance A parenthood charter to support all family-related projects, with key measures Special leave for major life events, often more generous than legal requirements An hybrid remote work policy: 2 to 3 days of remote work per week depending on the team, and the option to work fully remotely for one week twice a year 33 days paid holiday, i.e. 8 more than the statutory 25 days (instead of the traditional RTT) Access to the Wellpass platform (formerly Gymlib) with over 4,000 fitness and wellness activities across France at a discounted rate Meal vouchers (€10 per day, 60% covered by the company) Team buildings in France (Summer Party & Winter Party), abroad, and within your team Younited is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation. title: Head of FP&A (F/H)
description: About Younited At Younited, we are reinventing credit and payments to make banking simple, transparent, and inclusive. European leader in instant credit, we serve over 1 million customers and partner with major brands like Apple, N26, Bouygues Telecom. Operating in 4 countries with 500 employees, we are proud to be B Corp certified, placing social and environmental impact at the heart of our strategy. Our mission: become the trusted financial partner for millions of Europeans by promoting transparency and financial well-being. We leverage cutting-edge technology and innovation to redefine lending and payment practices, delivering exceptional user experience. Our solutions include credit and payment services for consumers and partners. We empower passionate problem-solvers to collaborate, innovate, and act as entrepreneurs in a fast-growing environment. In January 2025, we reached a major milestone in our history by becoming a publicly listed company on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam. Join us and shape the future of finance in an inclusive, dynamic, and ambitious company. Be part of an adventure that is only beginning! About the Finance team The Corporate Finance team reports to the Finance Director. The Corporate Finance team oversees the financial reporting of Younited within a regulated banking environment. Its mission is (i) to deliver accurate accounting, tax, and regulatory reporting, (ii) provide reliable performance analyses to guide strategic decisions, partnering with business units to optimize resource allocation and support key growth initiatives, and (iii) drive the continued digital transformation of the overall finance function while working closely with teams across the company. The FP&A team is being reorganised into an end-to-end function of 4 people, including the Head of FP&A. Each FP&A controller owns both the forecast and the actuals on their scope, across the full management cycle — budget, business plan and capital plan, monthly closing anticipation, and post-closing analytics analytics. Context 📄 Reporting directly to the Finance Director, the Head of FP&A leads the newly structured FP&A function (a team of 3 FP&A controllers). He / She owns the management cycle and the calendar, arbitrates priorities and ad hoc requests, and acts as the guardian of the method and of the single planning model. He / She is accountable for the quality of the figures and for the development of the team. This role comes at a pivotal moment: Younited is moving to a market-standard, end-to-end FP&A organization and the Head of FP&A will be responsible for shaping his/her team target operating model, formalise scopes and ways of working, and progressively automate and strengthen the reliability of the whole planning and reporting chain — while partnering closely with the business to turn financial analysis into better decisions. Key responsibilities 🚀 Build the team target operating model, define the set of FP&A procedures (scopes, calendar, controls, documentation) and make its organisation resilient by design with clear back-ups and shared standards. Own the budget process, business planning and reforecasts: annual budget (build, iterations, defence), multi-year business plan and periodic reforecasts, under one method and one single model. Own the monthly closing process: pre-close anticipation of closing topics so that issues are spotted before the accounts are closed, post-close analysis of variances to budget, and capital plan. Deliver timely, clear financial reporting tailored to each audience — leadership, local management and business partners — including management accounts, variance analyses and ad hoc studies, and act as a business partner to the divisions on strategic initiatives and performance improvement. title: Research Engineer
description: Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments? Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI? Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution? If your answers are yes, we should talk. At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments - to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery. Offer essentials Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day. Relocation package. Flexible working hours. English-speaking environment. Here is why we love this job ourselves, and hope you will enjoy it too: We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems The data already exists. We have robots in production at scale. We aren't waiting for datasets to be collected; the byproduct of our machines doing useful work is being created right now. We measure what matters. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance. High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company. World-class peers. Our team has built Google Warsaw, unicorn startups, led research in DeepMind, tested rocket engines, and worked at top companies like Nvidia and ByteDance. Now, we are shaping the reality of Physical AI together. We are building the bridge. We aren't a new startup looking for an application; we are an established player bootstrapping physical AI. We believe that this will be the first true proof-of-concept for scaled physical AI. What you will do Your focus will be defined by the intersection of Robotics and ML and large-scale multimodal model training - expertise in both is optimal and alternatively eagerness to learn. Expect challenges across two main pillars with the opportunity to specialise: Core Research & Large-Scale Infrastructure Own the Training Stack: Design, implement, and maintain the core infrastructure for large-scale VLA model training, including scheduling, distribution, job management, checkpointing, and rigorous logging. Enable Rapid Iteration: Build the critical tools and abstractions necessary for launching, monitoring, debugging, and seamlessly reproducing complex, multi-variant experiments. Train from Deployment Logs: Utilize our massive repository of offline, classical stack data to pre-train robust robot foundation models. Drive the Software Feedback Loop: Translate core research needs into concrete infra capabilities, track experiments, analyze results, and close the loop directly with ML researchers to unblock model progress Real-World Evaluation & Operations Design Physical Benchmarks: Design new robotic tasks and build lightweight physical setups to systematically evaluate model capabilities far beyond the limits of simulation. Execute Structured Evaluations: Ensure robots are properly configured, calibrated, and ready for rollouts. You will coordinate data collection efforts and run structured, on-robot evaluations to measure real-world success rates. Close the Physical Feedback Loop: Analyze real-world evaluation results to guide the ML research direction. You will identify operational bottlenecks across software, hardware, and deployment systems to continuously improve our iteration speed. Scale the Workflows: Beta test internal and third-party tools for teaching robots new skills, and write clear, structured documentation so the broader team can reproduce your workflows and scale your impact. What skills we’d like you to have: Experience: Deep experience and understanding at the intersection of machine learning, systems engineering, and robotics. Proven Track Record: Experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying modern deep learning architectures (Transformers, VLMs or VLAs, Imitation Learning, RL) for robot control, ideally with policies validated on real hardware. Engineering Excellence: Strong software engineering and infrastructure skills. You are highly proficient in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/JAX) and can write clean, scalable code for training and evaluation. Robotics Intuition: Comfort working hands-on with hardware. You understand the robotics full stack (perception, controls, state estimation) and how to debug failures when software meets the physical world. Pragmatic Research Mindset: You possess the ability to move seamlessly between research and implementation. You prefer execution, iteration speed, and real-world robustness over theoretical purity. What should you expect once you apply? A phone screen with the hiring manager to discuss your background and our technical direction. A half-day of on-sites (cultural fit & deep-dive technical interviews). A final decision made within 2-3 days after the on-site interview. Important: Expect detailed, honest feedback after completing the process, regardless of our decision. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Account Executive (Enterprise)
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary Every large group in Europe has bought an AI assistant, or is buying one this year. The next decision is harder: how their teams' own work runs on agents, across their own systems, governed, on top of what they already pay for. That is what Dust sells, and this role owns that decision inside a handful of France's largest groups. You will be one of our first Strategic Account Executives. We are looking for people who have been at the top of every team they have joined, wherever they started. The Role 5 to 8 named groups, 5,000+ employees, mostly headquartered in France. You own each relationship globally, across subsidiaries and countries. Some are already customers. They started with one team and grow as more teams build their own agents. Their renewals are where your account grows, and you run them. The others you open. We go in through the executive who owns the group's AI programme, before any tender is written. Our founders and executives work your accounts with you, and so do the consulting firms that run these programmes. Deals of €300K to €1M+ a year, decided by the executive committee, with IT, security, procurement and the business in the room. You run the deal team: solutions engineers, customer success, partners and founders, brought in when you decide. You write the playbook. How Dust sells to large groups is being built now, by the people in this seat. What success looks like 90 days: an account plan for each group, the owner of the AI programme identified in all of them, and a first executive meeting held in at least half. 12 months: a first group-level deal signed, and one existing account growing across new teams. Who we are looking for You have been at or near the top of every team you joined. Tell us your rank in each role, and where you started. We care more about how far you have come than about the logos on the way. You have opened large accounts yourself, without a big brand or an inherited list doing the work. You have led a deal decided at executive level, with procurement and legal involved, and you can walk us through every step of it. You have grown an account after the first deal, and you think in what an account is worth in three years. You use AI in your own work. If you have built an agent, show us. Fluent French and English. Based in Paris or moving here, with regular travel in France and Europe. We do not screen on years of experience or on the size of your last employer. If you have been the best at what you did and want a bigger game, apply. What is hard Our brand is smaller than the labs'. You will win on what Dust does next to the assistant a group already chose, not on our name. Large groups move slowly and decide at the top. A unit that loves the product does not make a group deal; you will learn to find the person who does. The playbook is unfinished. You will be writing it while you use it. What you get OTE €180k OTE 50/50 split, uncapped accelerators, and a significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed company. Founders on your accounts, a small team that decides fast, and room to lead as the Strategic team grows. We are not promising a title; we will look here first when we need one. Health cover, relocation support, Paris office, regular trips to San Francisco. How we hire A call with Talent, a deep dive on your largest deals with the hiring manager, a live executive meeting role-play, then a half-day where you present an account plan for a group of your choice, and a conversation with a founder. We decide within [2–3] weeks of your first call. In your application, tell us your rank on your team in each of your last roles, and one deal you are proud of. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. title: Security Architect
description: Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products. Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: Physical/embedded device security. OT (operational technology) network security. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines. What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. What you will be doing As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. Security standards, policies, and design patterns library Security architecture review process Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work. To succeed in this role: You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security " You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. In addition, you have the following technical expertise: Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries Zero trust architecture principles Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) The following competence is desired: OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) Container and Kubernetes security Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) Priva's technical stack is C#/C++/.NET and Angular. Experience implementing production projects with this stack is preferred, but not required if you are able to learn it quickly (based on your vast experience) What we offer you 💶 Excellent remuneration — competitive and aligned with experience. 🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 more at half price. 🏦 Excellent pension contribution . 🎓 Education budget of €1,000 per year. ⏰ Flexible working hours . 🍱 Onsite canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2). 🏋️ Free onsite gym . 🎉 Vibrant, open culture . title: Sr. Engineering Manager - Developer Ecosystem
description: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">RDQ427R369</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.</span></p> <p>Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.</p> <p>We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.</p> <p>The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team:</strong> Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.</li> <li><strong>Make agentic development the default path:</strong> Shape how developers and AI agents author, validate and deploy projects, both inside the workspace and from the developer's own coding agent. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.</li> <li><strong>Own the strategy and roadmap:</strong> Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence:</strong> Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.</li> <li><strong>Treat backward compatibility as a product feature:</strong> Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead across the platform:</strong> Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE).
