title: Product Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX</p> <h4><strong>Role Summary</strong></h4> <p>As a Product Security Engineer, you will support security assessments and vulnerability operations for Cloudflare’s core software products. In this role, you will analyze system architecture, threat model new features, and ensure that product-related security findings are accurately triaged, routed to the correct engineering owners, and mitigated within our SLAs.</p> <p>On any given day, you might conduct a deep-dive security review on a new feature design, triage a complex bug bounty submission, or work directly with engineering teams to resolve vulnerabilities from different sources like bug bounties, SAST, fuzzing and penetration tests. You will also work autonomously to identify areas where our manual processes slow down. You will write code and integrate AI/LLM solutions to automate initial triage and data enrichment, building tools that help the team handle security findings at scale. In short, your work will sit at the intersection of Product Security, Vulnerability Operations, and internal AI Tooling. Ideally, you have experience in conducting academic/vulnerability research with a focus on systems security.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Implement AI Security Solutions:</strong> Identify process bottlenecks and build AI-driven tools or scripts to help automate code analysis, optimize triage, and streamline Product Security workflows.</li> <li><strong>Security Reviews & Threat Modeling:</strong> Conduct structured security reviews and threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE) across product features, defining security requirements early in the development lifecycle.</li> <li><strong>Product Vulnerability Management:</strong> Manage the operational lifecycle of product security findings. Ensure vulnerabilities are verified, mapped to the correct engineering owner, and tracked to mitigation in alignment with established SLAs.</li> <li><strong>Bug Bounty Triage:</strong> Perform the technical triage and validation of Cloudflare’s external Bug Bounty submissions, verifying exploitability and evaluating business risk.</li> <li><strong>Pentest Coordination:</strong> Support internal and external penetration testing engagements by reviewing findings, clarifying technical context, and assisting development teams with remediation strategies.</li> <li><strong>Engineering Collaboration:</strong> Partner closely with DevOps and product teams, acting as a reliable security point of contact and helping developers implement secure coding practices.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Product/AppSec Expertise:</strong> 5+ years of experience in Product or Application Security within large-scale distributed cloud environments or SaaS platforms.</li> <li><strong>Practical AI & Automation Engineering:</strong> Demonstrated ability to build production-grade automation scripts and tools. Must possess hands-on engineering experience leveraging AI/LLMs to solve operational or technical challenges.</li> <li><strong>Threat Modeling & Risk Analysis:</strong> Competency in threat modeling methodologies and the ability to evaluate code flaws to determine their actual engineering and security impact.</li> <li><strong>Vulnerability Lifecycle Operations:</strong> Experience tracking, routing, and driving the remediation of software vulnerabilities across engineering groups while working against defined SLAs.</li> <li><strong>Strong Collaboration & Communication:</strong> Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, clearly communicating technical security risks to software engineers and resolving ownership ambiguity constructively.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Offensive Security Tooling:</strong> Familiarity with modern exploitation techniques, fuzzing frameworks, or automated scanning utilities.</li> <li><strong>Program Management Experience:</strong> Experience scaling crowdsourced security programs (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd) or optimizing agile project management workflows within JIRA.</li> <li>Experience in integrating hardware security features into production code bases</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. expertise or additional language capabilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Director, International Affairs that is:</p> <ul> <li>Able to connect title: Customer Engineer, Korea
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Seoul, South Korea, Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></p> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;

title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
description: We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated. Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence. We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end. As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems. You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices. Key Responsibilities Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably. Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components. Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable. Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery. Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests. Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve. Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers. Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits. Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization. Competitive salary and benefits package. Enjoy regular team activities and company events. Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week. Qualifications: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field. Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development. Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code. Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control. Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf). Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data. Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment. Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment. Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards. An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others. Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software. Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment. Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners. Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems. title: Enterprise Account Executive, Thailand
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Singapore</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine - winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in <strong>Enterprise accounts of the Thailand market</strong>. The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.</p> <p>You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.</li> <li>Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.</li> <li>Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.</li> <li>Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.</li> <li>Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree required.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> <li>The portfolio for this role consists of customers based in Thailand. Proficiency in Thai to communicate with these customers would be required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting
description: Krijg jij energie van een financiële administratie die tot in de puntjes klopt? Heb je ruime ervaring met boekhouding en houd je graag overzicht over financiële processen? Bij Normec Foodcare zoeken we een ervaren Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting die zelfstandig de financiële administratie beheert, afwijkingen signaleert en bijdraagt aan een correcte maand- en jaarafsluiting. Daarnaast bereid je de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor en werk je nauw samen met de Financial Controller en andere collega's binnen Finance. Daarnaast ben je een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor collega's bij complexere boekhoudkundige vraagstukken en ondersteun je hen met jouw kennis en ervaring. title: Werkstudent Medisch Acceptatie
description: Over ons Europa verandert. Steeds meer mensen kiezen voor vrijheid — als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Ze bepalen zelf wanneer, hoe en met wie ze werken. Maar die vrijheid komt met een keerzijde: onzekerheid. Bij Insify geloven we dat ondernemers zich geen zorgen moeten maken over verzekeringen. Daarom bouwen we iets wat de verzekeringswereld hard nodig heeft: transparante, eerlijke en volledig digitale verzekeringen, speciaal voor mensen die voor zichzelf werken. Geen ingewikkeld papierwerk, geen gedoe. Vandaag geregeld, morgen verzekerd. We verzekeren inmiddels duizenden klanten in heel Europa — en we zijn nog maar net begonnen. Het Operations Team Wij zijn het gezicht van Insify. Bij elk telefoontje, elke e-mail en elk gesprek bouwen we vertrouwen op. We zorgen ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord, gesteund en goed geholpen voelen — ook als het ingewikkeld wordt. Snelheid en kwaliteit gaan bij ons hand in hand, en we verbeteren continu op basis van wat we leren. Met een groeiend medisch acceptatieteam en uitbreiding naar meerdere Europese landen, speel jij een directe rol in iets wat echt impact maakt. Jouw rol Als Medisch Acceptatie Werkstudent ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten in een van de meest persoonlijke momenten van hun ondernemerschap. Je werkt nauw samen met medische specialisten en zorgt ervoor dat aanvragen soepel, nauwkeurig en klantgericht verlopen. Dit is geen standaard bijbaan — je draait mee in een snel groeiend team waar jouw bijdrage echt telt. Wat ga je doen Klantcontact. Je beantwoordt vragen via telefoon, e-mail en chat. Je legt complexe verzekeringspolissen en medische beslissingen uit op een manier die klanten écht begrijpen. Gegevensbeheer. Je vraagt medische dossiers op bij huisartsen en specialisten, controleert de volledigheid en verwerkt alles nauwkeurig in ons systeem. Samenwerken met specialisten. Je fungeert als schakel tussen de klant en de medisch specialist — je vat informatie samen, signaleert complexe vraagstukken en houdt de communicatie helder. Administratie. Je houdt klantgegevens up-to-date, verwerkt poliswijzigingen en bewaakt deadlines. Wat je meebrengt Je studeert momenteel, bij voorkeur in een richting met raakvlakken aan zorg, communicatie of bedrijfskunde. Je bent beschikbaar voor 24 tot 32 uur per week. Je Nederlands is uitstekend — zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Dit is een harde eis, omdat je dagelijks contact hebt met Nederlandstalige klanten. Je bent georganiseerd, schakelt makkelijk tussen taken en verliest deadlines nooit uit het oog. Je hebt een oprechte klantgerichte instelling — je vindt het fijn om mensen echt te helpen, ook als het niet makkelijk is. Je bent bereid het WFT-examen te halen als onderdeel van je professionele ontwikkeling. Wij betalen het en begeleiden je erdoorheen. title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
description: Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market. Deep in the wording. Fast in the build. About Insify Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most. We're doing it differently. Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance. We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader. Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve. What you’ll own in your first year You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline. Who you are You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one. You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs. You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be . Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes. You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market , and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen. You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are. You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs. You think like the customer : plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe. You’re at home in Excel and data , and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you. You work fluently in English ; German, French or Dutch is a big plus. What we offer Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made. Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent. A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build. A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship. Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program. The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party). The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support. If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Field Sales Representative - Amsterdam
description: Lightspeed is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. As a Field Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Lightspeed brand in your area. Your responsibilities: Generate lists of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial outbound call/ walk in to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus) Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Lightspeed in the market What you will bring to the team: Dutch fluency is a must Experience in a sourcing or closing customers, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry Since this is a field position, you will be out and about on a daily basis in your territory Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment Self-motivated, creative, and flexible General technical proficiency with software Experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus What’s in it for you? Come Live the Lightspeed Experience…. Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding. Uncapped commission Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact; and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry: Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners) Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow Subsidy to annual travel pass if you travel by public transport to the office Regular breakfast or lunches, drinks & snacks in our Amsterdam office To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. title: Senior Business Controller (Operations)
description: Would you like to work closely with the business as a Senior Business Controller and use your financial expertise to make a real impact on decisions? You will bring financial structure and insight, while keeping a forward-looking perspective: where can we improve, which decisions will make a financial difference, and what will they mean for our results? HG is a compact, international organisation. This means considerable responsibility, direct contact with decision-makers and room to drive change yourself. We are therefore looking for someone who takes ownership, works pragmatically and is not afraid to challenge existing ways of working. You will be based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working opportunities are limited: regular office attendance is important in this role because of the close collaboration with Finance, Operations and other stakeholders. You will also travel to the United Kingdom or Germany several times a year. About the role As Senior Business Controller, you will be responsible for business control within Operations and will also support our subsidiaries in the United Kingdom and Germany. You have a clear vision of what the best operational business control model looks like and have proven experience in realizing this. The Senior Business Controller plays a key role in strengthening financial control, transparency and decision-making across Operations. The scope covers procurement and product costing, as well as warehouse and transport operations. Working closely with Finance, Procurement and Operations, the Senior Business Controller translates operational developments and improvement initiatives into clear financial insights and P&L impact Our business is undergoing significant change. HG has recently changed its logistics service arrangements, consolidating most local warehouses into one central location as part of a cost-saving initiative. At the same time, a new ERP system is being implemented. This creates an interesting and dynamic environment in which existing budget models, cost allocation models, reporting and financial processes need to be further developed to reflect the new operating model and provide a solid basis for financial control and decision-making. What you will do Your responsibilities will include: Owning the operational cost lines between Net Sales and Contribution Margin for the whole group and . act as a strong Finance business partner to the Chief Operating Officer and his team, translating operational developments into actionable financial insights; Identifying and driving continuous improvements to the operational business, improving insights while reducing costs. Being the financial business partner for the country managers in the UK and Germany, including reviewing commercial deals and business cases. Analyzing budget versus actuals and explaining significant variances. Developing a clear understanding of budgeted versus actual purchase prices and identifying the key drivers behind price variances. Providing insight into raw material and purchase price developments and translating these into expected P&L impact. Quantifying and tracking the financial impact of Procurement and product-costing initiatives and other savings programmes. Establishing and further developing standard COGS based on expected cost developments. Build a thorough understanding of the warehouse and distribution budget, operational performance and key savings initiatives. Track whether the expected savings from the recently implemented warehouse and transport provider change are being realized in the P&L. Further developing cost allocation models for individual markets, using meaningful drivers, and working towards more complete and reliable management reporting. Ensuring the Operations P&L, budget and actual costs are consistently captured and reported in the same structure. Translating inventory developments into financial impact and creating a clear link between stock levels, budget assumptions and cost allocation. Supporting and improving an efficient month-end closing process, ensuring Operations costs are accurately and consistently booked, allocated and reconciled. E stablish or improve proper accounting entries together with Finance Administration and relevant operational partners. Co-lead the annual budget cycle and budget presentations to the Board. Using and improving Power BI, ERP data and financial processes to reduce manual work and increase transparency. You will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer and work closely with colleagues in Finance, Procurement and Operations. You will also have regular contact with the Germany and UK country managers. This position requires more than strong analytical skills. You will need to explain your insights clearly, engage stakeholders and constructively challenge where necessary. You will be a knowledgeable sparring partner who asks questions, brings structure and takes responsibility from analysis through to implementation. You proactively identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, reporting and transparency across Operations. HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. What you bring We are looking for a financially strong, hands-on and improvement-oriented controller who combines analytical capability with a practical understanding of Operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across Finance, Procurement and Operations and is able to turn complex cost drivers into clear insights and concrete actions. You bring a proactive mindset, strong stakeholder-management skills and a natural drive to simplify and improve processes. You are comfortable challenging existing ways of working, creating structure in a changing environment and taking ownership from analysis through implementation. You will also have: A completed university master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. A Registered Controller (RC) qualification is a strong advantage. Around 10 years of relevant experience in business control, operations control or a comparable financial role. Experience in a manufacturing environment is important, including knowledge of production processes, procurement and cost calculations. A sound understanding of business control, financial controls and treasury. Experience with ERP systems and an understanding of how financial data and accounting flows are structured. Good knowledge of Power BI. You do not need to build everything from scratch, but you can independently investigate, improve and develop analyses. Experience working with consolidation tools. Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive, hands-on and improvement-oriented mindset, with the ability to create structure in a changing environment. Fluency in English. Knowledge of Dutch is desirable, and German is an advantage. Experience with AI tools, such as Copilot. Willingness to travel to the United Kingdom and Germany several times a year. Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit What do we offer At HG, you will not be stepping into a role where everything is already set in stone. Changes in our logistics operations, systems and reporting create opportunities to further professionalize financial control and implement improvements yourself. You can expect: a senior role with broad responsibility and direct influence on financial and operational decision-making; a salary appropriate to the seniority of the role, with an indicative range of €85,000 to €100,000 gross per year; an annual on-target bonus of 25% of your gross annual salary; full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; a pension scheme; a commuting allowance; a full-time role based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working is possible on a limited basis, with office attendance being an important part of the role; a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued; a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks. We are HG HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products. We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems. HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance. We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact. HG does what it promises. Do you have any questions? Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at . Would you like to apply for the senior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days. Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated. title: Principal Growth Marketing Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>As a Principal Growth Marketing Manager on the Product Led Growth team, you set the growth strategy for a major set of audiences and product areas. You decide where Cloudflare should invest to win customers, how product-led and sales-assisted motions connect, and how marketing adapts as people increasingly discover and evaluate tools through AI.</p> <p>You still build. You write the theses, the messaging standards, the journey architecture, and the measurement model yourself. You also raise the capability of the growth marketers around you. Product leaders bring you in early to hear what they want amplified, and you give them a clear, evidence-based read on which messages are landing and which are not.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Set PLG growth strategy.</strong> Develop audience-centered growth theses that connect market insight, product usage, and business goals.</li> <li><strong>Lead product partnership.</strong> Work with senior product and engineering leaders to understand what they want amplified, and give them a clear read on which messages are landing and which are not.</li> <li><strong>Remove adoption friction.</strong> Diagnose signup-to-adoption funnels across products, prioritize the largest sources of friction, and drive cross-functional fixes to completion.</li> <li><strong>Build instrumentation and data pipelines.</strong> Design event instrumentation, data models, and pipelines that support growth goals: funnel and cohort reporting, attribution, and audience segmentation. title: Manager, Payments/Scheme Economics
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact You’ll help Airwallex manage and improve the economics of card payments, with a focus on scheme fees and interchange across Visa and Mastercard. You’ll turn complex network rules and payment data into accurate configurations, actionable analysis and decisions that improve cost visibility and margin performance. Own payment-cost analysis across scheme fees, interchange and network rules, identifying changes and translating them into clear financial, product and operational requirements. Maintain accurate fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic with Product and Engineering, ensuring payment-cost calculations and customer billing reflect current network rules. Build models and reporting across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types to identify margin drivers, anomalies, leakage and opportunities to improve payment economics. Support cost and margin optimisation through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration and related levers, contributing to pricing, product design, market launches and commercial decisions. Strengthen governance, testing, reconciliation and controls by comparing expected costs with actual network charges and helping drive root-cause resolution. Partner with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and external payment partners to resolve scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions. You’ll work from our Amsterdam office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials Experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or a related role, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech. Strong knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules. Experience translating complex payment rules, fee schedules or network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls. Experience working with payment-cost systems or controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations. Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modelling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs. Commercial judgment and the ability to connect payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimisation. Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale. Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners. Preferred Experience partnering directly with Visa, Mastercard or other payment networks. Experience applying AI or advanced analytics to rule interpretation, anomaly detection or payment-cost optimisation. You'll thrive here if You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect. Learn more about your team Finance & Corporate Development helps Airwallex grow with control. We’re a trusted partner to the business, providing actionable insights on performance, supporting market and product expansion and helping to shape the future of our product. We ensure that Airwallex meets its financial reporting, tax and safeguarding obligations globally. We work with existing and prospective investors to raise capital and ensure it is deployed effectively. This is a team for people who want to reimagine how the CFO office works. We’re looking for founder-like energy, high integrity and a passion for technology. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy working cross-functionally, think from first principles and can balance speed of execution with analytical precision. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>The role of a Telecommunications Field Engineer at Canonical</strong></p> <p>The telco industry is moving to software-defined services. This transformation is driven by open source software, cloud computing and the move to VNF / CNF approaches. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change.</p> <p>Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale.</p> <p>As part of the Canonical Field Engineering organization, you will lead customers through the design and delivery of OpenStack, Kubernetes, and software-defined networking solutions. Your passion for open-source technologies will enable customers to understand and operate advanced infrastructure substrates to meet the demands of 5G, sovereign AI, and beyond.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Remote-based, Americas and EMEA</span></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What your day will look like</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Translate Service Provider requirements into practical telco cloud platform architectures, enabling VNF/CNF, NFV, and MEC workloads at scale</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Provide technical pre-sales consulting to Service Provider teams</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Design and implement telco-grade open source multi-tenant private clouds and micro clouds</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Investigate, report and/or fix software defects uncovered during customer deployments</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Demonstrate advanced Infrastructure as code (IaC) techniques relevant to telco</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Architect and implement advanced, resilient Service Provider Cloud and Application solutions</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Design and deliver software defined infrastructure with OpenStack, Kubernetes, MAAS and Ceph</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Help customers adopt advanced Bare Metal, Public, Private and Hybrid Cloud solutions</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Support customer tenant onboarding, participate in architectural and business capability discussions, and enable successful adoption and production readiness of customer use cases</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Learn from customer engagements and drive meaningful product improvements</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Shape our roadmap to accelerate our growth in the telco market</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A thorough technical understanding of the telco NFVi (VIM), NFVO, VNFM and MEC space and key telco cloud infrastructure technologies like CPU Pinning, NUMA, SR-IOV, DPDK, etc</li> <li>Familiarity with telco architecture and industry standards</li> <li>Working knowledge of at least <strong>one of the following domains</strong>: Mobile Packet Core (4G/5G), Private Network, Radio Access Network (RAN), Voice, IP Backbone, VAS or OSS/BSS</li> <li>Working knowledge of Linux, Networking, OpenStack and Kubernetes</li> <li>Python software development experience for automation</li> <li>Ability to lead complex projects from start to finish</li> <li>A collaborative, customer-centric mindset with a strong focus on customer success</li> <li>Able to travel up to 25% of the time based on business requirements for events, customer meetings, project delivery</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Additional optimization, predictive maintenance, unified communication, and customer experience improvement</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Exposure to frameworks such as 3GPP, TM Forum ODA, eTOM, ETSI NFV, ONAP, O-RAN, or similar is a plus</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.</p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Parental Leave</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source.
